title: Sr. Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Sr. Construction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's senior owner's representative responsible for the autonomous end-to-end delivery of complex construction projects — including large-scale new builds, retrofits, and expansions for sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings that power Amazon's logistics network.

You operate with a high degree of independence, executing day-to-day operations autonomously and routinely delivering the right outcomes with limited guidance — even when project strategy is not yet well-defined. You deliver a mix of tactical and strategic initiatives that impact multiple teams and/or geographies in support of significant business objectives. You own design oversight, external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement — and you are accountable for the full performance of your external project management partners, architects, design consultants, general contractors, and subcontractors.

Beyond project delivery, you contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks, drive best practices across the organization, and are learning to force multiply — elevating the performance of the teams and partners around you. You write effective narratives and present complex decisions and trade-offs to Directors and VPs. You actively recruit, mentor, and develop other construction managers.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Own and enforce Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams; set the standard for safety culture on complex projects
- Lead negotiations with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) and regulatory bodies for permitting, regulatory compliance, and approvals
- Proactively identify and eliminate safety and compliance risks before they become project roadblocks

Project & Construction Management
- Oversee end-to-end project management services, design services, and external partner performance for complex projects; contribute to significantly complex projects as part of a team
- Serve as Amazon's senior owner's representative — the primary integrator between construction execution, design, and internal Amazon stakeholders across operations, equipment, IT, and facilities
- Develop project strategies and ensure appropriate resources are allocated to execute in accordance with those strategies
- Oversee design and engineering of complex projects, including design evaluations, design conformance reviews, and value engineering assessments
- Monitor project performance metrics, anticipate roadblocks and risks, manage escalations, and ensure corrective actions are taken
- Resolve complex issues and find a path forward in difficult situations; make trade-off decisions between short-term and long-term needs and defend those decisions to internal stakeholders
- Assess project performance through KPIs for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability; develop measurable targets and verifiable milestones

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Own project budgets and oversee spend approvals across all assigned projects
- Lead external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement functions
- Review, analyze, and approve or challenge cost and time change requests submitted by external project teams
- Review project requests against business need; provide approvals or recommend alternate solutions
- Ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements

External Partner & Stakeholder Management
- Align delivery from external project managers, architects, design consultants, general contractors, and subcontractors in line with Amazon priorities
- Hold external project managers accountable for timely accomplishment of deliverables; provide guidance and escalate as needed
- Support crucial relationships and lead negotiations of agreements with customers, suppliers, and external partners
- Collaborate with internal teams and influence them to decouple from dependencies; eliminate risks to innovation or customer satisfaction before they become roadblocks
- Partner with teams responsible for facility transition, base building management, and turnover documentation
- Contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks

Communication & Reporting
- Manage construction meetings effectively; drive detailed discussions and achieve high-level alignment and consensus across increasingly diverse stakeholder groups (legal, regulatory, operations, engineering, finance, external industry groups, etc.)
- Write effective narratives and present complex decisions, trade-offs, and potential solutions to Directors and VPs
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners
- Maintain clear, concise, and transparent communication across all project stakeholders

Process Improvement, Best Practices & People Development
- Drive continuous improvement and create sustainable, repeatable processes and playbooks for the team and region
- Drive efficiencies, streamline workflows, and mitigate excess process and risk
- Learn to force multiply — drive adoption of best practices and elevate the performance of teams and partners
- Recommend improvements to the way projects are scoped, built, tested, and deployed across the region or organization
- Actively recruit, mentor, and develop other construction managers within your organization and location

A day in the life
Each day, you operate as Amazon's senior owner's representative — autonomously driving the safe, on-time, and on-budget delivery of complex construction projects across your region. Your day may include:
- Reviewing design documents and providing strategic direction to engineering and design partners on complex projects
- Leading negotiations with general contractors, developers, or regulatory authorities
- Presenting project status, risks, and trade-off decisions to senior leadership
- Monitoring project performance metrics and driving corrective actions with external partners
- Collaborating with internal stakeholders across operations, equipment, IT, and facilities on project integration and handover planning
- Developing or updating process playbooks based on lessons learned from current projects
- Conducting site visits to verify construction quality, safety compliance, and schedule adherence

About the team
At Amazon, the GES NA D&C team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 7+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, or in a related construction discipline
- 7+ years of project management experience spanning design phase through construction completion and operational handover
- 7+ years of experience negotiating construction, procurement, and/or labor contracts
- 7+ years of proficiency with AutoCAD and/or Building Information Modeling (BIM), and scheduling software (Primavera, MS Project, or similar)
- Position includes travel up to 60% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions, or experience communicating results to senior leadership

title: Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer, B2C, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a strategic and technical Business Intelligence Engineer to build the analytics and data foundations that power Amazon Leo's global marketing engine. This role is critical in defining how a new Amazon business measures customer behavior, marketing effectiveness, funnel performance, and growth. You will design and build datasets, dashboards, pipelines, and measurement frameworks that enable Marketing, Product, and Leadership teams to make fast, data-driven decisions at scale.

This is a high-impact role requiring both strategic vision and hands-on technical execution. You will own and evolve the backend data architecture within our Customer Dat (Treasure Data), building upon existing foundations as new data sources and use cases emerge. You will design and maintain datasets and pipelines across our B2C tech stack, partnering with Data Engineering and Product teams to ensure complete, accurate, and actionable data across the full customer journey. This role requires collaborative autonomy—you will make independent strategic and technical decisions and drive your work forward with minimal oversight, while actively coordinating with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment and shared success.


Key job responsibilities
* Architect, build, and maintain foundational business datasets across our tech stack and other internal systems to support analytics, reporting, and customer growth use cases.
* Develop SQL-based transformations, data models, and ETL/ELT workflows to structure and unify marketing and customer data for customer lifecycle use cases.
* Design, optimize, and manage Amazon QuickSight dashboards that provide visibility into acquisition performance, attribution, and lifecycle funnels.
* Conduct deep-dive analysis to identify funnel drop-offs, diagnose performance issues, uncover customer insights, and evaluate marketing effectiveness.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches, data models, and scalable self-service tools.
* Drive alignment on KPI definitions, measurement frameworks, taxonomy, and data governance across global marketing teams.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Sales Ops, Data Science, and cross-functional partners to support experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, and predictive insights.
* Communicate effectively with senior management audiences (e.g. narratives, inputs into weekly/monthly/quarterly business reviews).* Drive best practices in operational excellence, data modeling, and analysis. Ensure that BI solutions are correctly and efficiently supporting the business.* Participate in hiring activities and mentor junior team members

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


A day in the life
You will spend part of your day improving the business health data architecture—designing better datasets, cleaning pipelines, and enabling new use cases in the CDP and other internal spaces. Another part of your day will involve partnering with Data Engineering to review instrumentation or troubleshoot data issues. You will also work directly with Marketing and Product teams to conduct deep dives, and design new measurement approaches. You will be a strategic and technical owner ensuring that Amazon Leo Marketing can make accurate, timely, data-driven decisions.

About the team
The Amazon Leo B2C team is responsible for building a world-class experience and driving global demand for a transformational connectivity service. The B2C Analytics team builds the systems, data flows, measurements, and insights that support a multi-LOB global business. We operate with the agility of a startup inside Amazon, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Science, and global marketing teams to ensure our decisions are grounded in high-quality data.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional or military experience
- 5+ years of SQL experience
- 1+ years of SQL, ETL or Oracle experience
- 1+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
- 1+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
- 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience
- Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets
- Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience with AWS technologies
- Experience with theory and practice of information retrieval, data science, machine learning and data mining

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

title: Strategic Customer Engagements, ISV EMEA
descriptionHtml:
At AWS, the Global Deal Strategy and Programs (GDSP) team drives cloud adoption and business growth through innovative pricing strategies. The organization comprises two specialized teams: Strategic Customer Engagements, which guide transformative deals with industry leaders, and Private Pricing Programs & Experiences, which scales and optimizes pricing solutions across our diverse customer base. Within GDSP, you will develop deep expertise in cloud economics, hone your strategic thinking, and directly impact AWS's market leadership while working with technologies and global clients.

Do you have an aptitude for analyzing opportunities and creating high-impact, innovative business deals? Can you take complex scenarios and simplify them down to the essentials while building consensus across broad stakeholder groups?

Strategic Customer Engagements (SCE) is seeking a Deal Lead to drive engagement and lead the various critical phases of the Deal Cycle (Strategy, Structuring, Negotiations, and Closure) for Strategic Collaborations. This role has an EMEA responsibility, is highly partner and customer facing, and will work closely with Amazon customers, partners, Partner Network (APN) programs teams, partner segment leaders, and sales leaders. The ideal candidate will possess a deal strategist and negotiator background, and experience in technology sales with customers and partners, and developing Go To Market (GTM) strategic collaborations, and be a proven collaborator across multiple stakeholders including engaging at partner/customer C-suite levels.

Strategy: This individual will work with the Partner and Account Team to set objectives, analyze key data and ensure executive alignment and governance. The individual will be able to provide advice on the competitive situation, create an actionable strategy, and lead engagement with the customer.

Structure: You will be able to distill business objectives in service of developing and executing deal structures that maximize the value of the opportunity for both customers and AWS.

Negotiations: You will be experienced with high-stakes customer negotiations, including commercial aspects of the deal structure. The individual understands the impact of business terms and pricing and can provide alternative solutions to ensure alignment across internal and external stakeholders.

Closure: Will be able to bring to closure, in partnership with the customer and partner/account team and legal teams, any contractual/legal matters for the deal, including briefing senior management.

Key job responsibilities
• Act as trusted advisor and thought leader in the development of the strategy and execution of the sales and GTM deal cycle (strategy, structuring, negotiation, and closure) for strategic, complex, or highly competitive partner and channel opportunities.
• Collaborate with finance and analytics teams to produce financial models, risk assessments and performance metrics that will guide each deal, ensuring data-driven decision-making and scalability.
• Dive Deep into customers’ business needs and obstacles, tailoring deal structures that are mutually beneficial to all.
• Inspire and influence internal stakeholders, experts and other resources not under direct control, proactively removing obstacles to drive deal momentum and deliver seamless execution.
• Facilitate alignment and effective AWS communication within sales team and internal/external key partners/customers and promptly resolve any conflicts to encourage harmonious and productive interaction.
• Continuously monitor and analyze industry trends and competitive landscapes to inform deal strategy and identify high-potential opportunities.
• Ensure disciplined sales methodology application across management groups, resulting in consistent and accurately forecasted financial results.
• Cultivate best practices through analysis and reporting in support of continuous improvement.
• Work with key internal stakeholders (e.g. AWS Partner Organization, finance, operations, legal, etc.) as needed.

A day in the life
SCE is a specialized global deal team that engages with commercial customers on deal strategy, structuring, and negotiations through contractual closure for transformational, strategic, large, complex, and/or highly competitive opportunities. This is a unique opportunity to engage with AWS customers on strategic opportunities, increase the growth of AWS (EMEA), and to establish AWS as their key cloud technology provider. These opportunities range across industry verticals. These engagements may also involve Pan-Amazon and AWS go-to-market opportunities involving close partnership between the SCE team and other Amazon and AWS stakeholders.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with, presenting to, and negotiating with C-level executives, IT, lines of business, procurement, finance, legal and internal stakeholders for sizeable commercial/enterprise deals
- Experience in technology-related sales, business development, or sales engineering/consulting
- Experience in management consulting, strategy, technology, venture capital, or a related industry

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in AWS products and services, including pricing and technical knowledge
- Experience identifying, developing, negotiating, and closing large-scale technology deals
- Proven track record of managing and streamlining complex processes with a close attention to detail
- Understanding of the Global/SI business model and ISV partnerships
- Strong written and verbal presentation skills and the ability to articulate complex concepts to cross-functional audiences.

title: Mechanical Engineer, Satellite Hardware
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Leo Mechanical Engineering organization is looking for early-career mechanical engineers who want to design, build, test, and deliver hardware for a large-scale satellite constellation.

Our mechanical engineering teams own hardware across the spacecraft lifecycle, from early concepts and architecture through detailed design, analysis, prototyping, qualification, manufacturing, and flight. Engineers work directly with hardware and collaborate across electrical, thermal, RF, reliability, manufacturing, software, and operations teams to solve multidisciplinary engineering problems.

This role is intended for engineers early in their careers who have a strong foundation in mechanical engineering fundamentals, are curious about how things work, and want to develop broad spacecraft hardware experience. Depending on background, interests, and business needs, engineers may work in spacecraft structures, avionics packaging, harnessing, solar arrays, mechanisms, test development, or manufacturing process development.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design mechanical hardware, assemblies, fixtures, or test equipment using engineering fundamentals and sound design practices.
- Create and release 3D models, drawings, specifications, and other engineering documentation.
- Perform engineering analysis and calculations to support design decisions and verify performance.
- Work directly with technicians, machinists, manufacturing engineers, suppliers, and other partners to build and evaluate hardware.
- Develop and execute engineering tests to characterize hardware, validate designs, and investigate failures.
- Participate in design reviews and communicate technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to multidisciplinary teams.
- Apply Design for Manufacturing and Assembly principles to improve hardware manufacturability, reliability, cost, and production scalability.
- Troubleshoot hardware issues using data, testing, and first-principles engineering.
- Support hardware from early prototype development through qualification, production, and flight.
- Develop increasing technical ownership of hardware and engineering decisions as experience grows.

A day in the life
There is no single typical day for a mechanical engineer on the team. You might begin the morning reviewing test data from hardware tested overnight, then update a CAD model based on what you learned. Later, you could work alongside a technician assembling a prototype, perform a hand calculation or finite element analysis to evaluate a design change, or meet with electrical and thermal engineers to resolve competing packaging requirements.

You may spend the afternoon in the lab troubleshooting hardware, preparing for a design review, working with a supplier on a manufacturing issue, or developing a fixture to test a new design.

Our engineers are expected to move comfortably between analysis, design, hardware, and data. The goal is not simply to produce drawings or calculations, but to understand the hardware, make sound engineering decisions, and help carry those decisions through to a successful product.

About the team
The Leo Mechanical Engineering organization designs, develops, tests, and industrializes the hardware that enables our satellite constellation. Our teams span spacecraft structures and integration, avionics packaging, harnessing, solar arrays, mechanisms, test development, and manufacturing process development. Engineers work across disciplines and throughout the full product lifecycle, from early concepts and prototypes through qualification, production, launch, and on-orbit operation. We combine deep technical expertise with strong hardware ownership and rapid iteration, giving engineers the opportunity to solve challenging multidisciplinary problems while seeing their designs progress from an idea to flight hardware.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Experience in engineering
- Experience in 3D CAD
- Experience in hardware design
- Experience communicating technical concepts and processes using clear, simple language and visuals

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on experience building mechanical systems through internships, laboratory work, Formula SAE, rocketry, robotics, CubeSat, machining, personal projects, or similar activities.
- Experience with CAD and Product Lifecycle Management tools such as Siemens NX and Teamcenter.
- Familiarity with engineering drawings, GD&T, tolerance analysis, and mechanical design best practices.
- Familiarity with structural mechanics, dynamics, thermal environments, materials, mechanisms, electronics packaging, or manufacturing processes.
- Experience developing or executing engineering tests and interpreting test data.
- Experience with Python, MATLAB, or other engineering analysis and automation tools.
- Understanding of Design for Manufacturing and Assembly principles.
- Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar technical subjects, work through ambiguous problems, and use first-principles reasoning to develop practical engineering solutions.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As an Amazon Leo Interdisciplinary RF Test System Engineer, you will own the full lifecycle of complex RF test systems and hardware development for spacecraft avionics and payload sub-systems. Your responsibilities span hardware and software development activities, RF test, system-level architecture, calibration support, and test system BOM-level CAD design. You will serve as the Responsible Engineer (RE) for your test set, operating at the intersection of hardware development, RF system verification, Space qualification testing, test automation, and high-rate manufacturing.

You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. You'll have relentlessly high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you'll be constantly looking for ways to improve. We want individuals who want to reach beyond what is possible today. Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a highly collaborative environment.

Key job responsibilities
• Architect, design, build, and sustain RF test systems for satellite modems, transceivers, BUCs, LNBs, and ground equipment through design validation, qualification, production and on-orbit support
• Support hardware and software development activities including RF subsystem design, integration, and characterization
• Perform RF test system-level path loss calibration, link budget analysis, and end-to-end signal chain verification
• Own test system BOM-level CAD design including rack layout, cable harness routing, mechanical fixture design, and documentation
• Own test planning end-to-end: decompose verification requirements into testable specifications, develop test procedures, and lead test readiness reviews
• Drive cross-functional alignment with electrical, mechanical, thermal, software, firmware, and manufacturing teams on verification strategy
• Design and deliver test hardware, fixtures, and tooling that optimize throughput, yield, and fault coverage
• Develop and maintain calibration procedures, path loss models, and measurement uncertainty budgets for RF test stations
• Build quantitative models (test coverage, reliability, throughput) to inform design trade studies and process decisions
• Automate and optimize test processes to meet production rate and first-pass yield targets
• Perform root cause analysis on test failures, lead corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement of production test systems


A day in the life
Our time is balanced between critical support/improvement of existing factory test processes, hardware development activities, and designing future test systems. This includes hands-on support troubleshooting space flight hardware and test systems, CAD design for test system BOMs, and working to align teams around future needs, employing engineering best practices and tools, including AI.

The tasks and daily focus change rapidly, and you will often take on exciting new responsibilities to ensure project success. Expect to address complex problems by diving deep into the data, identifying the scope of the issue, and creating innovative and functional solutions.

This Interdisciplinary Engineer will be a member of the Avionics Verification & Test team working within the wider RF Hardware Engineering team. This highly collaborative group of engineers has a diverse range of backgrounds and knowledge and works to build scalable and reliable test automation solutions and hardware development capabilities to ensure reliable operation of satellite vehicles in space.

The team's responsibilities include process development, test hardware and software development, and test execution supporting our 24/7 satellite manufacturing factory.

- 5+ years of experience developing and executing test plans for complex aerospace, automotive, or consumer electronics systems
- 5+ years of experience designing and integrating test systems for hardware/PCBA validation
- Demonstrated ability to work across multiple technical disciplines in a production or manufacturing environment
- Experience with RF path loss calibration, measurement uncertainty analysis, and signal chain characterization
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Experience with RF measurement equipment, including: power meters, spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators, network analyzers, oscilloscopes

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
- Cross-functional product development experience from concept through production
- 10+ years hands-on with RF subsystems, PCBAs, or high-speed signal characterization
- Test plan development per space hardware standards (GEVS / SMC-S-016)

You will architect the component knowledge base for AI cross-referencing against vendor datasheets, build engineering workflow integrations, and drive adoption across all hardware programs, eliminating design escapes, reducing board respins, and accelerating time-to-production for AWS custom silicon platforms.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager,  Amazon Smart Vehicles
descriptionHtml:
Do you have a passion for Automotive? Do you want to challenge the status quo of the in-car experience? Do you want to be the technical authority helping Japan's leading automakers build the future of the digital cabin? If you answered yes to these questions, we have a dream job for you. We are building the next generation voice-forward in-cabin experience that delights customers, increases safety, and brings the future of digital cabin to life. We are looking for a highly driven, technically deep, and customer-obsessed technical account manager to serve as the trusted technical advisor to leading Japanese automotive manufacturers including Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Mazda, and Subaru.

Based in Tokyo, you will be the on-the-ground technical leader for Japan, working closely with the global Amazon Smart Vehicles team to design, architect, and deliver voice AI solutions for Japanese automotive manufacturers. You'll be at the forefront of translating innovative genAI voice experiences into production-ready architectures for Japan's leading OEMs, helping them accelerate their technological capabilities and digital transformations through hands-on technical engagement.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the primary technical advisor and solutions architect for Japanese automotive OEMs including Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Mazda, Subaru, and other key manufacturers
• Design and present end-to-end solution architectures for in-cabin voice AI, integrating Amazon's genAI capabilities with OEM-specific vehicle platforms, infotainment systems, and cloud infrastructure
• Build and maintain deep technical relationships with Japanese OEM engineering leaders, chief architects, and platform teams, navigating complex organizational structures and cultural nuances
• Lead technical deep-dives, proof-of-concept engagements, and architecture workshops with OEM engineering teams to validate solution fit and accelerate adoption
• Partner with business development to support deal progression by providing technical credibility, solution scoping, and architecture proposals during complex commercial negotiations
• Develop and deliver technical presentations, demos, and reference architectures tailored to Japanese OEM requirements, including edge vs. cloud deployment trade-offs and EdgeLite positioning
• Provide regular technical status updates and integration progress reports in English to global leadership, leveraging AI tools for Japanese-to-English communication as needed
• Navigate Japanese automotive engineering processes and technical evaluation frameworks, understanding system integration requirements, validation criteria, and homologation standards
• Work closely with internal stakeholders (AWS Solutions Architecture, Product Engineering, Partner Engineering) and global Amazon Smart Vehicles team to coordinate technical strategies and integration roadmaps
• Collaborate with product, engineering, and platform teams to translate customer technical requirements into product feature requests and influence roadmap priorities
• Evaluate and address technical objections, competitive positioning, and integration challenges specific to the Japanese automotive market
• Represent Amazon Smart Vehicles at Japanese automotive technology conferences, developer events, and customer technical reviews
• Provide technical market intelligence and competitive architecture insights from the Japanese automotive sector to inform global product and engineering strategy


A day in the life
You'll be driving technical engagement activities on the ground in Tokyo — leading architecture workshops with OEM engineering teams, conducting solution deep-dives, building proof-of-concepts, and advancing multiple concurrent integration efforts. Your day involves navigating Japanese engineering culture, managing complex technical stakeholder relationships, designing solutions that bridge Amazon's genAI voice platform with diverse vehicle architectures, and keeping global engineering and leadership teams informed of technical progress in English. You'll balance hands-on technical execution (writing architecture documents, building demos, troubleshooting integrations) with strategic thinking about how Amazon's technology stack best fits Japan's automotive platform landscape.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- 6+ years of solving problems with technology in the Automotive & Manufacturing industries experience
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
- Experience in technical support, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
- • 10+ years of experience in the automotive industry with focus on infotainment systems, embedded software, voice/AI integration, or technical solutions architecture
- • Track record of leading technical evaluations and proof-of-concept engagements in competitive environments with long validation cycles typical of automotive industry
- • Experience designing integration architectures for automotive platforms; understanding of Japanese automotive technical evaluation and supplier qualification processes
- • Deep technical knowledge of automotive software stacks and platforms (Android Automotive, QNX, Linux), hardware platforms (Qualcomm, Nvidia, Renesas SOCs), genAI/LLM architectures, speech-to-speech pipelines, and edge computing deployment in automotive environments

Preferred qualifications

- AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Bachelor's degree
- • Experience working with automotive Tier 1 suppliers (Denso, Aisin, Continental, Bosch, Harman, Alps Alpine) on system integration or platform development
- • Deep understanding of competitive technical landscape in automotive voice AI and infotainment, particularly in Japanese market (Cerence, Google Automotive Services, Apple CarPlay architectures)
- • Experience with Japanese OEM engineering organizations and technical decision-making processes at Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Mazda, Subaru, or similar manufacturers
- • Hands-on experience with voice AI/NLU/ASR systems, conversational AI frameworks, or large language model deployment in resource-constrained environments
- • Knowledge of automotive middleware, AUTOSAR, vehicle APIs, and connected vehicle cloud architectures
- • Understanding of Japanese automotive industry technical standards, regulatory requirements (e.g., driver distraction guidelines), and platform certification processes
- • Existing technical relationships with engineering leaders at Japanese automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers
- • Experience coordinating across global and regional engineering teams in matrix organizations

descriptionHtml:

- Learn the daily operations of a high-density data center from the ground up
- Collaborate with teams across DC Operations, Engineering, Logistics, Security, and more

- Learn to operate independently, while staying connected to a supportive team

- A clear path forward where if you demonstrate strong performance, you may be considered for permanent full-time roles.
- An environment built around career progression
The chance to work at the intersection of hardware and cloud technology, helping to shape infrastructure across the region.

What we're looking for:
- Genuine curiosity about computer hardware and how large-scale technology works
- A willingness to learn, adapt, and solve problems hands-on
- Comfort working both independently and as part of a team
- Reliability and a safety-first mindset

Amazon Web Services design, install, and maintain the world's largest computing infrastructure. This is where you will help change the face of technology in the region, Hands-on work. World-scale impact.
Ready to start? Learn more at https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/

Key job responsibilities
Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:

- You will be trained in supporting data center infrastructure equipment including racks, servers, hardware components, networking devices and cables, following specific instructions and well-defined Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
- You will learn to perform routine operations such as rack installations, server break/fix, hardware component replacements, diagnosing hardware faults, troubleshooting network links and rack decommissioning with guidance and support.
- You will be trained in using Directed Workflow Instructions for hardware replacements and documenting all work in ticket tracking systems.
- You will learn to identify issue severity and work within stated Service Level Agreements (SLA), escalating when work deviates from established processes.
- You will be trained in inventory management tasks including receiving equipment, decommissioning hardware, liquidating racks or hardware components, and performing storage media (HDD, SSD) sanitization and destruction.
- You will learn how to operate in a high security environment, follow information security policies and physical safety practices, ensuring safe, secure work at all times.
- You will be trained in using technical documentation to find solutions and performing routine tasks following clear instructions.
- You will learn to work as part of a team performing similar tasks, collaborating with various AWS stakeholders.

- Familiarity with IT hardware, networking, or technical support gained through study, work, or hands-on tinkering
- A genuine enthusiasm for technology and a desire to build a career in data center operations or IT infrastructure
- Candidates should be able to perform the physical requirements of this role, which may include handling equipment.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. Software Developer - Amazon Web Services - Herndon, VA
Amazon Web Services (Route 53) is expanding our presence within the Herndon, VA area due to explosive growth! We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join the Amazon Route 53 team. You will design, build, and operate globally distributed systems that enable millions of customers to securely and reliably resolve DNS queries within milliseconds—across regions, VPCs, on-premises environments, and hybrid/multi-cloud architectures.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of networking, security, and distributed systems at massive global scale. You will get an opportunity to across the full stack—control plane, data plane, API surfaces—and integrate with core AWS infrastructure services. You will also help drive system architecture decisions, champion engineering best practices, and mentor junior engineers on the team.

At Amazon Web Services, we like to “work backwards”: start by understanding what customers need and using that to guide our software engineering. We’re looking for a software engineer who is experienced in listening to customers, synthesizing their needs, and rapidly iterating our services to quickly put features into customers’ hands. Our best ideas become even better when we get feedback from real customer use. The sooner we can get that feedback, the more quickly we can grow.

This position will be part of the Amazon Route 53 team in the Herndon, VA office. Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable Domain Name System (DNS) service offered by Amazon Web Services. We operate in over 50 locations worldwide and provide advanced functionality such as latency-based routing (LBR), Private DNS, Geo DNS routing, DNS failover, and integration with a plethora of AWS services. On top of that, we offer fast change propagation with a 100% availability SLA. Our service is quickly growing and we're expanding in multiple directions: adding new features and functionality to our DNS services, better traffic management, new AWS integrations, improving our health check capabilities, and expanding with new services in the naming and routing space.

We work on deep, technical problems that span a variety of core topics in computer science ranging from databases to networking to distributed systems to numerical analysis to security. We are looking for a developer who will lead the team and who feels strongly not only about building good software but also about running that software in the real world.

Amazon in a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” On a typical day, software engineers might whip up a prototype to prove an idea, instrument code to report a new metric, talk with customers, code up a feature, or draft a proposal for a radical new idea.

Design and implement highly available, low-latency distributed systems that serve DNS traffic at global scale

descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!


Key job responsibilities

Develop foundation models for content understanding using state-of-the-art deep learning and multimodal learning techniques to analyze video and text
Build time sequence foundation models to understand and predict customer behavior patterns and viewing trajectories
Work closely with engineers and product managers to design, implement and launch solutions end-to-end across various Prime Video experiences
Design and conduct offline and online (A/B) experiments to evaluate proposed solutions based on in-depth data analyses
Effectively communicate technical and non-technical ideas with teammates and stakeholders
Stay up-to-date with advancements and the latest modeling techniques in foundation models, multimodal learning, and time series analysis
Publish your research findings in top conferences and journals

A day in the life
We're using advanced approaches such as foundation models to connect information about our videos and customers from a variety of information sources, acquiring and processing data sets on a scale that only a few companies in the world can match. This will enable us to recommend titles effectively, even when we don't have a large behavioral signal (to tackle the cold-start title problem). It will also allow us to find our customer's niche interests, helping them discover groups of titles that they didn't even know existed. We are looking for creative & customer obsessed machine learning scientists who can apply the latest research, state of the art algorithms and ML to build highly scalable page personalization solutions. You'll be a research leader in the space and a hands-on ML practitioner, guiding and collaborating with talented teams of engineers and scientists and senior leaders in the Prime Video organization. You will also have the opportunity to publish your research at internal and external conferences.

About the team
Prime Video Recommendation Science team owns science solution to power recommendation and personalization experience on various Prime Video surfaces and devices. We work closely with the engineering teams to launch our solutions in production.

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

title: Senior Product Manager, Tech, Amazon Manufacturing Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Manufacturing Services (AMS) is seeking a Sr. Product Manager, Tech to own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the manufacturing execution and automation intelligence stack powering Amazon’s first advanced manufacturing facility — a highly automated, first-of-its-kind operation. This facility integrates industrial robotics, end-to-end manufacturing automation, and digital manufacturing to produce systems for Amazon’s global fulfillment network.

Key job responsibilities
Manufacturing Execution Product Strategy
• Own the 2–3 year product roadmap for the manufacturing execution stack — from scheduling UX through operator tools to AI-powered optimization
• Define the product vision that connects AI-native scheduling intelligence to the physical shop floor experience
• Develop and maintain the execution technology strategy across P0 (manual + semi-automated), P1 (AGV integration, real-time optimization), and P2 (AI-enabled autonomous control)
• Write compelling narratives (PR/FAQs, 6-pagers, OP docs) that articulate product strategy and secure investment from leadership

Scheduling & Operator Experience
• Serve as the operational product partner to the scheduling engineering team — translating manufacturing floor needs, pain points, and workflows into product requirements
• Own the operator-facing scheduling experience: how assignments surface, how disruptions are communicated, how overrides are captured, and how the system explains its decisions to the right audience
• Drive the scheduling system’s authority progression (Shadow → Advisory → Co-Pilot → Decision Maker) by defining success criteria, measuring override rates, and building supervisor trust through UX design
• Define product requirements for scheduling and explainability tools from the operator/supervisor perspective

Machine Connectivity & IIoT
• Own the product vision for machine connectivity — defining how equipment telemetry flows from factory floor to data lake to decision systems
• Define integration requirements for manufacturing equipment onboarded at the manufacturing facility (industrial lasers, robotic welding cells, automated coating lines, autonomous mobile robots)
• Develop product requirements for digital twin capabilities — real-time equipment state, simulation for what-if analysis, and predictive modeling
• Partner with automation engineers to define the machine-to-cloud data contract for each equipment class

AI/ML & Continuous Improvement
• Define and execute product strategy for AI-driven manufacturing intelligence: predictive maintenance, automated quality inspection, process parameter optimization, and autonomous cell control
• Own requirements for the data platform layer that enables ML — feature stores, event streams, model serving infrastructure
• Drive the feedback loop between quality outcomes (first-pass yield, scrap rates) and upstream process adjustments — ensuring the system learns and improves continuously
• Define the operator interaction model for AI recommendations — when to alert, when to auto-act, when to require human confirmation

Shop Floor Quality & Compliance
• Own the product experience for in-line quality: inspection workflows, non-conformance reporting, root cause analysis tools, and SPC dashboards
• Define how quality data flows back to both the scheduling system (for replan triggers) and the enterprise system (for financial variance reporting)
• Partner with Quality Engineering to translate ISO 9001:2015 requirements into tool capabilities and audit-ready data records


A day in the life
In the morning, you review overnight production data from our prototyping factory — the scheduling system’s override rate dropped to 7% this week, and you’re preparing the case to promote it from Shadow to Advisory mode. You pull the override-reason breakdown to identify two UX issues driving unnecessary supervisor interventions, then draft requirements for the engineering team.

Mid-morning, you join the scaled factory equipment onboarding review. The laser cutting integration team needs a decision on telemetry frequency — you work through the tradeoffs between data granularity (better for predictive maintenance models) and network cost (lower in batch mode), landing on a tiered approach by signal type.

After lunch, you’re on the prototype factory floor shadowing a powder coating operator through a disruption scenario — a rush order just reshuffled the queue, and you observe how the shop floor app communicates the change. The operator missed the notification; you sketch a design change in your notebook.

You close the day reviewing the ECO blast-radius prototype with the engineering team. An engineering change landed that affects 47 in-flight orders — the impact visualization needs to surface at-risk-dollars more prominently for the Change Control Board’s decision meeting tomorrow.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields
- 7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Experience defining roadmap strategy and prioritizing deliverables for your team products
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting
- Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES), shop floor scheduling, or production control software
- Experience managing technical products or online services in manufacturing or industrial environments

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in high-volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments
- Experience in practical work applying ML to solve complex problems
- Experience with concepts such as system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, and decision making
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
- Knowledge of cutting-edge production technologies and delivery workflows
- Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or other related discipline
- Experience presenting complex ideas in writing in the form of authoring white papers, proposals, or other formal strategy documents
- Knowledge of IIoT protocols (OPC UA, MTConnect, MQTT) and industrial data integration
- Experience in high-volume, high-mix manufacturing environments (metals fabrication, welding, coating, assembly)
- Experience with ISO 9001 or similar manufacturing quality management systems
- Knowledge of Industry 4.0 principles, smart manufacturing architectures, or software-defined manufacturing

title: Cloud Infra Architect, Migration, APJ-Delivery-Japan, Migrations & Mainframe Transformation
descriptionHtml:
企業を支える基幹システムのアプリケーションの革新に携わり、ビジネストランスフォーメーションと価値創造をリードしませんか？
Amazon Web Services(AWS)のProfessional Servicesでは、企業のオンプレミス環境上にあるワークロードをAWSへのマイグレーションを支援し、これらのシステムをモダナイズすることで、お客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーションをより俊敏かつ弾力的に加速できるようにプロジェクトをリードするCloud Infra Architectを募集しています。
お客様の業務を支える基幹システムはビジネスを支える重要なシステムです。多くの企業において、こうしたシステムは、オンプレミス環境で稼働しています。こうしたシステムは安定かつ堅剛である一方で、定常的な運用コスト負荷、短期間で変化するビジネスニーズへの柔軟な対応が容易でないなどが課題になっています。従来のアプリケーション資産をクラウドへマイグレーションし、継承しモダナイズすることでビジネスに俊敏性と持続性を実現化することは大きなチャレンジです。しかし、移行・モダナイズされたアプリケーションアセットを Amazon Web Services(AWS) のマネージドサービス上で動かすことは、単なるプラットフォームやアプリケーションアセットの刷新にとどまらない、お客様の未来を作る仕事です。マイグレーションとモダナイゼーションによってコスト削減、効率化が実現すれば、生成AIなどの最新の技術サービスの活用による新しいアプリケーション開発と新しいビジネスサービスのプロダクトリリースなどの長期的な好循環と価値の享受が期待できます。このようなお客様のビジネストランスフォーメーションの実現を支援するのが Cloud Infra Consultant です。オンプレミス環境の知識と経験を持ち、これらの上で稼働する様々なワークロードのクラウドへのマイグレーションとモダナイゼーションに経験、興味のある方を求めています。

title: Delivery Practice Manager, Media & Entertainment, Professional Services - AWS Industries
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services is looking for an experienced and motivated manager to lead, coach, grow, and partner with technically skilled, customer-facing Video and Cloud Architects for the Media & Entertainment (M&E) vertical. This role is based in the US or Canada supporting our lighthouse Media & Entertainment customers (world's largest Content Studios/Film houses, Post Production Studios, Broadcasters as well as MVPDs).

Professional Services (ProServe) engage in a wide variety of projects for customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base to obsessively drive customer success. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to Product and Service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.

As part of the AWS ProServe Video Solution Delivery team, we take AWS products, 3rd party products, and build solutions for our customers. As a Global Practice Manager for M&E, this executive-level candidate has extensive experience defining, designing, and implementing solutions for studios, broadcasters, and OTT providers. Ultimately, you will help us achieve our goal of becoming the market leader and most respected solution provider for cloud enabled video workflows. In this role, you will need to be technically capable and credible in your own right as well as effective in shaping the customer and solutions-focused skills of your team. You must enjoy learning and introducing new technology in order to help colleagues and customers embrace and adopt new technology. Furthermore, thought leadership in terms of looking beyond the technology and considering the value technology creates for our customers, and helping to change how technology is viewed are important aspects of the role. You will help team members ramp-up on AWS as well as develop speaking, writing, presentation, and executive as well as media industry interaction skills.

A strong Media industry skillset/acumen is a must. We strive to provide perspective guidance to our customers related to their core media business workloads including all segments of M&E industry from Content Production/Creation to Video Distribution and a past experience related to media business will be very helpful for the success of this role.

You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other departments within AWS such as our Sales, Account and Business Development teams, as well as representing your team to executive management and being able to guide AWS Service teams with appropriate roadmap feature set and Marketing teams with appropriate solution messaging related to media workloads.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

At AWS, we have a credo of "Work hard. Have fun. Make history". In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.

Engage with customers and collaborate with AWS sales leaders, business development leaders and engineering teams to drive design wins and platform adoption for Media & Entertainment customers on the AWS platform.

Enjoy developing technical talent to achieve great things. You will have a passion for educating, training, and enabling cloud computing experts for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise and mid-market customers.

Have a strong understanding of large-scale computing solutions, business-IT transformations, or relevant consulting experience. The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a technical consultant/architect or similar role and managing a team of technical consultants/architects.

You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions.

This is a customer facing role. You will be required to travel to client locations and deliver professional services when needed.

title: Workforce Planning Specialist II, Global Hiring Operations, GHXO Workforce Planning
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help shape the future of workforce planning and hiring operations? Amazon Workforce Staffing's Global Hiring Experience Operations (GHXO) team is seeking an exceptionally talented individual to join our team as a Specialist II, Global Planning.
We are seeking an experienced planning professional to join our GHXO team. This individual will execute contact center forecasting and scheduling across both internal site locations and BPO vendor sites, manage vendor relationships, and support procurement activities to ensure our hiring operations deliver exceptional candidate and hiring manager experiences at scale.
The ideal candidate will draw from their experience in contact center workforce management, capacity planning, and operational budgeting; demonstrating their ability to analyze data, drive scheduling decisions, execute process improvements, and deliver results in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Experience in BPO vendor management or procurement is a plus but not required.


Key job responsibilities
Execute contact center forecasting models to project staffing needs across internal site locations and BPO vendor sites; ensure alignment with demand plans and hiring targets.

Build and maintain scheduling frameworks for internal and outsourced contact center operations; optimize shift coverage, service levels, and agent utilization across all locations.

Manage day-to-day BPO vendor relationships; track performance against SLAs, escalate issues, and drive corrective action plans.

Support procurement activities for BPO vendors; assist with RFP processes, contract renewals, and cost analysis.

Maintain operational budget planning throughout the fiscal year; track spend against plan, identify variances, and recommend adjustments to stay within budget targets.

Process and develop upcoming year Operating Plan (OP) assumptions for contact center spend across internal and vendor operations; provide data-driven inputs for annual planning cycles.

Analyze key operational metrics (service level, occupancy, shrinkage, attrition) across internal and vendor sites to identify performance gaps and recommend solutions.

Deep dive inefficiencies across internal and vendor operations; own root cause analysis and implement scalable mechanisms to resolve recurring issues.

Coordinate with internal stakeholders (Capacity Planning, Finance, Vendor Management, Operations) to ensure forecasting inputs and vendor deliverables remain aligned.

Develop and maintain operational playbooks, SOPs, and reporting tools that support planning accuracy and accountability across internal and vendor teams.

Triage operational issues across internal and vendor sites; own resolution timelines and communicate status to leadership.


A day in the life
You will work as part of the GHXO planning team, balancing your time between forecasting and scheduling activities for internal and outsourced contact center operations, managing vendor performance, and supporting budget and procurement workflows. You will analyze volume trends, adjust staffing plans, review vendor scorecards, reconcile budget variances, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to remove obstacles and maintain operational excellence.

About the team
The Global Hiring Experience Operations (GHXO) team within Amazon Workforce Staffing owns the end-to-end hiring experience for high-volume roles. The team operates internal contact center sites and partners with BPO vendors to deliver additional capacity that supports candidate engagement, hiring workflows, and operational scalability. GHXO drives efficiency and quality across both internal and outsourced operations while maintaining Amazon's high bar for candidate experience.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
- 3+ years of contact center operations management with demonstrated progressively increased responsibility experience
- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
- Experience with operational budget management or financial planning within a contact center environment.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with supplier or vendor relationship management
- Experience working with recruiting and people-related tools, CRM systems, and complex spreadsheets
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results, or experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results, or experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Experience in procurement processes including RFPs, contract negotiation, and cost modeling for outsourced services.

descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.

The IPP team designs and builds high-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single-threaded owner for end-to-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.

We are seeking a strategic, experienced Manager, Program Management to lead a team of program managers responsible for the strategy, execution, and cross-organizational integration of Brand Protection programs. This is a hybrid people-leadership and program-delivery role and you will own the performance, growth, and delivery output of your team while individually driving high-impact programs that turn reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention, directly reducing brand abuse for rights owners globally.

This role operates in ambiguous, cross-functional environments where problem definition and strategy are not always predetermined. You will shape the direction of your team's work, define what success looks like, and build the organizational capability to deliver with senior leadership visibility.

This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.


Key job responsibilities
1. Lead and develop a team of program managers, setting clear expectations, providing direct and constructive feedback, and coaching each team member to operate at the top of their level.
2. Build a high-performing team culture centered on ownership, bias for action, and customer obsession fostering an environment where PgMs can tackle ambiguous, high-stakes problems independently.
3. Establish team-level mechanisms (e.g., weekly business reviews, program health checks, retrospectives) that drive operational rigor and continuous improvement.
4. Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high-ambiguity brand protection challenges, owning the most critical and cross-cutting programs.
5. Analyze defect trends, abuse patterns, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs and strengthen Amazon's enforcement posture.
6. Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities at scale.
7. Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space.
8. Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations making trade-off recommendations, surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions, and ensuring your team's programs are integrated into the broader Brand Protection strategy.
9. Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.
10. Build and maintain deep team-level expertise in brand abuse and enforcement strategy, ensuring the team can conduct rigorous deep dives to derive insights about emerging abuse vectors across Amazon's worldwide stores.


About the team
The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.

title: Software Development Manager , Prime Video Live Streaming
descriptionHtml:
Every time a fan tunes in to a live match, a breaking news channel or a global live event on Prime Video, the stream reaches them through systems this team builds. Prime Video's Live Playback organization runs live content streams at scale. It covers live signal acquisition, encoding, packaging, monitoring and playback integration for both Live Events and 24x7 Linear channels. Working with AWS, we're building a cloud-based, end-to-end live streaming platform that delivers high-quality, low-latency video to customers around the world, and we're changing how live TV is delivered compared with traditional broadcast.
We're looking for a strong technical leader for the Live Orchestration team. The team owns tier-1 orchestration workflows that set up, run and tear down complex signal ingestion, encoding and packaging pipelines. Those pipelines power thousands of linear stations and live events worldwide, including 4K, HDR and Atmos experiences. The team also owns Prime Video's real-time monitoring system for live streams. It evaluates billions of health records to detect signal loss and video quality issues and triggers automated mitigations, so streams stay available and high quality when customers are watching.

You'll set the vision for this mission-critical team. A big part of that is leading the build of next-generation, frontier AI agentic systems that can monitor, diagnose, heal and scale live infrastructure on their own as the business grows. This role gives you a rare chance to learn broadcasting technologies and live streaming protocols, work directly with world-class video scientists and Senior Principal Engineers, and shape how AI agents run live video infrastructure at Amazon scale.

The ideal candidate is passionate about simple, elegant solutions to hard distributed-systems problems and is obsessed with the customer. You'll lead with an AI-first mindset. That means using AI wherever it makes sense to change how the team designs, builds, tests and operates software, and to automate the operational work that slows engineers down. You look at problems holistically, beyond the borders of your own team, and you're comfortable working at every level, from strategy and business priorities to system architecture and specific interfaces. You don't shrink from the spotlight. You can run cross-org discussions, handle questions and bring people to good outcomes together. You read code, write clearly for executives, and make sure every system you own is reliable, scalable and secure. Experience with broadcast or live streaming technologies is a plus but not required. If you're a strong distributed-systems leader who's curious about live video, you'll pick up the domain quickly by working alongside our video scientists and Senior Principal Engineers.
You'll be part of the leadership group that dreams up, designs and launches greenfield capabilities for Prime Video's live platform across geographies. In this role, you'll engineer the next generation of intelligent, self-healing live infrastructure that delivers live sports, news and events to millions of customers on every device, every time.

- Own and drive the technical vision and roadmap for the Live Orchestration team's tier-1 orchestration and real-time monitoring platforms
- Lead the design and delivery of AI agentic systems for autonomous detection, diagnosis, remediation and capacity scaling of live infrastructure
- Lead the team in using AI across the software development lifecycle and operations wherever it makes sense, raising engineering velocity and quality

title: ML Kernel Performance Engineer, AWS Neuron, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds AWS Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium.

The Acceleration Kernel Library team is at the forefront of maximizing performance for AWS's custom ML accelerators. Working at the hardware-software boundary, our engineers craft high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every FLOP counts in delivering optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

The AWS Neuron SDK, developed by the Annapurna Labs team at AWS, is the backbone for accelerating deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon's Inferentia and Trainium ML accelerators. This comprehensive toolkit includes an ML compiler, runtime, and application framework that seamlessly integrates with popular ML frameworks like PyTorch, enabling unparalleled ML inference and training performance.

As part of the broader Neuron Compiler organization, our team works across multiple technology layers - from frameworks and compilers to runtime and collectives. We not only optimize current performance but also contribute to future architecture designs, working closely with customers to enable their models and ensure optimal performance. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology

This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge products at the intersection of machine-learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures. You will architect and implement business-critical features, publish cutting-edge research, and mentor a brilliant team of experienced engineers. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators.

Explore the product and our history!

Our kernel engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will:

* Design and implement high-performance compute kernels for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models
* Analyze and optimize kernel-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware
* Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks
* Implement compiler optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling

Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.

Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.
