title: Principal Technical Program Manager, MADS
descriptionHtml:
Every day, advertisers and partners worldwide measure the success of their Amazon Ads campaigns through the data Programmatic Reporting delivers: billions of aggregated datapoints that AI agents, machine learning models, and analytics engines around the world now depend on as AI reshapes how advertising is planned and optimized. The Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) organization at Amazon Ads is looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive the largest, most cross-cutting programs behind that data.

Programmatic Reporting owns Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, the interfaces advertisers and partners worldwide use to consume Amazon Ads measurement data. Behind them sit the pipelines that source, transform, and deliver that data, processing billions of aggregated datapoints on Apache Spark, Apache Iceberg, and AWS. Delivering this data accurately, freshly, and cost-efficiently requires programs that span multiple engineering teams, product management, and partner organizations across several sites and regions.

You take on the programs that don't yet have a shape, where the strategy is still forming, the right sequencing isn't obvious, and what success even looks like has to be defined before anything can be planned. You bring order to that ambiguity across the many engineering, product, science, and partner teams spread over multiple sites and regions, and you build the mechanisms that keep delivery predictable at that scale. The guidance, standards, and operating cadence for how these programs run are yours to shape. You operate with real technical depth: you read the designs, ask the sharp question in an architecture review, and, when the direction is wrong, you challenge the strategy, the architecture, or the way the organization is structured to deliver, and back it with a concrete alternative. You do this as a trusted advisor to the organization's senior leaders: you frame the decision, the tradeoff, and your recommendation for audiences that run from the working team all the way up to the organization's most senior leadership, and you help shape where they invest. And you run programs the way this team builds them: instrumented, automated, agent-assisted. Status, rollups, and dependency tracking largely assemble themselves, freeing your own hours for the judgment calls no tool can make. You influence without authority, and you make the teams around you, and yourself, faster.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end delivery of the largest, most ambiguous cross-team programs across pipelines, query engines, APIs, and data integration, where the plan has to be created, not just followed.
- Partner with senior and principal engineers, product leaders, and senior leadership to shape strategy and roadmap in ambiguous spaces, defining what the plan should be, not just executing it.
- Build and sequence the program (scope, milestones, success criteria), and drive resolution of risks, blockers, and dependencies before they slip delivery.
- Establish the operating mechanisms, increasingly automated and agent-driven, that keep delivery predictable across sites and regions.
- Advise senior leaders on where to invest and on the org-wide mechanisms and structure needed to deliver at scale.
- Frame decisions and recommendations for audiences from the working team up to the most senior leaders, with a clear point of view and the data behind it.
- Drive technical tradeoffs across data freshness, accuracy, cost, and time-to-market, escalating crisply when alignment is needed.
- Coordinate launches and deprecations of reporting interfaces across engineering, GTM, partner, and solutions-architecture teams.
- Grow the next tier of leaders: mentor TPMs and engineers, raise the bar on delivery practice, and contribute to hiring and promotion decisions.

About the team
The Programmatic Reporting team builds the data interfaces that power how advertisers and partners measure their Amazon Ads outcomes. We own Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely data to advertisers and partners worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of data engineering and developer experience, and increasingly extends into GenAI-powered interfaces and data lake integrations.

We move fast, think in systems, and obsess over data quality. This role is a chance to take on challenging delivery problems with real room to build the guidance and mechanisms behind them. The team is based in Toronto and partners with teams across multiple sites.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

title: Security Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems. We are looking for a Security Engineer to join the FDE security team and help secure production AI systems deployed in customer environments.

You will conduct security reviews, write security tooling, perform threat modeling, and implement controls that protect AI systems built by FDE engineers. You work alongside FDE delivery pods in customer environments, getting hands-on with production code, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML pipelines. You learn fast, ship fast, and build security into the system rather than bolting it on after the fact.

This is a hands-on security engineering role where you spend most of your time writing code, reviewing architectures, and testing systems. You work with senior security engineers who will mentor you, but you own real security deliverables from your first engagement. If you want to learn AI security by doing it, in production, at enterprise scale, this is the role.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.


Key job responsibilities
- Conduct security design reviews, code reviews, and architecture assessments for production AI systems (agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, orchestration layers, model integrations) under guidance from senior security engineers
- Perform threat modeling and penetration testing for AI/ML applications deployed in customer environments; identify vulnerabilities and work with FDE engineers to implement fixes before production release
- Build and maintain security automation: scanning tools, CI/CD security gates, guardrail testing scripts, secrets detection, and dependency vulnerability checks for forward-deployed AI systems
- Implement security controls for AI-specific threats: prompt injection prevention, output filtering, data isolation, model API endpoint hardening, and guardrail configuration
- Support security incident response for FDE-delivered production AI systems; assist with triage, root cause analysis, and remediation under senior engineer guidance
- Document security findings, patterns, and remediation guidance as reusable playbooks and runbooks that benefit future FDE engagements
- Contribute to the FDE security accelerator library: reusable modules, templates, and reference configurations that help FDE engineers build secure AI systems faster
- Requires up to 25% travel

A day in the life
You start the morning running your automated security scan against a new Bedrock-powered application an FDE pod shipped overnight, triaging the findings and filing issues for two real vulnerabilities. Mid-morning you pair with an FDE engineer to fix an IAM policy that's overly permissive for their multi-agent orchestration system. After lunch you're writing a Python script that automates guardrail bypass testing for the team's standard deployment pattern. You close out the day joining a threat modeling session led by a senior security engineer, where you learn how to assess data flow risks in a customer's RAG pipeline. Every week you're working on a different AI architecture, building skills you can't get anywhere else.

About the team
AWS Forward Deployed Engineering embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to build production AI systems. AWS invested $1B in this initiative. We move at the speed of the customer: demonstrating ROI in weeks, not quarters. We are customer-obsessed. We lead customers toward outcomes, build together, and leave behind scalable patterns. Security is our enabling function: without it, nothing goes to production. Our culture is people-first, anti-burnout, bold, and engineering-excellence-driven.

ABOUT AWS:
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. title: Technicien d’exploitation de centre de données (ETO) / Engineering and Operations Technician (EOT), DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Technicien d’exploitation de centres de données (ETO)

Description du poste:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est en forte croissance et est à la recherche d’un technicien d’exploitation de centre de données pour rejoindre son équipe d’exploitation des infrastructures de centre de données en pleine expansion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) est une entreprise de technologie très dynamique et leader mondial dans le domaine des centres de données. Le technicien d’exploitation de centres de données est responsable des entretiens des équipements électriques, mécaniques et de protection incendie dans le centre de données. Le technicien d’exploitation de centres de données sert de personne-ressource technique auprès d’Amazon dans ses centres de données. Les équipements du centre de données qui supportent les serveurs critiques doivent être opérationnels 99.9 999 % du temps. Le technicien d’exploitation de centres de données a également la responsabilité de réduire les coûts d’exploitation des installations grâce à des solutions innovatrices. Le technicien d’exploitation de centres de données est le premier intervenant dans les cas de problèmes électriques et mécaniques touchant la disponibilité des services Amazon. Ces équipements comprennent, sans toutefois s’y limiter, les génératrices de secours et les systèmes de carburant connexes, les armoires de distribution électrique et de commutation, les systèmes d’alimentation sans coupure (UPS), les panneaux de distribution électrique (PDU), les unités de ventilation et de climatisation (AHU, CRAH, CRAC), les pompes, les moteurs, les variateurs de fréquence (VFD) et les systèmes immotiques.

Ce poste exige que le candidat sélectionné obtienne et conserve une cote de sécurité active du statut de fiabilité auprès du gouvernement du Canada.


Engineering and Operations Technician (EOT)

Job Description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for an Engineering and Operations Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a fast paced technology company and a leader in the world of data centers. The Engineering and Operations Technician is responsible for overseeing the maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. The Engineering and Operations Technician serves as a technical resource to support Amazon within its data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. Engineering and Operations Technician’s are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities. Engineering and Operations Technician’s are Amazon’s front line respondents for electrical and mechanical issued affecting Amazon's availability. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, switchboards/switch-gears, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, CRAHUs, CRAC's, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

This position requires that the candidate selected obtain and maintain an active Reliability Status security clearance with the Government of Canada.



Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

• Agir à titre de principal point de contact d’affaires avec les équipes techniques et d’installations du fournisseur de colocation afin de répondre aux besoins opérationnels quotidiens au sein de la zone de disponibilité (AZ);
• Superviser les fournisseurs de colocation sur site ainsi que leurs entrepreneurs afin de s’assurer que tous les travaux effectués respectent les pratiques établies, les procédures en vigueur et la législation locale;
• Gérer les fournisseurs de colocation pour assurer l’entretien préventif et correctif, ainsi que la réponse aux situations d’urgence touchant les systèmes critiques, incluant les appareillages de commutation, les génératrices, les systèmes UPS, les équipements de distribution électrique, les refroidisseurs (chillers), les tours de refroidissement, les unités de traitement d’air des salles informatiques (CRAH), les systèmes de surveillance du bâtiment, etc.;
• Créer et gérer les demandes de gestion de changements ainsi que les billets de gestion d’incidents pour les installations du centre de données;
• Assurer une disponibilité sur appel à l’extérieur des heures de bureau et intervenir rapidement lors de situations d’urgence ou d’incidents (pannes électriques, catastrophes naturelles, etc.), et réviser les procédures d’opérations d’urgence afin d’en améliorer l’efficacité;
• Collaborer étroitement avec le fournisseur de colocation et les entrepreneurs afin de résoudre les enjeux d’ingénierie d’infrastructure et réaliser des analyses de causes fondamentales lors d’incidents opérationnels;
• Élaborer et maintenir une documentation complète en anglais relative aux opérations d’affaires et d’installations, en partenariat avec le fournisseur de colocation;
• Identifier et recommander de façon continue des améliorations visant à accroître la sécurité, la sûreté et la disponibilité du centre de données;
• Maintenir un inventaire exact et à jour de l’infrastructure du centre de données au moyen des matrices et tableaux de bord internes;
• Prendre en charge l’installation des baies (racks) et effectuer les évaluations d’espace, de capacité électrique et de refroidissement;
• Diriger les projets de nouvelles constructions et d’expansion afin d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle, incluant les phases de conception, d’implantation et de mise en service;
• Participer aux processus de recrutement internes, incluant la conduite d’entrevues et le soutien à l’intégration des nouveaux employés.

---

Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the primary business interface with the Colocation provider’s technical and facility teams to address day-to-day operational requirements within the Availability Zone (AZ);
• Supervise the on-site Colocation providers and respective contractors, to ensure all works performed is complied with established practices, procedures & local legislation;
• Manage Colocation suppliers to conduct routine maintenance, and respond to emergency services for critical systems including switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.;
• Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for Data Center facility;
• Engage in non-office on-call responsibilities and respond promptly to emergency situations or incident, such as power failures or natural disasters, and review to refine the established Emergency Operations Procedures to effectively handle these situations;
• Deeply involve with Colocation provider and contractors to resolve infrastructure engineering issues and conduct root cause analysis for operational issues;
• Establish comprehensive English documentation to business & facility operations in partnership with the Colocation provider;
• Constantly explore and recommend improvements to enhance the data center safety, security and availability;
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Data Center infrastructure inventory through related matrices and internal dashboards
• Take charge of the installation of the racks and conduct the rack space, power/cooling assessment;
• Lead new build and expansion projects to improve the operations efficiency, including the design, implementation, and commissioning phases;
• Assist in internal recruitment including conducting interviews and assisting with onboarding.

Basic qualifications

- Connaissance des systèmes électriques utilisés dans les opérations critiques de centres de données, incluant notamment, sans s’y limiter : les alimentations provenant de postes électriques (utility), les transformateurs, les appareillages de commutation (switchgear), les systèmes UPS de classe VFI, les DRUPS, les unités de distribution d’alimentation (PDU), les commutateurs de transfert automatique (ATS), les commutateurs de transfert statique (STS), les batteries SLA/VRLA et leurs systèmes connexes, les génératrices diesel ou à turbine à gaz ainsi que leurs systèmes d’alimentation en carburant, les dispositifs de protection contre les surtensions, les systèmes de filtration harmonique active, les systèmes de surveillance des batteries, les systèmes de surveillance des circuits dérivés (branch circuit monitoring) ou les systèmes SCADA.
- Minimum de 3 ans d’expérience pertinente en gestion d’installations, ainsi qu’en exploitation et en maintenance d’équipements d’infrastructure au sein d’installations critiques telles que des centres de données, des usines d’exploitation, des postes électriques, des hôpitaux, etc.; expérience en gestion d’incidents majeurs liés aux installations.
- Puisque ce rôle nécessite que l’employé interagisse avec d’autres entités d’Amazon à l’échelle mondiale ainsi qu’avec des employés et intervenants dans d’autres provinces canadiennes, la connaissance du français et de l’anglais est exigée pour ce poste. .
- - ***************************************************
- Knowledge of electrical systems in critical Data Center operations that include but are not limited to utility substation feeds, transformers, switchgear, VFI Class UPS, DRUPS, PDUs, ATS, STS, SLA/VRLA batteries and associated systems, diesel/gas turbine generators and related fuel systems, Surge Suppression, Active Harmonic Filtering, battery monitoring systems, branch circuit monitoring systems or SCADA systems.
- Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience with facility management, and operating and maintaining infrastructure equipment in critical facilities such as data centers, operation factories, substations, hospitals, etc.; experience in major facilities incident management.
- Due to the nature of the role that requires interaction with other Amazon entities globally and with Amazon employees and stakeholders in other provinces in Canada, bilingualism French and English is required for this position

Preferred qualifications

- Excellente attitude de travail et forte volonté d’apprendre, avec un grand souci du détail et de la précision; solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et grande capacité à travailler de façon autonome et à faire preuve d’initiative, tout en étant un joueur d’équipe collaboratif capable de travailler efficacement avec les autres / Good work attitude and eagerness to learn, with deep attention to details and accuracy; also possess strong problem-solving skills and strong ability to work independently and take initiative, while also being a collaborative team player who can work effectively with others
- Baccalauréat en génie électrique, en génie mécanique ou dans un domaine connexe / Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

title: Regional HR Manager, SSD-FC
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Manager is a key strategic partner on the SSD-FC PXT team, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, culture, and change management. This role balances tactical excellence with strategic insight, leveraging both technology and human judgment to align local leadership, centralized support, and systems in delivering high-quality employee experiences.

You will drive operational excellence through strategic leadership at your site(s), translating priorities into actionable plans while leveraging technology and data to enhance decision-making. Leading a diverse team of HR professionals, you'll balance automation with human insight to drive excellence throughout the employee lifecycle. Success demands operational excellence, leadership presence, and the ability to connect strategic vision to execution.

The HR Manager leads and is responsible for operational excellence and organizational health through strategic PXT leadership and effective people management. They strengthen culture and deliver business results by translating organizational priorities into actionable plans through their site’s PXT function. HR Managers execute business goals through hands-on leadership and data-driven decision making, while partnering with business leaders to improve leadership effectiveness and employee experience.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility, ensuring personal connection and hands-on leadership where needed.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead a diverse team of HR professionals with varying levels of experience to drive operational excellence through high-judgment decisions, risk mitigation, and employee experience enhancement. Guide your team in ensuring practices comply with company policies, procedures, and federal, state, and provincial laws or regulations, while fostering their professional growth and expertise.

- Partner with Business Leader(s) to strengthen culture and deliver business results. Create an environment where employees feel safe, valued, and respected through data-driven workforce solutions and effective people management practices.

- Drive talent management and development across all levels, establishing mechanisms for equitable selection, retention, and performance optimization. Coach leaders to build high-performing teams and address performance gaps effectively.

- Monitor employee sentiment through regular floor presence, data analysis, and feedback mechanisms. Hold leaders accountable for delivering positive employee experiences and implement targeted action plans to strengthen culture.

- Champion organizational change through effective stakeholder management and change leadership. Engage teams regularly, remove adoption barriers, and model positive behaviors while maintaining strong partnerships across functions.

- Drive adoption and optimization of HR technology solutions to enhance efficiency, data accuracy, and employee experience. Lead the HR team in developing digital fluency, leveraging analytics for decision-making, and utilizing AI to streamline processes while maintaining a human-centered approach.

- Own end-to-end PXT operational excellence through rigorous process execution, structured inspection routines, and effective use of tools and data. Ensure consistent documentation standards and timely issue resolution while escalating systemic concerns appropriately.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic leadership and hands-on people management, requiring excellent organizational and interpersonal skills to manage multiple priorities. You'll regularly engage with teams on the production floor while responding to time-sensitive matters such as employee concerns and investigations.

Using cutting-edge AI-powered analytics and data insights, you'll identify trends and opportunities in areas like attrition, attendance, and engagement. You'll collaborate closely with business leaders, providing strategic guidance while maintaining strong relationships across all levels of the organization. Through these partnerships, you'll drive initiatives that enhance employee experience and strengthen cultural health.

From coaching leadership teams to implementing innovative HR technologies, you'll balance technical expertise with human judgment in complex situations. In this fast-paced environment, you'll have the opportunity to create sustainable improvements and meaningful impact across your site and broader organization, helping build a workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to perform at their best.

About the team
Sub-Same Day Fulfillment Centers (SSD-FC) are an integral part of meeting Amazon’s customer promise through Prime same-day delivery. In tandem with its Rapid and Rural Logistics business parallels, these locations strive to serve over 80% of Prime customer demands across North America. – And with people at the heart of it all, our commitment to provide HR functional excellence continues and grows.

Known as People, Experience and Technology (PXT) , our HR team members are present onsite to help drive tactical leadership direction, while providing top-notch internal customer support. PXT teams are flexible, thoughtful, socially responsible, and are always planning for the future.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- 5+ years of human resources leadership, or 5+ years of leadership in operations, customer service, retail, distribution, shipping/logistics, healthcare, hospitality, or manufacturing experience
- Experience implementing data-driven workforce solutions and HR metrics
- Experience supporting or leading employee-focused processes including onboarding, benefits, investigations, training or talent management

Preferred qualifications

- Master's Degree or MBA

title: Software Dev Engineer, AWS Elastic Container Service
descriptionHtml:
AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS) is forming a new team in Seattle with a bold mission: dramatically reduce the time it takes for containerized workloads to become ready to run on Fargate. The vast majority of customer tasks are short-lived, making launch speed one of the most impactful levers for customer experience — and we're going after a step-function improvement.

As an SDE on the Workload Optimization team, you'll work at the intersection of container runtimes, operating systems, and networking to optimize the end-to-end launch path. This is deep systems work with direct, measurable customer impact at enormous scale.


Key job responsibilities
- Build and optimize container startup and runtime systems using Linux kernel, containerd/runc, and Bottlerocket
- Design and implement solutions across the container networking and instance preparation stack
- Work on one of the highest-scale container orchestration platforms in the world
- Join a founding team with greenfield ownership and the opportunity to shape technical direction from day one

About the team
Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) makes it easy for customers to run, scale, and secure containerized applications on AWS. ECS powers some of the most demanding workloads on the planet — from startups launching their first container to enterprises running millions of tasks across global infrastructure.

The Workload Optimization team is a brand-new team within ECS, based in Seattle, with a focused mission: fundamentally reduce the time it takes for a containerized workload to become ready to run on AWS Fargate. For the vast majority of Fargate customers, launch latency is one of the biggest factors in their end-to-end experience — and we believe a step-function improvement is achievable.

This is a greenfield team, which means you won't be inheriting legacy systems or processes — you'll be building from scratch. You'll work deep in the systems stack (Linux kernel, container runtimes, OS, networking) alongside a small, senior group of engineers who care deeply about performance, correctness, and customer impact at scale.

We value engineers who think from first principles, are comfortable with ambiguity, and are energized by hard problems that don't have obvious solutions. Our culture is direct, low-ceremony, and high-ownership — you'll have real influence over what we build and how we build it from day one.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Technical Writer, Veeqo
descriptionHtml:
The Technical Writer owns the complete documentation lifecycle for a product-led support function, managing help guides, internal SOPs, wiki resources, and in-app communications. This role sits at the intersection of content strategy and AI-powered support, where documentation quality directly drives ticket deflection and customer self-service success. The Technical Writer collaborates cross-functionally with product, engineering, support and other teams to ensure accurate, customer-centric content across all touch points.

Key job responsibilities
- Create, maintain, and optimise customer-facing help guides that power an AI support bot, directly influencing ticket deflection rates and customer resolution metrics
- Develop comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures by partnering with support agents and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring consistent tone and technical accuracy across all internal documentation
- Support product launches across the complexity spectrum by producing documentation from scratch or updating existing guides based on feature scope
- Manage documentation lifecycle through systematic content tagging, regular reviews, and proactive maintenance frameworks
- Test, adjust, and monitor in-app experiments including welcome messages, user workflows, and customer messaging to maximise AI engagement and effectiveness
- Facilitate discussions between external partner teams and internal product teams to identify process gaps and improve customer experience
- Challenge existing processes that compromise the customer experience and propose modifications aligned with organisational standards
- Maintain expertise in support tooling features and product launches to leverage the most impactful content delivery approaches

A day in the life
This role blends analytical, creative, and collaborative work throughout the day. You'll review AI support bot performance metrics to identify content gaps, then pivot to building or refining documentation based on what's driving unresolved customer queries. Cross-functional meetings with product, and engineering teams are a regular feature—you'll drive alignment on process changes, present recommendations to senior leaders, and advocate for the customer experience.

On the content creation side, you'll conduct intake conversations with subject matter experts, draft SOPs and help guides, and shepherd them through review before publishing to both customer-facing and agent-facing AI systems. You'll also run in-app messaging experiments, adjust engagement flows based on data, and manage your content lifecycle backlog—flagging guides due for refresh and planning upcoming documentation work.

No two days look the same; you might spend one day deep in writing and another facilitating stakeholder discussions or analysing bot resolution data to inform your next content priority.

About the team
Veeqo is Amazon's multi-channel shipping and inventory platform, purpose-built for fast-growth e-commerce businesses. Since joining the Amazon family in 2021, Veeqo has helped thousands of online retailers cut shipping costs, streamline fulfilment, and scale with confidence. Our Swansea team sits at the heart of that mission — and this role puts you right at the centre of it.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as a technical editor or writer of technical documentation working with style guides

Preferred qualifications

- Minimum 2 years Experience as a technical editor or writer of technical documentation working with style guides

title: Senior Firmware Engineer, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction.

If you’re passionate about actuation and robotics systems, and have a strong interest in safety and performance, then we’d like to talk to you about becoming part of an organization with global impact on millions of customers.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the architectural design of complex control systems end to end, partnering with peers and adjacent teams to drive innovative solutions to the hardest problems.
• Take full, uncompromising ownership of the firmware development lifecycle, from concept through field deployment, and stand behind the results you ship.
• Lead functional and safety requirements elicitation, moving quickly and decisively to unlock maximum system performance for our customers.
• Drive system bring-up, root cause analysis, and systematic troubleshooting with a bias for action, resolving issues at the source rather than the symptom.
• Deliver high-impact feedback in peer reviews and communicate crisply and candidly with technical leadership.
• Engineer solutions that strike an uncompromising balance between top-tier performance and reliability, and relentlessly raise the bar on both.
• Own stakeholder communication and technical reporting, keeping the right people informed and aligned.
• Drive system commissioning and field deployment, taking accountability for results in real-world conditions.

A day in the life
As a Senior Firmware Engineer, you will partner with cross-functional teams to design, build, test, and debug complex, cutting-edge robotic systems, and you will own the outcome from the first design sketch to live field deployment. No two days look the same, and every one moves fast. You lead and shape design discussions, brainstorm bold new approaches to the hardest problems in robotics, and turn ambitious product concepts into firmware that ships. You act with urgency and sound judgment, making the calls that keep the team moving without ever compromising quality or safety. When it is time to prove the work, you write automated tests that validate new features and run live testing to debug and root cause issues at the source, staying accountable until the system performs, holds up under real-world conditions, and delivers for our customers. You do not wait to be asked, you see what needs to happen and you make it happen.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of professional experience delivering production embedded firmware for motor control systems
- A proven record of owning the full software development lifecycle end to end in robotics or industrial automation, and being accountable for the outcomes
- Expert-level command of software architecture design and C/C++ development for resource-constrained embedded systems
- Deep, hands-on proficiency with ARM architecture, processor peripherals (timers, PWM, ADC, communication interfaces), standard interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN), and industrial communication protocols (EtherCAT)
- Extensive, production-grade experience with real-time operating systems such as FreeRTOS
- Authoritative expertise in Field-Oriented Control (FOC) and advanced motor control strategies
- Hands-on experience with power electronics, schematic reading, and close collaboration with hardware engineers
- A demonstrated track record as a mentor, tech lead, or engineering team lead who raises the bar for those around them

Preferred qualifications

- Solid working knowledge of IEC 61508 (Functional Safety of Electrical/Electronic Systems), with a practical grasp of Safety Integrity Levels (SIL) and the full safety lifecycle
- A firm foundation in cybersecurity principles and standards for embedded systems
- Working knowledge of bootloaders and firmware update mechanisms
- Practical familiarity with robotic control systems architecture
- Applied experience with model-based development and code generation (MATLAB/Simulink)
- Hands-on exposure to continuous integration and automated testing

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Transportation Specialist, Amazon Intermodal (AZIM)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Intermodal (AZIM) Operations team is seeking highly skilled and motivated Transportation Specialists to join this rapidly growing team. AZIM Operations drives the end to end operational execution of all loads (internal and external) shipped on our 1P network. The team supports regions and shippers across the Supply Chain network and is tasked with ensuring on-time pickup and delivery of freight from vendors, Amazon fulfillment centers (FCs), rail yards and shipper hubs. In the case of disruptions, the Operations team is responsible for addressing the disruption, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring timely resolution of the issue. The AZIM Operations team is the first line of defense in understanding network trends, delays, dwells and other exceptions that impact AZIM’s ability to deliver a world class transportation product that serves its customers on time.

An ideal candidate has a background in customer service/call center, transportation, and/or supply chain environments. Additionally, a passion for quickly providing solutions and resolution to challenges by using strong communication, problem solving and organizational skills is a must. Successful candidates will enjoy working in a fast-pace, high-volume call center environment with a lot of growth opportunity. They will thrive on accountability to themselves, team, carriers/drivers and work schedules!

Key job responsibilities
-Deliver excellent carrier and driver experience/solutions, in a high-volume contact center environment, through researching, problem-solving, setting appropriate expectations and working within the Amazon Transportation network to get trailers/trucks back on track when disruptions occur
- Work in fast-paced environment, and adhere to schedules: start/stop, and breaks/lunches
- Support workload surges and/or weather-related operations as needed to include working significant overtime during designated high-volume peaks
- Use internal systems to gather data from multiple sources to support reporting on a daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly basis
- Provide support to field teams and partners by creating repair requests, monitoring load execution, ensuring on-time pickup and delivery metrics
- Work with cross-functional teams. Use analytical skills to drive data-driven decision, and effectively communicate insights to others across Transportation Operations Management, Amazon Freight Shippers, rail partners, Carriers, and Fleet
- Provide support to drivers and carriers with over the road disruptions

Your calls will be monitored and recorded for training and compliance purposes.

A day in the life
The AZIM Transportation Operations Specialist facilitates the continued flow of Amazon’s supply chain by passing information to key stakeholders and resolving disruptions that impact customer experience or the flow of information impacting performance and delivery. The Specialist addresses or escalates any concerns arising during the lifecycle of freight leaving rail ramps, shipper hubs, Amazon fulfillment centers, or transiting between rail to OTR carriers. The day-to day role requires the specialist to provide resolutions by researching and querying internal tools and making real-time decisions in accordance with their guidance and standard work processes. In this role, the Transportation Operations Specialist will be able to understand the process and requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. This position will need to have the experience to understand Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Are 18 years of age or older

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel) experience

title: Sr. Fire Protection Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you dream of working in a role where your talent with Fire Protection and next-generation data center design can be merged? Do you want to expand your current knowledge of building systems while providing input from your previous experience? Have you ever wondered what it is like to be able to influence construction on a global scale? YES! Then keep reading….

In this role you will influence all aspects of fire protection design, construction, operations, and maintenance for our global fleet of data centers. This includes fire suppression, fire detection, fire alarm, and mass notification systems, as well as fire-resistant construction and life safety. You will work with internal and external teams to define, design, detail, and document the various fire protection features that our facilities require, using both prescriptive and performance-based design approaches. As an Owner, you will strive to ensure the fire protection features of our buildings protect our people and keep our customer’s data safe and uninterrupted over the life of the building. We expect you to contribute your expertise to the continual improvement of our fire protection design standards.

Primary responsibilities will be to perform and oversee project-related work, such as water supply analysis and design for fire water service to buildings, including coordination with utilities and fire officials to establish basic site infrastructure requirements. The ability to coordinate fire protection system space requirements, supporting utilities, and equipment locations, and to provide detailed construction specifications for all fire protection-related trades will be expected. You will typically be responsible for the preparation of prescriptive designs for building fire suppression, alarm, and detection systems. In some cases, you will be expected to prepare or approve performance-based design elements as needed to support our goals. You will review all design disciplines to ensure they meet the minimum fire protection requirements described in our design standards. In some cases, you will oversee and review this work and in other cases you will perform the work yourself.

As the team’s subject matter expert, you will ensure that contractors have the information they need to build our data centers the way we expect them to, and that our operations teams are well equipped to operate and maintain them as needed to meet our goals. As part of this role you will work with internal and external stakeholders, including design, construction, commissioning, operations, vendors, and other service providers, as well as local building and fire officials. You will be part of a global team, and you will be an integral part of our work to change the world through technology.

Key job responsibilities
• Driving improvement of design standards and project approaches across the organization.
• Work with third party design vendors to review concept designs and designs in progress to ensure they meet established design standards, local code requirements, and any other requirements of the Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs).
• Be responsible for providing high quality fire protection engineering advice on a wide variety of projects globally while working with global fire protection engineering teams to achieve alignment of designs and design objectives.
• Coordinating with construction, commissioning, and risk management teams to answer requests for information and value engineering queries.
• Be responsible for construction documents, code compliance, design and installation standards, water supply evaluation and assessment, testing, inspections, and submittal review. Meet with AHJs as needed to ensure approval of fire protection features.
• This position will require up to 25% travel.

About the team
The Data Center Design Engineering team at Amazon Web Services consists of Architects, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Fire Protection and Controls Engineers working to design the next generation of Data Centers. The team is committed to achieving a world-class uptime for our customers and strives to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, and efficiency, while finding new ways to meet our growing demand. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make directly to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs. As an integral member of the team, you will have the opportunity to directly impact our business and create positive change.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

- 6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Experience applying local codes, National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards, International Code Council (ICC) requirements, and other fire protection industry standards, procedures, and methodologies

title: Security Engineer II, Amazon GuardDuty
descriptionHtml:
Amazon GuardDuty is a customer facing threat detection service that was built to protect applications and services running in AWS. The service processes trillions of events and applies advanced analytics and machine learning to detect threats. If you are interested in learning about operating a service at massive scale and working alongside world class engineers, then this role is for you.

The Security Engineer position will be working on Amazon GuardDuty, which is a managed threat detection service that continuously monitors for malicious or unauthorized behavior to help you protect your AWS accounts and workloads. It monitors for activity such as unusual API calls or potentially unauthorized deployments that indicate a possible account compromise. GuardDuty also detects potentially compromised instances or reconnaissance by attackers. This is an advanced engineering team that is using cutting edge techniques to help customers assess, monitor and protect their cloud based resources. We are looking for an experienced security engineer with red team penetration testing skills to join this team to research, tune and validate our detection mechanisms.

A successful candidate for this role will have a deep understanding of both information security and computer science. If you can exploit at scale while remaining stealthy, identify and exploit misconfigurations in network resources, develop out of the box techniques, and communicate complex info in a digestible manner, you could be an ideal candidate.

The scope of this role includes researching attack patterns, building attack simulations, active testing, and mentoring data scientists and software engineers. In this role, you will interface with many internal security teams to keep up to date with the latest attack techniques.


Key job responsibilities
As a Security Engineer, you’ll:

- Recognize and safely utilize attacker tools, tactics and procedures
- Develop scripts, tools or methodologies to enhance red team capabilities
- Work with data scientists to help develop and test detections for complex exploitation patterns
- Build simulations to validate tools and techniques

- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics), or 2+ years of IT Security experience

descriptionHtml:

This is a senior- level individual contributor role within the AWS Specialists & Partners (ASP) Customer Success Center of Excellence, requiring a combination of executive-level strategic vision and practical credibility to help customers fundamentally reimagine their business processes using AI.

Amazon Quick is AWS's enterprise AI platform that enables organizations to transform how work gets done, from knowledge management and research to decision-making and operational workflows. This role focuses on helping customers move beyond AI experimentation to systematic business process reinvention at enterprise scale.
You will define the methodologies, frameworks, and repeatable models that shape how AWS and its customers approach AI-powered business planning, execution, and operation transformation. Your work will directly influence product roadmaps, partner ecosystems, and go-to-market strategies, creating lasting organizational and market impact across hundreds of enterprises globally.


Key job responsibilities
Strategic Customer Transformation

Offering Development & Scaling

- Synthesize learnings from customer engagements into documented playbooks, best practices, and success patterns that inform AWS product roadmap and GTM strategy.

title: Sr System Development Engineer, Mfg Bring Up and Test, AWS Mainstream Compute
descriptionHtml:
External Job Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Hardware Engineering team creates compute and storage server designs for Amazon's web services. Our engineers work with leading edge technologies, solve challenging problems, influence the industry's roadmaps, and develop new and unique solutions that are ahead of the pack. We work in an environment that fosters innovation and creativity. We encourage and invest in new directions and new ideas that will serve our customers better. We sometimes fail, but we learn from such failures and we improve. It is because of the team and our constant focus on the customers, that we are able to develop creative and new designs that set the standards on performance, quality, cost, and operational excellence.

We are looking for a Sr System Development Engineer, Mfg Bring Up and Test to drive manufacturing test excellence across our global server and rack production network.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end manufacturing test strategy for new product introductions — from early design engagement through production ramp and yield optimization. As a technical leader, you will solve complex test architecture challenges at the intersection of hardware design, firmware, and manufacturing operations, ensuring that every server and rack we produce meets the highest quality bar before reaching our data centers.


Key job responsibilities
The Sr System Development Engineer, Mfg Bring Up and Test owns the end-to-end manufacturing test strategy and execution for server and rack systems across all contract manufacturer sites, from early product design through volume production. Key responsibilities include:

- Drive testability requirements and lead design-for-test (DFT) reviews from the earliest design stages to optimize hardware for efficient manufacturing validation, debug, and serviceability.
- Develop and standardize comprehensive test strategies spanning board-, server-, and rack-level validation across all critical subsystems (compute, memory, networking, power, and storage), enforcing consistency across all production sites globally.
- Architect and deploy the complete manufacturing test infrastructure and automated test flows at factory sites — including network configurations, boot environments, test fixtures, and provisioning systems — to ensure production readiness ahead of volume ramp.
- Drive test automation and telemetry to reduce manual intervention, accelerate feedback loops, and achieve significant test-time reductions through risk-based testing and optimized sequencing.
- Apply a rigorous change management process — validating in lab environments, qualifying at factory sites, and deploying in a controlled, traceable manner to prevent regressions.
- Lead manufacturing test failure triage and yield improvement during New Product Introduction (NPI), applying structured root cause analysis and corrective actions to achieve first-pass yield targets.
- Establish data-driven boundaries between manufacturing and post-deployment validation to balance cost, cycle time, and defect escape risk.
- Drive capacity analysis across test positions, yield projections, and equipment utilization during production ramp to ensure throughput aligns with production targets.
- Serve as the key technical liaison between internal engineering teams and external manufacturing partners, aligning on build schedules, design changes, and production readiness.


A day in the life
As a Sr System Development Engineer, Mfg Bring Up and Test, no two days are the same. On any given day, you might be leading a design-for-test (DFT) review with hardware engineers to ensure testability is built into products from the earliest design stage, or architecting test strategies that span board-, server-, and rack-level validation across compute, memory, GPU, networking, power, and storage subsystems. You'll develop and deploy automated test flows and infrastructure at contract manufacturer sites — optimizing test sequencing and building telemetry to accelerate feedback loops. During production, you'll lead structured root cause analysis and drive yield improvements through data-driven corrective actions. You'll collaborate across cross-functional teams and global manufacturing partners to ensure every platform is production-ready ahead of volume ramp.

About the team
The team consists of Hardware Design Engineers, System Design Engineers, Software Development Engineers, Manufacturing Engineers, and Technical Program Managers. Our Manufacturing Test Engineer sits at the critical intersection of product design and volume production. We own the systems and processes that validate every piece of hardware AWS deploys, spanning compute, AI/GPU, networking, and storage platforms across Intel, AMD, ARM and Accelerated/GPU architectures. We are builders who thrive on solving complex problems across hardware, firmware, and software domains, and we measure our success by the quality and efficiency of our global manufacturing operations.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby experience
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 5+ years of experience in manufacturing test engineering, system validation, or production test development.
- Experience with server- or rack-level hardware testing and validation in a data center, Original Design Manufacturer (ODM), or contract manufacturer environment.
- Experience designing or architecting test systems, test infrastructure, or manufacturing validation frameworks.
- Experience deploying and operating in Linux/Unix environments.
- Experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives with external manufacturing partners.
- Experience with test coverage analysis, yield improvement, and root cause investigation methodologies.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with system-level burn-in testing, subsystem validation (CPU/memory/PCIe/power), or hardware validation at scale.
- Experience with rack-level integration testing and connectivity validation.
- Knowledge of board-level testing (ICT, BFT, functional test) and server-level validation flows.
- Experience with test automation frameworks and automated test deployment pipelines for manufacturing test.
- Experience with fault injection testing and test coverage effectiveness analysis.
- Experience with BOM validation, firmware programming, or hardware telemetry configuration.
- Knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), PFMEA, and first-pass yield improvement methodologies.
- Experience with test fixture design, validation, and correlation studies.
- Familiarity with ARM-based and x86 server platforms.
- Experience with test change management processes and controlled deployment across multiple production sites.

title: Sr. RF Ground Systems Engineer, Leo Ground Systems
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

Have you ever wanted to develop aerospace grade ground stations and related products for a high-performance satellite constellation? We are looking for a Ground Systems Engineer to participate in the technical definition, architecture, development, integration, test, qualification, production, and deployment of Leo ground systems with full lifecycle ownership. These systems include state of the art, physically remote, high reliability, aerospace grade full motion tracking antennas, modems, and innovative supporting systems that directly impact the end-to-end ground-space link performance.

Key job responsibilities
- Define, develop, and provide Radio Frequency (RF) technical oversight for integrated ground station products and solutions for gateways and tracking, telemetry, and control systems, working with both internal teams and suppliers.
- Develop solutions to demanding design problems enabling Amazon to fully realize aerospace grade, high reliability ground station Leo connectivity products.
- Support conducting in-depth design reviews including preparing design review documentation and artifacts, and reviewing design materials.
- Develop RF architecture, specifications, requirements, and designs and perform analyses, prepare documentation, and conduct presentations for parabolic LEO tracking TT&C and Gateway Terminal systems.
- Possess Subject Matter Expertise in developing RF hardware equipment and modem products for integration into Ground Gateway and TT&C terminals.
- Assist development of qualification, verification and validation plans and philosophies to ensure our physically remote products meet rigorous technical, functional, performance, reliability, and business requirements across teams and suppliers
- Assist in the development of gateway monitoring and control systems and methodologies, including operational and fault management plans and on-site commissioning methodologies.
- Support identification and analysis of operational faults and performance metrics and trends.
- Perform root cause analysis and anomaly resolution on highly complex system issues.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
In this role as Sr Ground Systems Engineer, you will be actively engaged in developing Amazon Leo’s Ground Gateway terminal products. These products enable space-ground mission critical, high throughput communications with Leo satellites. You will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary, mutli-domain team to develop, test, qualify, produce, and globally deploy solutions and products enabling Leo’s global network.

About the team
The Ground Systems team is responsible for the architecture, design, build, and installation of Kuiper’s Ground and TT&C Gateways. Our Ground Gateways enable high data rate, low latency communications between Kuiper points of presence (PoP) and our Low Earth Orbit Satellite constellation. TT&C Gateways support satellite Launch and Early Orbit enabling command and control of the satellites during this critical phase. The team works closely with the Networks, Regulatory, Payload Test, and RF Hardware teams to ensure Leo provides a seamless customer experience.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
- Minimum of 8 years of system engineering experience in development and delivery of satellite communications systems.
- RF systems experience, preferably with ground tracking antennas and systems.
- Experience in RF product design, and/or integration and test as related to antenna systems and their associated ancillary equipment.
- In-depth understanding of satellite communications link budgets.
- Experience supporting Systems Engineering of ground systems development efforts including meeting cost, schedule, and performance goals.
- General computer hardware and software proficiency.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in development and operation of full motion ground gateways and/or TT&C systems.
- Experience in writing and managing RF system and subsystem requirements, including definition and traceability.
- Experience in defining and documenting RF hardware and software and interfaces, between systems and subsystems.
- Experience working with external custom product suppliers
- Experience with satellite modems and satellite ground system integration from RF to Network.
- Minimum of 5 years’ experience in development of LEO/MEO systems.
- Experience in monitoring and controlling operational satellite ground systems, including fault and performance management.
- Experience with satellite communications spectrum monitoring systems and software.
- Experience with analysis and scripting tools such as MATLAB, Python, STK, or Visualyse
- Experience in V-Band and E-Band RF systems.

title: Specialist ProServe Cloud Architect (SC & MFG), Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) HCLS
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced technology leader to serve as a Specialist ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. This is a role requiring deep expertise in Supply Chain & Manufacturing (SC&MFG) — spanning both Manufacturing (manufacturing execution, process control, quality systems, CMC orchestration) and Supply Chain (planning, logistics, procurement, distribution) — and the ability to flex across both domains. The role focuses on Industrial IoT (IIoT), data foundation, and intelligent-automation architectures that unlock manufacturing and supply chain data for AI-native workflows, powered by AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI.

In this position, you'll serve as both a deep domain expert and a hands-on solution architect, counseling senior executives at the world's leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies on designing AI-driven transformation programs that span the manufacturing-to-supply-chain continuum — e.g., IIoT and edge data architectures, manufacturing data lake and digital twin solutions, MES/MOM modernization, CMC orchestration platforms, and agentic supply chain planning. You'll develop innovative go-to-market (GTM) strategies and perspectives on how AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI unlock value from the shop floor to the distribution network, creating repeatable solutions and accelerators that scale across HCLS customers.

You'll collaborate with colleagues across the ProServe HCLS team and external Partners, working backwards from customer outcomes to design fit-for-purpose solutions and programs across SC&MFG.

This role requires expertise in AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI applied to pharmaceutical and life sciences Supply Chain & Manufacturing, paired with experience in professional services and business development. The ideal candidate can flex seamlessly between manufacturing operations and supply chain contexts — understanding both the regulated manufacturing environment (cGMP, GxP) and the planning-to-fulfillment data landscape. You think big, innovate, focus on customer objectives, execute at high standards, and maintain continuous curiosity.

Key job responsibilities

• Serving as the practice's dedicated specialist and deep domain expert in Supply Chain & Manufacturing — spanning smart manufacturing, IIoT, digital twins, CMC orchestration, and supply chain intelligence — designing and delivering solution architectures that solve complex customer problems across both manufacturing and supply chain
• Developing innovative GTM strategies, offerings, and accelerators for the SC&MFG space spanning manufacturing and supply chain — identifying whitespace, shaping new service offerings, and positioning the practice to capture emerging demand across the manufacturing-to-supply-chain continuum
• Counseling HCLS executive customers to explore the art of the possible with AI-driven transformation across Supply Chain & Manufacturing — pushing the frontiers of innovation in smart manufacturing, autonomous quality, predictive supply planning, and agentic process orchestration to achieve breakthrough operational outcomes
• Collaborating with internal teams to innovate AWS solutions, services, accelerators, and demos that address evolving SC&MFG customer needs — including IIoT edge-to-cloud pipelines, manufacturing data foundations, digital twin architectures, and agentic supply chain systems
• Designing complex, scalable, and secure architectures on AWS to achieve customer business outcomes (CBOs) across Manufacturing and Supply Chain — from shop-floor data ingestion and process automation through enterprise-wide supply chain visibility and planning optimization
• Driving large, complex opportunities — spanning manufacturing, supply chain, or both — from ideation, through vision building and scoping, solution architecture development, all the way to sales closure — owning technical qualification, de-risking delivery, and participating in the Sales-to-Delivery (S2D) motion
• Acting as a trusted advisor and thought leader to customers and internal colleagues on industry trends in SC&MFG AI, industrial data architectures, digital twin technology, CMC orchestration, supply chain resilience, and emerging technologies across the HCLS landscape
• Leading senior engagement on the practice's highest-potential SC&MFG opportunities — including IIoT data platform builds, digital twin programs, MES/MOM modernization, CMC orchestration initiatives, and agentic supply chain deployments — across a portfolio of strategic Life Sciences accounts

title: Product Research & Development Manager, World Wide Grocery Stores, Private Brand, APAC
descriptionHtml:
Worldwide Grocery Stores (WWGS) is a global retail organization dedicated to revolutionizing the grocery shopping experience through enhanced efficiency, quality, and affordability. At its core, WWGS Private Brands (PB) serves as a crucial strategic division that develops, sources, and manages proprietary food products for both Whole Foods Market (WFM) and Amazon-branded lines across all geographic regions. Operating as a unified force, Private Brands supports both North American and International operations by leveraging cross-functional expertise in product development, sourcing, sensory evaluation, commercialization, and quality assurance to bring products to market end-to-end across all WFM and Amazon channels. This collaborative structure enables WWGS to deliver high-quality, innovative products while maintaining operational excellence across diverse global markets—rapidly scaling its food portfolio without compromising on quality standards or process efficiency.

WWGS PB APAC team manages “byAmazon” and Whole Foods Market Exclusive brands including “365”. We lead the growth of our Food PB assortment. We develop and execute the food PB expansion and growth strategy to support broader Grocery efforts across Core Consumables, Amazon Fresh, Quick Commerce, and Sub-Same Day Grocery by working across multiple channels and partner teams.

The ideal candidate will be customer-focused, a proven self-starter, and have a demonstrated ability to innovate. Also, this role conducts product-related customer research, performs data analysis, and works with WWGS/JP leadership to develop and position new products. We are looking for someone who combines a passion for consumers and food with a willingness to move fast and experiment often.

Additionally, this role requires the ability to influence multiple organizations, including WWGS, Core Consumables, Amazon Fresh, Express Mart, Quick Commerce, Food Safety, Legal, Operations, and Marketing. A strong project management skill is essential.
