title: Software Development Manager, PV Sports and Linear Tech / Live Events Publishing
descriptionHtml:
Want to change the way people watch Live Sports? Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties — including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Roland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. We move at the speed of live events, shipping fast, iterating constantly, and building across a rapidly expanding set of technologies. And we're doing it at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded owner for Sports experiences, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling experiences to our customers.

We are a team of builders — from new graduates to seasoned architects — who value ownership, open debate, and learning through experimentation. We make decisions together, move fast, and hold each other to a high bar. If you're a leader who thrives in that kind of environment, read on.

Who are we:
The Live Events Publishing team is part of Prime Video Sports & Linear org, responsible for the end-to-end systems that bring live sports content to customers. We are the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. We build the automation, tooling, and AI-powered capabilities that enable operators and systems to publish content quickly and accurately for events like NBA, Fox Sports, and other major live programming. Our Bangalore team is a growing engineering hub, and this role is central to scaling our impact.

About the role: As a Software Development Manager on the LEP team, you will lead a team of engineers building and operating the suite of services that fulfill our vision: the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog — enabling sports fans worldwide to discover, purchase, and consume sports content in any format, on any device. You will set the technical direction, hire and grow engineers, and drive the bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle.

What we're looking for:
We are looking for a highly talented Software Development Manager to help build fast, scalable, robust systems to crystallize and execute this vision. The successful candidate is expected to be a hands-on technical manager who sets a high bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle, while hiring, coaching, developing, and growing a team of engineers. We seek someone with an insatiable curiosity and appetite for learning, who can build and nurture an AI-native engineering team capable of leveraging emerging AI technologies in our solutions. We value a proactive mindset and a genuine passion for making complex systems simple. Your ability to build a culture of innovation and adaptability will be key as we integrate AI throughout our engineering practices.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and grow a team of software engineers, owning their project assignments, performance coaching, and career development while building a strong hiring pipeline
Define and communicate your team's roadmap and technical strategy to management, principal stakeholders, and partner teams, aligning priorities with customer needs
Facilitate systems design, architecture, and scaling discussions, making sound trade-offs across reliability, latency, and maintainability for the live sports catalog
Partner with product management and peer engineering managers to scope work, estimate effort, and deliver high-quality software that improves the live sports viewing experience worldwide
Champion operational excellence by establishing metrics, monitoring practices, and automation that keep your team's services healthy and your customers well-served

A day in the life
You start by syncing with product and partner engineering leads to scope upcoming work or unblock in-flight deliveries. Mid-morning you might review a design document with your engineers, pressure-testing assumptions around latency and scale for a new publishing workflow. After lunch you check operational dashboards, then shift to a one-on-one where you coach a team member through a promotion plan. Later you contribute to your team's technical strategy, weighing customer impact against engineering cost before wrapping up with a status update to stakeholders.

About the team
The Prime Video Sports Publishing (LEP) team is the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. The team builds and operates the suite of services behind our vision to be the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog — enabling sports fans to discover, purchase, and consume sports content on any device.

We are a team that values inclusiveness, respect, and mentorship. Our technology choices and designs are driven by engineers, not handed down from above. We have a strong voice in shaping the product, pitching ideas up the chain rather than the other way around.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of engineering experience
- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
- Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.

Key job responsibilities

• Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time-off, payments, and work-related situations available to employees.
• Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
• Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
• Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de-escalate complex cases.
• Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
• Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
• Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
• Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
• Consult, coordinate and partner with our third-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.

A day in the life
In a typical day, you will manage a mix of escalated cases from Tier 1 advisors and direct employee contacts, researching and resolving immigration inquiries, processing documentation and letter requests, managing leave-related concerns, and supporting employees through accommodation processes. You own each case from first contact through resolution, proactively following up and removing roadblocks rather than passing issues along. Every interaction matters — you listen with empathy, anticipate what the employee needs next, and go beyond the immediate question to ensure a complete and trusted experience. You must be prepared to handle chat, phone calls, and back-office work interchangeably throughout your shift. This role demands proficiency navigating multiple systems, tools, and applications simultaneously with speed and accuracy. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with strong communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize competing demands, and a relentless focus on delivering the best possible experience for every employee.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
- Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards
- Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
- Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

title: Delivery Consultant, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant, to
join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to
design, develop, implement and re-engineer applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud,
including GenAI-accelerated modernization techniques. You'll be a key leader in driving
customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices
throughout the project lifecycle.

As a Delivery Consultant, you will be proficient in leading the architecture of complex, scalable,
and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely
with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current applications, and propose effective
migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on
industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for
leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing
performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
• Designing and implementing complex, highly available, and secure AWS infrastructure
solutions tailored to customer needs
• Highly experienced in cloud migration strategies (6Rs) and leading complex migrations,
wave planning and utilization of migrating tooling to accelerate customer migrations.
• Conducting discovery and requirements-gathering sessions with customer stakeholders
to understand business drivers, technical constraints, and success criteria, and
translating them into actionable architecture recommendations
• Exerting technical influence across multiple teams, increasing their productivity and
effectiveness through knowledge sharing and architectural guidance

Framework → .NET Core, Java EE → Spring Boot, etc)
• Decomposing monoliths into microservices and serverless architectures (Lambda,
ECS/EKS, Fargate, Step Functions, EventBridge)

title: Sr Product Manager - Technical, Tax Engine
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Tax Services organization is building the next generation of solutions to shape the way that we calculate, collect and invoice tax information as one of the world’s largest collectors of online indirect taxes and fees. Our organization’s mission is to ensure that Amazon has the right technology and processes to remain accurate and adaptable in a rapidly changing business and tax environment.

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a Sr Product Manager - Technical (Sr PM-T) to join us in London and help build the future of the Tax Services document printing product, which is responsible for generating billions of business-critical documents (e.g. tax invoices, commercial and transport documents) every year. As a Sr PM-T, you will be responsible for identifying and executing on opportunities to build high-impact solutions and features for our document printing product that meet customer needs and drive business growth.

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial product manager who is passionate about solving complex and ambiguous problems, and who thrives in a fast-paced environment. This position has a high level of visibility, so you will need to be able to communicate clearly and compellingly at all levels of the company. Additionally, you will be responsible for measuring business impact by diving deep into metrics, tying inputs to business outcomes, and working backwards from customers. You should have a positive attitude and strong work ethic; you will work fast and smart, and adapt and iterate quickly. This role operates in highly ambiguous areas – ideal candidates have a proven track record of bringing clarity, simplifying and prototyping to iterate fast.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:

- Influence the development and execution of high-quality feature roadmaps based on the overall product strategy and vision.
- Understand and explain the impact of product features on the strategic value, useability and performance of the document printing product.
- Make prioritization and trade-off decisions among customer experience, scope, and time to market.
- Manage product planning and development through day-to-day collaboration and decision making with a cross-functional team including engineers, designers, and business development partner teams.
- Develop detailed, crisp user stories with acceptance criteria based on customer needs/experience and business requirements that can be used to create product specifications and architecture.
- Define and analyze metrics that measure and benchmark product success.

A day in the life
As a Sr PM-T in Tax Services, your day will be a mix of meetings and heads-down time for strategy and roadmap planning, and tactical execution. You’ll meet with customers and peers across product, engineering, UX, tax and legal to understand their needs and identify feature needs for our document printing product. You’ll develop functional product and user experience requirements for new features and processes to help meet our customer needs. You will be expected to own the end-to-end roadmap for discrete product features from requirements gathering through to implementation, working across teams to break down silos and drive feature delivery on the product. You will partner closely with the Tax Services engineering team to drive technology design outcomes that are scalable to support all of Amazon’s business and compliance needs. The work you deliver has a direct impact on the future portfolio of product for the Tax Services organization.

Basic qualifications

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
- Master's degree in a technical field

title: Sr. Applied AI Architect, Applied AI & Data Architecture
descriptionHtml:
Applied AI Solutions Architects in AWS help customers build and use AI agents to transform how work gets done. You will design and productionize agentic systems using services like Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, build and contribute to open-source AI accelerators, and help customers adopt AI-native software development practices.

The role splits roughly 50/50 between direct customer engagements and building leverage through reusable assets, open source, and thought leadership. In customer work, you will guide customer teams to leverage AI services and frameworks. You'll work hands-on to unblock adoption and ensure solutions are secure, reliable, and cost-effective. In your building time, you will create reference implementations, contribute to open-source projects, and develop content that enables the broader community. You will work closely with AWS service teams to close the loop between what customers need and what AWS builds.

This is a global role within the Solutions Architect organization. You will maintain deep relationships with AI service teams and collaborate with specialists and builder customers across regions to stay current on capabilities and influence roadmaps.

Key job responsibilities
- Design end-to-end agentic solutions for customers by understanding their business objectives, clarifying assumptions, and making informed trade-off decisions across areas such as model selection, orchestration patterns, tool and context design, evaluation and guardrails, and latency/cost optimization.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, diving deeply into technical details, identifying opportunities and risks, and contributing to constructive discussions that accelerate platform and service adoption.
- Leverage existing design patterns and reusable artifacts where appropriate, and create new solution designs with potential for future reuse when novel approaches are required.
- Develop and deliver technical content such as presentations, workshops, sample code, and white papers that educate customers on best practices and incorporate lessons learned from real-world engagements.
- Collaborate with internal teams including sales, engineering, and support to translate customer feedback into technical requirements, resolve root-cause issues, and progress opportunities through their lifecycle.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing a customer's architecture proposal, preparing feedback on their scaling strategy and security posture before a design review call. After the call, you sketch out an updated reference architecture that addresses the constraints discussed. In the afternoon, you collaborate with an engineering team to document a feature request a customer raised, then wrap up by refining a workshop you are building to share best practices with a broader customer audience.

About the team
Applied AI and Data Architects (AIDA) is a team of specialized AI prototypers with a product mindset. The team builds a portfolio of domain-specific Tech Field Products such as semantics, data engineering, ML, AI security/governance/agent-ops, and DevOps. Each product is grounded in customer reality. The team earns the right to guide by building alongside customers.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Technical Business Developer, Global Oil & Gas Business Development
descriptionHtml:
AWS is building deep capability in the midstream and downstream energy segment, including refineries, petrochemical plants, pipelines and LNG facilities, where operational technology meets cloud at scale. As a Technical Business Developer on the AWS Energy team, you will own the global go-to-market strategy for this segment, identifying where cloud, data, and AI can move the needle on process optimization, asset integrity, emissions management, and supply chain visibility. You will work across AWS account teams, ISVs, and systems integrators to shape solutions that fit how these operators actually run, bridging IT/OT convergence, industrial data platforms, and advanced analytics with the commercial models that make adoption real. You will develop reference architectures and technical content grounded in plant-level and pipeline-level use cases, and build relationships with VP-level engineering and digital leaders at major operators who are making build-vs-buy decisions right now. This role suits someone who has walked a plant floor, understands a DCS from a historian, and can hold their own in a conversation about turnaround planning or pipeline SCADA modernization. You will use your network and credibility in the sector to open doors that cold outreach cannot, and you will be measured on pipeline generated, solutions adopted and customer outcomes delivered, not slide decks produced.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and own a global go-to-market strategy for the midstream and downstream energy segment, identifying priority use cases and customer targets across regions.
- Engage VP and C-level leaders at major mid/downstream companies, building trusted advisory relationships and connecting their operational challenges with AWS solutions.
- Create and deliver technical content such as whitepapers, reference architectures, and solution briefs for use cases including digital twins and carbon management.
- Build jointly with partners, customer account teams, and industry deployment and systems integrators to co-develop solutions for refining and pipeline operations.
- Coach account teams on mid/downstream positioning and mentor teammates to help the broader organization grow its energy practice.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing your global pipeline of mid/downstream opportunities and preparing a business case for a new customer engagement. By midday, you are on a call with a refinery's digital transformation lead, mapping their process optimization needs to AWS capabilities. In the afternoon, you work with a systems integrator partner and a customer account team to finalize a joint solution brief, then close out by coaching an account team on how to position a carbon management use case. You regularly present progress and recommendations to senior leadership, ensuring alignment across regional teams.

About the team
The AWS Energy team works with some of the world's most complex and impactful companies to bring cloud computing to the energy industry. Our mission is to accelerate digital transformation across the energy value chain. We build alongside partners, customer account teams, and industry systems integrators to deliver real outcomes for our customers. The midstream and downstream segment represents a significant growth opportunity, and this role is central to building our presence with global refining, chemicals, and pipeline operators. We value curiosity and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to delivering results together.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Energy & Utilities industries experience
- Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- Experience working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking
- Experience working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT.
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in business, data science, public administration, finance, engineering, human resources, or related field, or PMP certificate
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams

title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS EKS
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II (SDE-2) to join the EKS Runtime Release team. In this role, you will design, build, and operate systems that power the compute layer for Amazon EKS, working on critical infrastructure that enables customers to run containerized workloads reliably and securely at scale. You will own the end-to-end AMI lifecycle including designing optimized Amazon Machine Images for EKS workloads across Amazon Linux distributions, implementing automated build and release pipelines with integration testing, and ensuring compliance with 21-day CVE patching SLAs through automated tooling. Your work will involve qualifying and certifying new GPU and accelerator instance types such as P6 (B200/B300), G7, and Trainium2, managing NVIDIA driver updates and multi-version support strategies, and integrating Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) drivers for GPU, EFA, and Neuron workloads. You will develop and operate the Node Monitoring Agent that runs as a DaemonSet on customer nodes, implementing health checks, automated log collection, and EFA monitoring capabilities to provide fleet-wide observability. A significant portion of your work will focus on enabling AI and ML workloads by implementing VM isolation runtimes with Nitro partition support for secure container startup, optimizing node startup sequences for Auto Mode, and building support for AI agent workload patterns including pod pause, resume, snapshot, and restore capabilities. You will also update and maintain container runtimes including containerd and runc, configure SOCI snapshotters for improved cold-start performance, implement advanced kubelet configurations for huge pages and CPU topology management, and ensure GPU Operator compatibility across the fleet. As an SDE-2, you will drive technical design decisions for node runtime architecture, collaborate with service teams across AWS to integrate new capabilities, provide 24/7 oncall coverage for operational support, respond to SEVs and customer escalations, and mentor junior engineers while raising the bar on engineering and operational excellence. This is an opportunity to work on foundational infrastructure that directly impacts millions of customers running containerized workloads on AWS, with particular focus on enabling the next generation of GPU-accelerated AI and ML applications.


Key job responsibilities
Design & Build: Architect and implement the node-level runtime infrastructure that powers EKS compute. Design optimized Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), integrate GPU drivers and accelerator support, implement VM isolation runtimes, and build node monitoring systems that operate reliably across millions of customer nodes.

Operate at Scale: Own the operational health of the EKS runtime layer handling millions of customer workloads across diverse instance types and accelerators. Participate in on-call rotations, respond to SEVs, resolve customer escalations, and drive operational improvements that reduce MTTR and improve fleet stability.

Technical Leadership: Lead the design and implementation of complex node runtime features end-to-end, from requirements through AMI build pipelines, testing frameworks, deployment, and production validation. Drive technical decisions on AMI architecture, container runtime strategies, and GPU/accelerator integration.

Kubernetes & Runtime Expertise: Work deeply with node-level Kubernetes components including kubelet configuration, device plugins, Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) drivers, and container runtimes (containerd, runc). Understand Linux internals, systemd, GPU drivers, and isolation technologies to build robust node capabilities.

Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with EKS control plane teams, EC2 instance teams, NVIDIA, AWS AI/ML services (SageMaker, Trainium, Inferentia), and open-source communities to deliver integrated solutions that enable customer workloads from traditional containers to cutting edge AI training and inference.

Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers on systems programming, Linux internals, and operational best practices. Conduct thorough code reviews, share knowledge on GPU technologies and container runtimes, and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence.

Operational Excellence: Drive improvements in AMI build and release pipelines, automated CVE patching, instance qualification testing, monitoring and alarming for node health, and incident response processes. Build automation that reduces manual toil and accelerates time-to-resolution.

Innovation: Identify opportunities to enable new GPU and accelerator technologies, optimize node startup performance, improve container isolation and security, and push the boundaries of what's possible with AI/ML workloads on Kubernetes. Simplify customer experiences through better defaults, comprehensive monitoring, and self-healing capabilities.

About the team
The EKS Runtime Release team builds and operates the foundational compute layer that powers Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS). We own the node-level infrastructure that makes EC2 instances become reliable, secure, and high-performance Kubernetes nodes. This includes designing and building optimized Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), integrating GPU drivers and accelerator support, implementing container runtimes and isolation technologies, building node monitoring systems, and automating security patching across the fleet. Our systems run on millions of customer nodes and enable workloads ranging from traditional microservices to the largest AI training and inference clusters in the world.

Our team tackles challenges at the intersection of Linux systems programming, Kubernetes internals, GPU/accelerator technologies, and distributed systems operations at massive scale. We're building the next generation of node capabilities—from VM-based pod isolation with Nitro partitions to Dynamic Resource Allocation for GPUs and accelerators, from qualifying cutting-edge instance types like P6 (B200/B300) and Trainium2 to enabling AI agent workload patterns with pod pause, resume, and snapshot capabilities. We work closely with NVIDIA, EC2 instance teams, AWS AI/ML services, and the Kubernetes community to deliver the most capable and reliable node platform for containerized workloads.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences. Amazon's culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. While we maintain 24/7 on-call coverage to support our critical infrastructure, we distribute the operational load fairly and invest heavily in automation and operational excellence to minimize toil and ensure sustainable on-call burden.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Whether you're learning about Linux kernel internals, GPU driver architecture, Kubernetes device plugins, or distributed systems operations, our senior members provide one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer - balancing innovation work (new GPU support, AI workload patterns) with operational excellence (automation, monitoring, reliability improvements)—and enable them to take on more complex technical leadership in the future.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Kubernetes, Docker or containers ecosystem, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities and experience in managing and troublshooting network
- Knowledge of and experience with cloud infrastructure technologies
- Experience in Linux/RHEL, or experience in Kubernetes, Docker or containers ecosystem and experience with programming/scripting (Batch, VB, PowerShell, Java, C#, Chef, Perl, Ruby and/or PHP)
- Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
- Experience delivering products against plan in a fast-paced, multi-disciplined, distributed-responsibility and often ambiguous environment
- Experience with enterprise architecture including virtualization technologies and distributed architecture
- Experience in an operational role, or experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems
- Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Kubernetes/CNCF ecosystem

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Supply Chain Manager III, Global Transportation Services (GTS) Planning
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the tools and processes that make supply chain planning faster and smarter? Amazon's Global Transportation Services (GTS) Planning Products team is looking for a Supply Chain Manager III to define problems, design solutions, and drive productivity improvements across our outbound transportation network planning operations. As the team invests in using AI to automate manual planning processes and build more robust systems, this is a compelling time to join and shape how that transformation takes hold.

This is a highly collaborative, individual contributor role where you will work side by side with planners to understand their workflows, identify improvement areas, and write clear problem statements. From there, you will partner with technology teams to build tooling solutions and with operational partners to implement process changes. You will work with optimization models, capacity planning tools, and product management tools to turn undefined challenges into concrete products. If you thrive in ambiguity and want visibility with senior leadership, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Define problem statements by embedding with planners to understand planning workflows, then partner with technology teams to design and deliver tooling solutions — including optimization models and capacity planning tools — that improve productivity across the outbound transportation network.
- Analyze supply chain planning data to identify root causes behind performance gaps and propose scalable process or system improvements, with a focus on automating manual processes through AI-driven approaches.
- Lead weekly product update meetings with leadership, business, and tech stakeholders, and prepare monthly and quarterly business reviews to communicate progress, trade-offs, and recommendations.
- Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to implement technical improvements to reporting and planning mechanisms.
- Develop metrics and monitoring dashboards that enable stakeholders to track planning performance and make informed decisions.

A day in the life
Your work is almost entirely collaborative and roadmap-driven. You might start the morning reviewing capacity planning outputs or optimization model results to refine a problem statement, then meet with planners to validate your findings. After lunch, you could be in a working session with a tech team scoping requirements for a new AI-powered automation tool. Later in the week, you run a product update meeting with leadership, business, and tech stakeholders to share progress and align on priorities. You will also prepare and present monthly and quarterly business reviews, giving you regular visibility with senior leaders.

About the team
The GTS Planning Products team keeps Amazon's outbound transportation network planning processes current and pushes them forward. We are investing in AI and automation to replace manual workflows with robust, scalable systems. We build solutions for the broader planning organization and partner with carrier teams, tech teams, and operations to integrate these into our planning tools. This role offers growth in the product space — you will build expertise in optimization models, capacity planning, and the latest tooling trends while developing deep knowledge of network planning. Through business reviews and product launch communications, you will gain regular exposure to senior leadership and the chance to shape how Amazon plans transportation at scale.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Builder Experience Team (BeXT) as a Senior Data Center HR Partner and make every day better for the Builders who power AWS. This is a 100% on-site role where you'll serve as the strategic HR partner to cluster operations leadership across multiple clusters. You'll operate with significant autonomy — applying senior judgment in precedent-setting situations, designing scalable mechanisms, and coaching site leadership teams through the most complex people challenges in a rapidly growing business.
What we are looking for:

Adaptability. Manage multiple scenarios across clusters utilizing HR expertise, consulting skills, and influence — often in precedent-setting situations where no clear playbook exists.

High Judgement. Make high-stakes decisions independently in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations. Navigate complexity with composure and serve as a go-to advisor for HRPs and site leadership.

Strategic Thinking. Connect sentiment trends, workforce data, and operational signals across clusters to identify systemic patterns. Translate cross-cluster insights into scalable recommendations that shape leadership action.

Influencing. Influence multiple levels of the organization across clusters — from builders to senior site leaders and cross-functional partners — without direct authority. Lead integrated people strategies through partnership.

Builder Advocacy: Build trust through consistent floor/onsite presence, site walks & gemba walks across multiple clusters. Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders, ensuring they feel fully engaged in their work and valued for who they are. Independently manage relationships with employee representative boards.

Strategic Partnership: Serve as the primary HR partner to cluster operations leadership across multiple clusters, developing proactive strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience. Perform cross-cluster systemic risk detection — connecting sentiment trends, workforce data, and operational signals to provide recommendations to site leadership and HRBPs. Coordinate cross-cluster communications in partnership with site leadership. Present at monthly All Manager and All Team Meetings.

私たちは毎年新しいオペレーション拠点を立ち上げ、プロフェッショナルとしての成長機会を提供しています。パートタイムのアソシエイトからDirectorまで、多様なBackgroundを持つメンバーとのCross-functionalワークを通じて、新しい視点やスキルを身に付けることができます。

Key job responsibilities

【具体的な業務内容】
- 物流拠点運営、ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
- シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
- 組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
- オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現

- メンバーがより生産的で、パフォーマンスが高く、多様性があり、インクルーシブになるようサポート、指導し、動機付けします。チームメンバーの個人的な成功に対するビジョンとコミットメントを持って、共感を持ってリーダーシップを発揮し、楽しく仕事をし、メンバーに楽しんでもらいましょう。

- 年間のオペレーション計画を編成し、日次/週次の生産計画と実績確認、短期/長期の需要変動対応、3PLを含む関係者との調整を通じて、コストを管理しながら、年間のオペレーション計画を実行します。
- DEI やSustainability関連の大規模プロジェクトや、Family Day、ボランティアイベントなどの大規模イベントをリードします。
- 部署間、シフト間、およびネットワーク間でベストプラクティスが着実に共有されるように、積極的なアクションを講じます。

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、Amazonの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。

title: エリアマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都葛飾区を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、エリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実にお届けされるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
■業務内容■
「エリアマネージャー」には、他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、「People First」の考え方で、各種プロジェクトをリードし、またピープルマネージメントを行っていただきます。また、「エリアマネージャー」は拠点の全ての工程を担当し、上司の示す部署全体の方針や安全・品質・生産性の年間目標に沿って、担当工程における改善を積み重ね、日々の計画、進捗、実績管理に責任をもち活動いただきます。

具体的な業務は以下の通りです。

主な責任と職務内容：
① チームメンバーの育成とサポート
現場の最前線にいるマネージャーとしてチームメンバーと積極的に関わり、メンバーからの意見に基づく職場改善によりエンゲージメントを高めます。また、数名から数十名のチームのマネージャーとして、業務上の知識・スキル、アマゾンカルチャー等の指導を行うことはもちろん、部下の悩みに傾聴し、問題の解決に向けて自ら動きます。さらに、部下の勤怠や労働時間等の把握、管理を適切に行います。

② 担当プロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上
マネージャーはそれぞれ特定のプロセスを担当し、そのプロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上をリードします。日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、作業環境の改善、トレーニングの進捗管理など多岐にわたる改善活動が該当します。問題を特定し、対策を立案し、チームメンバーを巻き込みながら実行に移し、結果を出していくことが求められます。

③ 日々のオペレーション対応
物流拠点のすべての工程を管理し、商品の管理からお客様へお届けするまでの一連の流れの中で計画を立案し管理していただきます。日々のオペレーションにおいてお客様にお約束した納期を確実に守るため、物量の上振れや下振れ、急な労働力不足、システムトラブル等の変動要素に際し、適切に判断して対応していくことが求められます。

④ プロジェクトリーダーとして改善を推進
Amazonでは日々改善が推進されています。エリアマネージャーは通常業務と並行して、安全上のリスクや生産性を改善するプロジェクトのリーダーとして拠点内の年次/月次プロジェクト活動を推進します。これらのプロジェクトにおいては関連部署との協業等も含まれます。

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Purchase Experience, Amazon Books
descriptionHtml:
Join the Books org and lead product development for our Payment and Purchase Experience charter. We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager - Technical to help create the most trusted and delightful end-to-end purchase and payments CX for Books customers world-wide. You will develop the strategy and vision for this charter and collaborate with an engineering team to oversee the development of related products and features.

Key job responsibilities

About the team
The mission of the Books Customer Value org is to maximize customers’ return on money, time, and energy spent acquiring Books and empower them to read more. We do so by obsessing over value to ensure sharp pricing, making acquiring a book seamless and secure, and providing tools to build a reading habit.

title: Sr Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - S&T
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.

AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Key job responsibilities
As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. title: Sr. Infrastructure Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Reliability & Quality
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Senior Infrastructure Reliability Engineer you will be proactively driving the reliability risk identification, assessment and mitigation for datacenter infrastructure equipment (Example: Busduct, Tapoff Box, MV Transformers, LV SWGR, Breakers, UPS, Power Distribution Cabinets etc.). You will also be responsible for root cause analysis of critical equipment failures and drive the continuous improvements to improve datacenter availability for AWS customers. You will work closely with both internal and outside partners including suppliers to drive key aspects of product specification, risk identification plan and execution. You must be ownership minded, independent, action and results oriented to succeed in an open collaborative environment.

The candidate should have experience in using Physics-of-Failure based approach to develop and implement both analytical and empirical approaches for product quality/reliability risk identification and assessment during product design, manufacture as well as deployment stages. The individual should be able to drive AWS application-specific requirements in carrying out both lifecycle environmental and operational stress driven risk analysis, including thermal, electrical, chemical and mechanical stresses so to identify overstress and fatigue-related product weaknesses. Candidate should be capable of evaluating not only product design quality/reliability risks, but also have the skills and experiences in assessing electronics manufacture process related quality/reliability issues. Knowledge of statistical techniques and models is required to analyze test as well as field data.

At the component level, the individual will drive critical component identification and the associated vendor selection and qualification requirements. The candidate will be expected to use knowledge of process capability for electronic component production as well as system-level performance requirements to establish critical to quality and reliability metrics.
At the system level, the individual will develop datacenter system level reliability model and related reliability quantification and risk analysis for datacenter configuration optimization. The candidate will be expected to be familiar with system reliability engineering tools, such as reliability block diagram, statistical modeling and data analytics.

During sustaining stage, candidate will be responsible for monitoring product performance in the field and will be responsible to drive root cause analysis of any critical failures and the associated corrective and preventive actions. The individual should also be able to drive effective vendor auditing and quarterly review process to drive the continuous improvements of datacenter availability.

The successful candidate should be considered as an expert in the reliability engineering field and have a proven track record of success in not only product reliability leadership, as well as business negotiations and program management. Strong skill-set in problem analysis and solving as well as communication and vendor management are necessary. Candidates should also be able to travel within US and internationally.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Customer Logistics Security (CLS)
descriptionHtml:
Customer Logistics Security (CLS) within Stores Security (StoresSec) is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to define and deliver security programs with broad cross-organizational impact across Amazon's global logistics systems, from robotics platforms to the technology stacks that power worldwide fulfillment, transportation, and delivery operations.

Amazon's logistics network spans first mile (fulfillment and inbound), middle mile (sortation and transportation), and last mile (delivery) operations, along with Amazon Grocery and Amazon Prime Air drone-based delivery. Securing these systems at global scale requires identifying security gaps across diverse and rapidly evolving technology stacks, recognizing threat patterns that span operational boundaries, and driving a portfolio of security programs that protect customer trust and help ensure safe, reliable operations.

CLS builds and maintains security solutions that protect logistics and robotics infrastructure worldwide. This Principal TPM will operate with complete independence as the single-threaded leader responsible for identifying security risks across logistics systems and Amazon Robotics environments, defining technical requirements for CLS-built solutions, and influencing delivery of a portfolio of security projects across all logistics lines of business. You will be expected to operate in areas where security strategy has not yet been defined, applying deep knowledge of security systems and technologies to invent, evolve, improve, and simplify solutions. You will own the technology roadmap for CLS security solutions, decompose complex security problems into straightforward solutions, and drive large-scale engineering efforts that solve significantly complex or endemic security problems across Amazon's worldwide operations footprint.

This role requires deep security domain expertise and a broad understanding of the company systems and technologies relevant to logistics security. You will consistently bring strong, data-driven business and technical judgment to decisions, evaluate complex architectures spanning IT and operational technology boundaries, and influence senior stakeholders (VPs/SVPs) on security investment and prioritization. You will represent complex decisions, trade-offs, and potential solutions clearly to leaders up to three levels above, helping them understand the decisions they need to make and the options available.


Key job responsibilities
- Security Risk & Threat Analysis: Assess logistics systems, robotics platforms, and operational technology across Amazon's worldwide operations, spanning first mile, middle mile, last mile, Grocery, and Prime Air, to identify security opportunities and systemic threat patterns. Identify gaps and opportunities within and between countries, architectures, and organizations. Recognize when systems are susceptible to prior failure patterns and steer teams to avoid recurrence.
- Technical Requirements, Design & Architecture Influence: Serve as a trusted representative of the CLS engineering organization, independently influencing system design and solution architecture across partner teams. Translate risk findings into clear technical requirements for CLS-built security solutions at global scale. Apply deep domain knowledge to invent new approaches where existing solutions fall short. Recognize when designs require additional guidance from senior engineers or subject matter experts and engage them appropriately.
- Portfolio Program Leadership: Own and drive a portfolio of security projects across all logistics lines of business. Make the case for technology programs, influence teams to dedicate resources, and lead the effort or find the appropriate owner. Ensure findings in one domain accelerate risk reduction in others.
- Strategy, Roadmaps & Delivery: Own the cross-functional program roadmap for Customer Logistics Security, operating in areas where strategy has not yet been defined. Drive large-scale engineering efforts end-to-end, from risk assessment through global deployment, creating the correct sense of urgency and aligning teams toward coherent security strategies.
- Stakeholder Influence & Communication: Build consensus and influence organization priorities, system owners, and technology direction across robotics engineering, logistics operations, and security organizations. Represent complex decisions and trade-offs clearly to leaders up to three levels above. Drive executive-level escalations with excellent judgment.
- Mentorship & Team Development: Amplify impact by educating TPM and engineering communities on security program management best practices. Mentor TPMs and program managers, participate in Principal TPM promotion assessments and talent reviews, and raise the bar on operational rigor and security domain expertise.

A day in the life
Customer Logistics Security builds and maintains security solutions that protect Amazon's logistics and robotics infrastructure at global scale. You will work across the full breadth of Amazon's logistics operations, fulfillment centers, sortation facilities, transportation networks, last mile delivery stations, Grocery operations, and Prime Air, identifying where security gaps exist and driving solutions that close them. You will regularly operate in ambiguous spaces where security strategy has not yet been defined, applying deep domain knowledge and data-driven judgment to create clarity, invent new approaches, and simplify complex problems. Every engagement leaves our partners with stronger security posture and clearer ownership of ongoing risk management.
You will collaborate daily with a cross-functional team of security engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and program managers. You will assess emerging risks as logistics systems and Amazon Robotics capabilities evolve, identify threat patterns that cut across operational boundaries, define what CLS needs to build next, and ensure delivery stays on track across a complex, multi-domain stakeholder landscape. You will make the case for security investments, proactively drive system-level reviews, build consensus across senior leadership, and create mechanisms that ensure programs succeed long after your direct involvement ends. Your work directly protects customer trust and helps ensure safe, reliable operations worldwide.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT), Platform Engineering and Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale.

Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. Most excitingly, you will help drive refresh of the existing tool, an AI-first greenfield initiative to rebuild the platform from the ground up using modern stream-based architecture, eliminating a decade of technical debt and delivering near real-time metrics. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. If you have that expertise, are customer-centric, and motivated about building systems that operate at global scale, then we want to talk to you!

Key job responsibilities
* Design, develop, and test software components across Labor Insights' ingestion, aggregation, reporting, and configuration layers — handling labor events, time clock punches, employee location tracking, and productivity report generation
* Build new services using AI-assisted development practices, leveraging tools like Amazon Q and Bedrock to achieve high-velocity delivery on greenfield systems
* Design large-scale data processing solutions using DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, and stream processing frameworks (Cosmos/Flink) optimized for high throughput and low-latency access
* Drive service consolidation and modernization — migrating from legacy infrastructure to Native AWS (NAWS) with full CI/CD pipelines
* Participate in definition of coding standards and apply them in code and design reviews
* Provide estimates for development tasks and negotiate timelines with project leaders
* Mentor junior team members and help them acquire critical skills and best practices
* Document and communicate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders
* Participate in deep technical discussions, where you stand up for your ideas and work with team members to find the best solution for the customer
* Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them

A day in the life
Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations.

Billions-scale data processing. You build systems that ingest 19+ billion labor events per year from warehouse floor tools, time clock systems, and employee location heartbeats. You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities.

AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE).
AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling.

Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations.

About the team
About Labor Insights: We build Amazon's global labor management platform — the system of record for measuring associate performance across every fulfillment center, sort center, delivery station, and grocery facility worldwide. Labor Insights tracks how ~1 million associates spend their time, producing the productivity reports (PPR, PPA, attendance, Time Off Task) that operations managers use to make staffing decisions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure customer shipments go out on time.

What Makes This Role Exciting:

* Build FCLM 2.0 from the ground up — a once-in-a-career opportunity to greenfield a platform that runs Amazon's global workforce visibility, using AI-first development to deliver in months what would take years through traditional approaches
* Pioneer stream processing — transition from batch to real-time with sub-minute latencies using Cosmos/Flink, fundamentally changing how Amazon tracks labor performance
* Build a multi-tenant platform (FCLM FLEX) — design a configurable translation layer that recasts PPR and PPA as flexible views on the same underlying data, eliminating duplicate pipelines and enabling third-party teams to create custom labor views without engineering support
* Reimagine the portal experience — rebuild the portal used by 70K+ daily users from legacy JSP/jQuery into a modern React application with accessibility, localization, and scalable access controls
* Expand to new businesses — onboard Amazon Grocery (Fresh, Whole Foods) and other new business lines in 2026+, scaling the platform to new node types and labor models
* Build AI-powered tools — design intelligent systems using Amazon Bedrock for automated configuration management, request intake, and operational copilots that serve 1.5M workers globally
* Massive impact — every feature you build is used by tens of thousands of warehouse managers the same day; Labor Insights’ operations save an estimated $25M+ annually


Our tenets:

* Build for Scale: Design generically to support multiple use cases beyond Labor Insights
* Service Generalization for Multi-Tenancy: Build abstractions that work across all businesses
* No Data Filtering by Default: Accept all incoming data, build flexible views on top

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Sr. Principal Software Engineer, Shipping Tech & Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Shipping is our externalized business providing small parcel transportation services to sellers and shippers. Amazon Shipping leverages many of the above foundational systems together with operations capabilities to pick up packages from shipper warehouses and inject them into the AFN outbound transportation network to provide an end-to-end parcel delivery product we can sell.

The Sr. PE in this space will develop deep understanding of Amazon’s end-to-end fulfilment and transportation operations in order to support small-parcel transportation for all Amazon marketplaces, its subsidiaries, merchants and off-Amazon shippers.

This role will need to understand not only how a large set of technical services within Carrier Integration Services (CIS) and Amazon Shipping work together, but also how they interface and enable the adjacent functions, capabilities and programs across First Mile, Middle Mile and Last Mile as we transition to being an end-to-end carrier.

The Sr. PE will establish the strategy and execution plan to achieve convergence of multiple legacy systems in the carrier space, gracefully manage this transition while both legacy and new systems coexist in production, and strike the right balance between feature velocity and not blocking business launches yet also avoiding accrual of technical debt and throwaway work.

To do this effectively requires setting a strategy that provides value in both the near and long-term, and aligning 5 to 6 VP stakeholders on the vision and plan. The Sr. PE must possess a broad and deep understanding of the transportation architecture and operations, and create scalable solutions to support heterogeneous functions at scale, such as FC package labeling and sorting, sort center processing, line haul, air and last mile delivery as well as an ever-growing number of programs (e.g., Sub-Same Day, AmazonDay, Roar, Pharmacy) and advanced capabilities (disruption management, replanning, problem solve, Redirect to Locker).
