title: Principal PM-T, Growth, Outbound Communications
descriptionHtml:
Every day, hundreds of Amazon teams across Retail, Prime, Prime Video, Music, Alexa, and more reach customers through email, push, SMS, and messaging apps. Outbound Communications runs that marketplace, at the scale of hundreds of millions of customers and billions of messages, through everyday sending and Amazon's largest events: Prime Day, Prime Big Deal Days, and the holidays. Each message competes for finite customer attention. The marketplace grows when every message earns more of it: more customers open, click, and buy, and fewer opt out.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager - Technical to lead growth for this marketplace. You'll own click-through rate, conversion, and incremental sales per message across channels, and the technical products that move them: personalization and recommendations in messages, send-time and channel optimization, new creative and interactive experiences, conversational and messaging channels, and the experimentation engine that tells us what works.

You'll work backwards from the customer. You'll find where messages fail to earn engagement, form hypotheses, and run a high-velocity experimentation program with engineering and science. You'll ship the winners as platform capabilities that every sending team can use, not one-off campaign tweaks. You'll measure growth honestly, on clicks, conversions, incremental OPS, and long-term customer value, not opens, and you'll balance short-term lift against opt-outs and customer trust.



Key job responsibilities
- Own the growth strategy, roadmap, and goals for Outbound's customer attention marketplace: CTR, conversion, incremental OPS per message, and engagement across email, push, SMS, and messaging channels.
- Build and run a high-velocity experimentation program. Set the hypothesis backlog, prioritize by expected impact, and make A/B and multi-armed testing fast, trustworthy, and self-service for every sending team.
- Own the technical products that drive engagement: personalization and recommendations inside messages, send-time and channel selection, content and creative optimization, and interactive and conversational experiences that let customers act without leaving the message.
- Partner with science and engineering to bring ML and AI into who receives what, when, and on which channel, including ranking, propensity and uplift models, bandits, and generative content, and measure their incrementality against holdouts.
- Define the growth funnel and its instrumentation end to end, from delivered to opened, clicked, converted, and retained. Make the data reconcilable, real-time where it matters, and attributable to the module, content, and decision that drove it.
- Grow the addressable audience: opt-in and permission growth for new channels, reactivation of lapsed customers, and deliverability and reach improvements.
- Turn winning experiments into platform capabilities. Write PR/FAQs and requirements, make build-vs-buy and architecture trade-offs with engineering leaders, and drive adoption across partner teams.
- Set growth tenets and guardrails, such as opt-out, complaint, and frequency limits, so growth never comes at the cost of customer trust.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon 1P Lending
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help millions of customers in Latin America get fair, simple and transparent credit? Amazon's 1P Lending team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II (SDE II) to design and build the systems behind our lending products in Brazil and Mexico.

You'll build and own services that handle customer onboarding, credit decisioning, loan servicing, repayments, and integration with local partners and regulators. These are critical financial systems, so they must be correct, secure, auditable and highly available.

You'll be part of a team of engineers in São Paulo and work closely with engineering teams in India and with Product, Risk, Finance and Compliance partners in Brazil and Mexico. You'll own features from design to production, help shape the team's architecture, and see your work directly affect customers' access to credit.

We're looking for a strong engineer with high ownership. You should enjoy solving hard problems, write high-quality code, and care about how your systems behave in production.

Key job responsibilities
Design and build: Design, write, test and launch scalable, reliable services and features for lending products in Brazil and Mexico.
Own your systems from start to finish: Take features from requirements and technical design through deployment, monitoring and ongoing improvement.
Contribute to architecture: Write and review design docs, weigh technical trade-offs, and help shape the team's system architecture with senior engineers and the SDM.
Build for financial services: Build in the security, data privacy, auditability and correctness that regulated lending systems need, including local requirements in Brazil and Mexico.
Work across geographies: Work with engineering teams in India and partner teams in Brazil and Mexico on shared services, integrations and launches.
Run what you build: Take part in on-call, debug production issues, lead root-cause analysis and make lasting fixes.
Raise the bar: Do thorough code reviews, improve engineering practices, and mentor junior engineers and interns.
Work with business partners: Partner with Product, Risk and Compliance to turn customer and regulatory needs into technical solutions.

A day in the life
On a given day you might:

Write the design doc for a new repayment-scheduling service.
Review a teammate's code and suggest a simpler approach.
Pair with an engineer in India to debug an integration issue.
Work with Risk to understand a new credit-decisioning rule.
Ship a feature to production and watch its metrics after launch.
You'll split your time between design, coding, operations and working with your team and partners.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Applied Scientist, Fauna Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Robots are about to step out of the movies and into our homes. If you're excited about this robotics revolution, come join Amazon's Fauna Robotics. As an Applied Scientist in this org, you'll push the state-of-the-art techniques in Robotics. You'll drive technical excellence in areas such as perception, manipulation, sim2real transfer, reinforcement learning and multi-task learning, designing novel algorithms that bridge the gap between research and real-world deployment.

In this role, you will integrate hands-on technical expertise with scientific leadership, ensuring your team delivers robust solutions for dynamic real-world environments. While staying updated with the latest advancements in robotics research, you will leverage your experience and expertise to guide the team towards the most promising direction. Collaborating with a talented group of software engineers and scientists, you will bring your ideas to fruition. Deploying robots in home environments requires you to anticipate challenges not encountered in structured settings like warehouses. Additionally, consumer-grade sensors and actuators necessitate working around their limitations, requiring out-of-the-box innovative ideas. As such, you are someone who truly enjoys thinking about problems using first principles at a holistic and systems level to address the aforementioned challenges.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead technical initiatives in areas such as robotics foundation models, reinforcement learning and manipulation - - Design experiments to identify the limitations of current state-of-the-art models and developing new models or techniques that can surpass these models
- Design and implement novel deep learning architectures that push the boundaries of what robots can understand and accomplish
- Mentor fellow scientists while maintaining strong individual technical contributions
- Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize and scale models for real-world applications
- Influence technical decisions and implementation strategies within your area of focus
- Experienced in communicating complex technical work to a non-technical audience
- The ability to work with minimal guidance, be proactive and to handle ambiguity and the challenge of quickly evolving goals

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- PhD, or Master's degree and 3+ years of applied research experience

Preferred qualifications

- Hand-on experience of deploying Deep Learning models on robots
- Experience in developing Vision Language Action (VLA) models and/or Reinforcement learning for robot manipulation

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
Technical writing to support change management program
Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
Role may support more than one location/site.


Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection


This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility


Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM), Prime Air Europe
descriptionHtml:
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity and inclusion of our teams within the organization. How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and most importantly safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers and are excited for what’s to come. Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog. If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Prime Air is the place for you.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) in Prime Air Europe, you'll own the end-to-end lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs that underpin Prime Air's mission to deliver safely and at scale. This role sits at the intersection of technical delivery and strategic program leadership, serving as the critical bridge between engineering teams and business stakeholders while driving operational excellence across Prime Air's European operations. You will work back from customer opportunity in Europe to durable, scalable solutions, and deliver them through the Infrastructure Expansion and Deployment teams, the engineering

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities. As a Senior TPM in Prime Air's European Operations, you will own the full lifecycle of technical programs spanning drone delivery systems, ground infrastructure systems and the customer experience built on top of them, ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery at the highest safety and quality standards. You will work backward from customer opportunity: identify where the European customer experience limits adoption or leaves opportunity unrealised, quantify what it is worth, write the requirements, and define success in measurable customer terms before any build starts. You will insist on solutions that are durable and reusable, so that what one country needs is built once in a way the next country inherits, rather than accumulating per-country workarounds. You will lead technical risk assessment frameworks, proactively identifying risks, developing mitigation strategies, and driving resolution across cross-functional engineering teams to keep programs on track. You will drive cross-functional integration of European and US technical infrastructure, coordinating with engineering teams on system architecture decisions and technical dependencies, and evaluating the system-level designs that come back. A critical part of your role involves establishing and maintaining standardized technical processes, tooling, and operational frameworks that drive efficiency and scalability across European programs. You will develop and maintain executive-level technical dashboards (e.g., QuickSight), creating standardized metrics and review processes that enable data-driven decision making across global operations, and you will own the business cadence those reviews run on. In partnership with senior technical and business leadership across EU and US, you will drive alignment on priorities and program execution, translating complex technical information into clear, actionable insights. You will champion continuous improvement and innovation initiatives while ensuring teams maintain the highest safety and security standards. Working with the Infrastructure Expansion and Deployment, Regulatory and Operations teams, you will ensure that the technical infrastructure, the systems and the customer experience are ready for each new site launch in the UK and the EU, and that operations can run what you deliver without you.

title: Ingénieur(e) DCEO , Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) des Opérations d’Ingénierie de Centre de Données’ pour rejoindre notre équipe dans un centre de données AWS situé en Île-de-France. Dans ce rôle hautement pratique et basé sur le terrain, vous assurerez et piloterez l’exploitation et la maintenance directes de l’infrastructure électrique et mécanique qui alimente les services cloud AWS.

Vous prendrez en charge la maintenance pratique, impulserez des améliorations de processus, créerez de la documentation opérationnelle et accompagnerez les membres de l’équipe. Ce poste requiert une personne motivée, autonome, faisant preuve d’initiative, capable de prendre des décisions techniques de manière indépendante et recherchant proactivement des solutions tout en visant l’excellence opérationnelle.

Vous ferez partie de l’équipe Ingénierie et Installations, responsable du maintien de la disponibilité pour les clients, de la maintenance et de l’exploitation de l’infrastructure technique, ainsi que de l’entretien des installations du centre de données.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services est responsable de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. En d'autres termes, nous sommes les personnes qui font fonctionner le cloud. Nous soutenons l'ensemble des centres de données AWS ainsi que tous les serveurs, équipements de stockage, réseaux, systèmes d'alimentation électrique et de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu aux innovations sur lesquelles ils comptent. Nous travaillons sur les problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables impactant nos opérations, et nous recherchons des talents qui souhaitent nous aider à relever ces défis.





Key job responsibilities
Sécurité
• Respecter et maintenir les normes de sécurité les plus élevées et encourager une culture de sécurité de classe mondiale
• Montrer l’exemple dans la mise en œuvre et le maintien des protocoles de sécurité
• Répondre aux situations d’urgence et coordonner avec les services d’urgence si nécessaire

Opérations et Maintenance d’Ingénierie et des Installations
• Démontrer une connaissance approfondie et pratique des systèmes électriques, mécaniques, de protection incendie et de contrôle, y compris les systèmes d’alimentation sans interruption (ASI/UPS), les appareillages de commutation, les disjoncteurs, les inverseurs de source automatiques, les groupes électrogènes diesel, les refroidisseurs, les systèmes CVC (chauffage, ventilation et climatisation), les systèmes de traitement des eaux, les commutateurs de transfert statiques, les ventilateurs d’extraction, les variateurs de fréquence, les systèmes incendie et les transformateurs
• Exploiter, surveiller et maintenir les systèmes de détection et de suppression d’incendie, y compris les systèmes de pré-action, VESDA et autres équipements de protection incendie
• Rédiger, réviser et publier les Procédures Opérationnelles Standard (SOP), les Procédures Opérationnelles d’Urgence (EOP) et les Méthodes Opératoires (MOP)
• Réviser la documentation des fournisseurs pour la maintenance préventive (p. ex., RAMS – Fiabilité, Disponibilité, Maintenabilité, Sécurité’)
• Dépanner et résoudre les problèmes électromécaniques ; collaborer avec l’équipe d’ingénierie dans le cadre des SLA internes
• Effectuer des relevés opérationnels quotidiens de tous les équipements mécaniques et électriques lors des rondes/prises de relevés de routine
• Réaliser des activités de maintenance préventive et corrective pratiques sur les infrastructures critiques
• Exécuter les réparations, remplacements d’équipements et modifications des installations conformément aux normes
• Gérer les systèmes de tickets pour la Maintenance Préventive et Corrective (GMAO, outils de gestion des incidents)
• Prendre des initiatives pour améliorer les pratiques à partir de l’expérience opérationnelle ; contribuer à la création de plans d’amélioration des processus
• Planifier et exécuter les affectations de travaux à l’aide des documents de maintenance et de gestion des changements
• Collaborer avec les équipes internes sur la planification de la capacité et les améliorations de l’infrastructure
• Superviser les sous-traitants effectuant des interventions ou des maintenances préventives
• Répondre aux alarmes et effectuer le dépannage et les réparations d’urgence
• Former et accompagner les nouveaux membres de l’équipe (Exercice, Parrainage, Mentorat)
• Participer aux revues d’activité (p. ex., WBR/MBR)
• Effectuer la manutention manuelle et le levage d’équipements, y compris le travail sur des échelles et en hauteur, lorsque requis’
• Utiliser des outils alimentés par l’IA pour améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle, le dépannage et l’analyse des données
• Produire des rapports et communiquer des concepts techniques à la direction

Horaires de Travail
Il s’agit d’un poste 100 % en présentiel basé en Île-de-France. Le poste fonctionne selon un planning par roulement afin d’assurer une couverture 24h/24 et 7j/7 des opérations du centre de données, pouvant inclure des postes de jour, des postes de nuit, des week-ends et des jours fériés.


About the team
Pourquoi AWS ?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est la plateforme cloud la plus complète et la plus largement adoptée au monde. Nous avons été pionniers du cloud computing et n'avons jamais cessé d'innover — c'est pourquoi les clients, des startups les plus prospères aux entreprises du Global 500, font confiance à notre gamme robuste de produits et services pour alimenter leurs activités.

Expériences diversifiées
Amazon valorise les expériences diversifiées. Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les qualifications et compétences préférées énumérées dans la description du poste, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Si votre carrière débute, n'a pas suivi un parcours traditionnel ou inclut des expériences alternatives, ne laissez pas cela vous empêcher de postuler.

Culture d'équipe inclusive
Chez AWS, il est dans notre nature d'apprendre et d'être curieux. Nos groupes d'affinité dirigés par les employés favorisent une culture d'inclusion qui nous permet d'être fiers de nos différences. Des événements et des expériences d'apprentissage continus, notamment nos conférences CORE (Conversations on Race and Ethnicity) et AmazeCon (diversité), nous inspirent à ne jamais cesser d'embrasser notre singularité.

Mentorat et évolution de carrière
Nous élevons continuellement notre barre de performance dans notre quête pour devenir le Meilleur Employeur au Monde. C'est pourquoi vous trouverez ici un partage de connaissances infini, du mentorat et d'autres ressources d'avancement professionnel pour vous aider à devenir un professionnel plus accompli.

Équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle
Nous valorisons l'harmonie entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Réussir au travail ne devrait jamais se faire au détriment de sacrifices à la maison, c'est pourquoi nous nous efforçons d'offrir de la flexibilité dans notre culture de travail. Lorsque nous nous sentons soutenus sur le lieu de travail et à la maison, il n'y a rien que nous ne puissions accomplir dans le cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Certification, apprentissage ou diplôme en électricité ou mécanique dans un domaine technique pertinent, avec 4 années ou plus d’expérience pratique dans l’exploitation d’installations critiques
- Connaissance avancée des systèmes électriques, mécaniques et de protection incendie (distribution électrique, CVC, contrôles, détection/suppression d’incendie) – tant pratique que théorique – et maîtrise générale de l’informatique
- Maîtrise de l’anglais (à l’oral et à l’écrit)[

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience en centre de données ou en ingénierie d’installations à mission critique/hyperscaleur (5 années ou plus souhaitées)
- Expérience pratique avec les systèmes de protection incendie (pré-action, VESDA, suppression par gaz) et les plateformes BMS/de surveillance
- Expérience démontrée dans le mentorat de personnel technique ou la direction de projets techniques

Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. title: Sr. Performance Marketing Manager, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

The Amazon Leo Consumer team is looking for a talented Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own digital marketing channels in the Asia-Pacific and Japan (APJ) region. This role is responsible for end-to-end strategy and execution to acquire subscribers through digital marketing channels including search, display and social. You will build, test, automate and scale performance marketing initiatives across traffic channels. You will own MarTech product enablement to target and reach customers, planning, buying, and forecasting, campaign execution, and measurement solutions. You will work closely with Product & Engineering, Central Marketing, external agencies and publishers, and central Amazon teams to ensure we meet subscriber goals at an efficient cost-per-acquisition.

A successful candidate will be both creative and analytical, with deep experience delivering successful marketing campaigns for subscription businesses. title: Research Scientist II, Grocery ECO
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a talented Research Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning and computer vision models that solve real-world problems at scale in the Amazon grocery domain. You will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to turn complex technical challenges into production-ready solutions, and own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment. You will bring scientific rigor to every stage — from data analysis and model design to evaluation and iteration. This is a high-impact role where your models will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.

Key job responsibilities
Design, train, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning models for complex grocery-domain problems including product identification, shelf perception, and in-store scene understanding — iterating rapidly from prototype to production-quality solutions

Conduct rigorous exploratory data analysis to characterize domain-specific challenges (image variability, catalog gaps, label noise) and translate findings into actionable modeling decisions

Design and execute offline and online evaluation frameworks — defining metrics that capture both model performance and downstream business impact, and diagnosing failure modes to prioritize improvements

Build and improve data pipelines and annotation workflows that feed model training, including active learning strategies to maximize label efficiency

Communicate technical results, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders — connecting model behavior to customer experience outcomes

Stay current with state-of-the-art research in computer vision, multimodal learning, and representation learning — evaluating and adapting promising techniques to team-specific problems

Contribute to a culture of scientific rigor through reproducible experimentation, thorough documentation, peer code and design reviews, and raising the quality bar for the team

A day in the life
As a Research Scientist on the GRAISE team, you'll spend your days analyzing model performance from overnight experiments, and prototyping new approaches using multimodal learning with store video and sensor data. You'll present findings to product and business stakeholders, translating technical results into actionable recommendations. Throughout the day, you'll balance rigorous scientific thinking with practical engineering constraints, knowing your work directly improves the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.

About the team
The GRAISE team (Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience) within World Wide Grocery Store Tech (WWGST) builds foundational AI and machine learning systems that power Amazon's in-store grocery technologies. We develop domain-specific models that solve uniquely complex challenges in grocery — from smart shopping carts and inventory intelligence to personalization and store operations. Our mission is to create technology which makes grocery shopping more convenient, economical, personalized, and enjoyable for customers while empowering retailers with operational efficiency.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree
- Experience investigating the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to business problems and products
- Experience analyzing both experimental and observational data sets
- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of R, MATLAB, Python or similar scripting language
- 3+ years of applied research experience
- Knowledge of deep learning, machine learning and statistics
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals

title: HR Consultant Apprentice - 24 month Fixed Term Contract
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about people, and curious about what makes a great workplace actually work? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join Amazon as an HR Consultant Apprentice - a role where the decisions you support shape the day-to-day experience of thousands of employees.

HR at Amazon isn't about admin and policy for their own sake. Our teams sit alongside business leaders, using data, insight, and well-designed mechanisms to help managers lead well, grow their people, and make fair, consistent decisions at real scale.

As an apprentice, you'll learn this craft by doing it. You'll start by supporting the fundamentals and, over time, take on real responsibility - getting closer to the business, forming your own point of view, and learning how to influence outcomes rather than simply respond to requests.

A day in the life can involve:

- Partnering with managers and stakeholders to offer expert, practical HR guidance

- Contributing to diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

- Supporting the delivery of HR strategy for the lines of business you work with

- Using people data to spot trends and shape fair, consistent decisions

- Helping standardise and improve best practice across teams

This role suits someone who's genuinely curious about people and comfortable with a bit of grey - not every answer is in a handbook. You'll build credibility with colleagues at every level, ask good questions, and bring empathy and sound judgement to situations that are rarely black and white. We move fast, fail fast, and fix faster, so you'll be encouraged to form a view and act on it early.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship you'll put newfound knowledge into practice every day, supported by first-class coaching, tailored development, and rewarding work that will empower you to reach new heights and build the future you envision.

You'll gain a vast range of experiences and skills while working towards the HR Consultant Partner Level 5 apprenticeship standard and the CIPD Level 5 certification in People Management. As a working student, your focus is to complete your studies in your 20% off-the-job time, developing the skills, knowledge, and behaviours to work towards successful graduation. You'll be set goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

You'll build your skills over a 24-month period, starting in September. Your apprenticeship will combine classroom/virtual-based training to cover knowledge, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, online learning, and mentoring from our experienced team members.

We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups – including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities – provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're also continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer, so you'll have the resources and support to develop into a well-rounded professional.

Your career isn't a straight path - it's a journey you build as you go. A universe of opportunity awaits, and your next adventure starts here.

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in England at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in England for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- Hold 5 GCSEs at grade 4-9 (A-C) or above (or equivalent) including Maths and English and 3 A Levels or equivalent qualifications (at grade C or above) or a T-Level Pass
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 24 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- A genuine interest in people, behaviour, and what makes a workplace work well - whether through study, a part-time role, volunteering, or simply being the person others come to
- Some experience of working with or helping others in any setting (for example a customer-facing role, team project, club, or community activity)
- Confidence working with information and data - spotting patterns, drawing sensible conclusions, and using evidence to support a view

title: RME Mechatronics Apprentice – Northern Ireland Locations (36-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
Fascinated by the mechanics behind automated systems? Want to master both electrical and mechanical engineering while working with cutting-edge technology? Amazon is the perfect place to launch your career in Mechatronics Maintenance.

As one of the world's most advanced technology-driven companies, we're powered by automation, robotics, and continuous innovation - from robotic arms to complex conveyor networks and smart sensor technology that keep millions of customer orders moving. This apprenticeship gives you the chance to become a multi-skilled maintenance technician across both electrical and mechanical disciplines, with hands-on experience on industry-leading equipment, some of which only exists at Amazon.

Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is fundamental to our operations - they keep vital machinery running around the clock. As an RME Mechatronics Apprentice, you'll help maintain a wide range of equipment while upholding Health and Safety best practice, keeping your colleagues safe, preventing downtime, and improving the availability and quality of our equipment.

You'll thrive here if you stay calm when things go wrong and get a real kick out of fixing them. You're hands-on, curious about how machines work, and you understand that keeping production moving is what it's all about. And you don't need to be a qualified engineer to start - what matters most is a practical, problem-solving mindset and a hunger to learn.

A day in the life can involve:

- Carrying out proactive and preventative maintenance
- Carrying out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Using the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Making modifications and upgrades to existing equipment
- Upholding health and safety policies and practices
- Working on continuous improvement projects, and suggesting long-term improvements

Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll build a broad, in-demand engineering skillset, including:

- Fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance
- Mechanical device maintenance, and fluid power systems assembly and testing
- Electrical equipment wiring and testing
- Hydraulics and pneumatics
- Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) operations
- CAD design and 3D printing

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

Throughout the apprenticeship you will work towards an Advanced Apprenticeship in Engineering, combining practical, on-the-job experience with industry recognised study. This is a 3-year program where you will spend one day per week with our training partner focusing on the academic learning component of your apprenticeship. You will work towards achieving both a Pearson BTEC Level 3 Certificate in Advanced Manufacturing Engineering AND an ETA Level 3 NVQ Diploma in Engineering. During the remainder of the week, you will gain hands-on experience at one of our Fulfilment Centres, Sortation Centres, or Delivery Stations. You will learn directly from experienced technicians and engineers and gain exposure to real engineering projects. You'll support our 24/7 operation in shift patterns covering days, nights and weekends that reflect the real-world schedules of engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock.

Please note: some of our training sites aren't accessible by public transport, so you'll need to be able to arrange reliable travel to and from site. Access to a car can make this easier but isn't essential.

In later years, you'll combine day or block-release study for your qualification in Engineering or Mechatronics with on-the-job training at one of our Fulfilment Centres, Sortation Centres, or Delivery Stations, learning directly from experienced technicians and engineers and gaining exposure to real engineering projects.

This role supports our 24/7 operation, so you'll work shifts covering days, nights and weekends - patterns that reflect the real-world schedules of the engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock.

This apprenticeship trains you for a variety of maintenance roles - mechatronic maintenance technician, maintenance engineer, mechanical fitter, and electrical engineer - with plenty of opportunities for progression both within RME and more widely across Amazon. This could be the start of an exciting and rewarding career.

You'll join a diverse and passionate team of engineers dedicated to driving results and pushing creative boundaries. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups - including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a well-rounded professional.

Join us and be part of the team that keeps Amazon moving. Apply now and shape the future of technology with us.

Original certificates or certified copies must be submitted - this is a mandatory requirement to secure the position. Applications without verified qualifications by this date will automatically be unsuccessful, and failure to provide proof by the deadline will result in the withdrawal of any conditional offer, meaning you will not be able to commence the programme. Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)

title: Mechatroniker / Elektroniker / Mechaniker / Servicetechniker - Frankenthal bei Mannheim
descriptionHtml:
Mechatroniker / Elektroniker / Mechaniker / Servicetechniker oder vergleichbare Fachkräfte als Instandhaltungstechniker:in in unserem Logistikzentrim in Frankenthal bei Mannheim gesucht!

Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

*** Die Stelle beinhaltet die Arbeit in einem rotierenden Dreischichtsystem, welches Samstage, Nachtschichten sowie Rufbereitschaft umfassen kann. ***

Wir bieten:
- Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon
- Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket
- Eine kostenlose Lebens- und Erwerbsunfähigkeitsversicherung und Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
- Amazon Career Choice Programm, mit dem wir Weiterbildungen mit bis zu 8.000€ unterstützen
- Mitarbeiterrabatte auf amazon.de sowie Amazon Extras (z.B. Rabatte in Reisen, Restaurants, Unterhaltung, Elektronik, Heim etc.)
- Pendlerleistungen: Kostenloses Parken oder Kostenübernahme für das Deutschlandticket
- Familienbonus (Einmalzahlung für Eltern in Elternzeit)
- Vermittlungsservices für die Betreuung von Kindern, Senioren und Menschen mit besonderen Bedürfnissen
- Ein kostenloses Mitarbeiterhilfeprogramm (auch für Familienmitglieder) für eine Beratung bei beruflichen oder privaten Angelegenheiten
- Hervorragende Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem globalen Unternehmen

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life


Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt. Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen. Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK). Alternativ Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Hochschulstudiums im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Berufserfahrung in dem entsprechenden Handwerk

- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company, Amazon has reinvented how hundreds of millions of people shop online – providing customers with the opportunity to find and discover virtually anything they want to buy and providing millions of sellers with a platform for growing successful businesses. We are looking for an exceptional data engineer to help us develop new ways to build trust and loyalty with sellers, a crucial component of our flywheel

Sellers’ trust in Amazon is our top priority and in this role, you will be tasked with building that trust over time by building and maintaining the data sources that power all of our decision making. Amazon’s growth requires leaders who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new solutions, have an unrelenting tenacity to get things done, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems.

The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and be able to create and maintain efficient & automated processes. They know and love working with data engineering tools, can model multidimensional datasets, and can partner effectively with business leaders to build the right data pipelines to answer key business questions. They will build efficient, flexible, extensible, and scalable data models, ETL designs and data integration services. They will also be required to support and manage growth of these data solutions. They are analytical and creative, and don’t quit. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and with high opportunity for impact for those willing to roll up their sleeves and dive deep to achieve results.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will work on unifying fragmented data pipelines, building robust data models, and ensuring reliable data lineage across multiple product areas. You will partner closely with software engineers, product managers, and analytics teams to develop data solutions that drive innovation and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in big data technologies, strong data modeling and problem-solving skills, and a track record of delivering scalable, maintainable data systems. If you’re excited by the challenge of shaping data platforms that support real-world hardware, software, and operations, this is the role for you.

A day in the life
-Architect and implement scalable, reliable, and secure data pipelines and infrastructure to support analytics, reporting, and business operations.
-Design and enforce data modeling standards, data lineage, and governance frameworks that ensure consistency, re-usability, and quality across systems.
-Lead design and code reviews, driving engineering best practices across data development, documentation, testing, and monitoring.
-Build data platforms and frameworks that support both batch and real-time processing, enabling flexible, efficient analytics at scale.
-Implement secure and compliant data solutions that meet internal and external regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR).
-Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies to improve data platform performance, cost efficiency, and scalability.
-Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data requirements, define solution architectures, and ensure alignment with business needs.
-Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team hiring and onboarding

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with SQL

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

title: Sr Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - S&T
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.

AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Key job responsibilities
As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.

As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

- 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- Knowledge of cloud architecture
- 10+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
- 7+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Professional level certification
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

title: Senior Graphic Designer, Leo Industrial Design
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a talented Senior Graphic Designer to join our Industrial Design team and shape the visual experience of our customer-facing hardware. From thoughtfully designed product packaging and intuitive installation guides to compelling executive presentations and branded merchandise, your work will help customers discover, understand, and connect with new technology.

This role combines exceptional visual design skills with deep knowledge of physical product development, packaging, and print production. You will collaborate with Industrial Designers, Engineers, Usability Researchers, and manufacturing partners to translate complex technical information into clear, engaging, and beautifully executed visual communications.

We're looking for a hands-on designer who thrives at the intersection of creativity and technical execution, takes ownership from initial concept through production, and is excited to see their designs become real products used around the world.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Hardware Packaging: Lead graphic design for customer hardware packaging, inserts, labels, and printed materials, creating cohesive, premium customer experiences.

Installation Guides: Develop intuitive manuals, quick-start guides, technical illustrations, and iconography that simplify complex hardware installation.

Print Production: Own production-ready artwork, dielines, print specifications, color management, and proof approvals. Collaborate directly with factory production teams and suppliers to ensure quality execution.

Executive Presentations: Create compelling presentations, infographics, diagrams, posters, and visual storytelling assets for hardware teams and senior leadership.

Brand Graphics and Merchandise: Design original graphics for apparel, patches, stickers, promotional materials, and team swag, overseeing production with external vendors.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Industrial Design, Engineering, Usability, Marketing, and Operations to deliver accurate, intuitive, and visually consistent solutions.

Global Product Support: Adapt packaging and documentation for international markets, multilingual layouts, and regulatory requirements.

Design Excellence: Independently manage projects from concept through manufacturing, maintaining exceptional design quality and improving creative workflows.

A day in the life
One day you might collaborate with Industrial Designers and Packaging Engineers to develop packaging for a new customer terminal. The next, you could review factory print samples, refine installation illustrations with Usability Researchers, or create compelling graphics for an executive hardware review.

You'll balance hands-on creative work with technical problem-solving, supplier collaboration, and production execution. Projects range from sophisticated customer-facing packaging and documentation to mission-inspired merchandise celebrating major program milestones. You'll see your designs evolve from initial concepts into physical products used by customers around the world.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Industrial Design team shapes the physical design and customer experience of hardware connecting people to our satellite broadband network.

Our multidisciplinary team includes Industrial Designers, visualization specialists, researchers, and engineers developing sophisticated, intuitive hardware for global customers.

We value creativity, craftsmanship, technical excellence, and thoughtful design. Graphic design is integral to our work, ensuring every customer touchpoint—from packaging and installation instructions to product communications—delivers a cohesive, premium experience. You'll join a collaborative, hands-on team where your designs directly influence real products and customer experiences.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of design experience
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience partnering with technical partners for design implementation
- Bachelor's degree in in graphic design, industrial design, digital communications design, visual arts, mass communications, art, or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of typographic and brand design principles
- Experience communicating technical concepts and processes using clear, simple language and visuals
- Experience in visual design demonstrated through design concepts, case studies, documentation, mockups and style guides
- Knowledge of typography, design principles, trends and best practices across digital and print
- Experience overseeing all creative aspects of development production and post production
- Experience working with global teams and diverse partners
- Experience developing packaging and printed materials for consumer electronics, technology products, or premium hardware brands.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
• Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
• Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
• Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
• On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
• Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
• Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
• Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Software Engineer, AWS Applied AI Solutions
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

We're building Chorus, a real-time document workspace where AI agents are actual collaborators: an agent gets a cursor in the doc, edits the same CRDT, and shows up in presence right next to you. We wrote it from scratch in Rust and TypeScript; we sync in under 50ms with hundreds of simultaneous editors on a single document, and it costs roughly a dollar per builder per year to run. It's an exciting combination of greenfield work with a massive user base that provides immediate feedback when something doesn't work.

Requirements

• You proactively seek out problems, propose solutions, and own delivery
• You find ways to deliver code with agents at high speed without sacrificing the quality of the code or the software.
• Experience in building distributed and high-concurrency systems
We're a small team with an unusually direct line from idea to thousands of builders using it. If you want to be one of maybe a dozen people in the world shipping production CRDT infrastructure that treats AI as a peer, this is the job.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the design and delivery of significant components of a service scaling from early customers to broad AWS adoption
• Contribute to technical discussions with partner teams — bring data, document tradeoffs, and help the team land on a decision
• Recognize when a one-off solution is the right call versus when a pattern is emerging that deserves a real abstraction, and raise it with the team
• Raise the bar through thorough code reviews and by helping onboard newer engineers to the codebase and team practices
• Contribute to operational excellence: add monitoring and alarming for the features you build, follow through on production readiness, and take ownership during on-call

A day in the life
Your mornings are usually free for focus work -- architecture deep dives and hard problems. Around 11 you'll have standup, then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for design reviews, CR feedback, or unblocking an engineer. Some days you're deep in code; others you're on a call with a customer team working through how their system integrates with yours. You're the person who knows the system most deeply -- and you work to ensure you're never the bottleneck. The problems are hard and the stakes are high -- but we believe we can move fast, do exceptional work, and have a full life outside of it.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications
