title: Support Engineer IV , Amazon Pharmacy Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Pharmacy delivers prescriptions safely, accurately, and fast. The business is defined by four things: cost, speed, scale, and patient safety. Our fulfillment network spans central and regional fill, small-format sites, kiosks, and growing automation, and every order is a patient’s prescription.
The team is the first line of technical support for that network, 24x7 across multiple shifts. We triage fulfillment issues, work with vendors on robotics and automation hardware problems, and route genuine defects to the right engineering team. The goal goes beyond fixing tickets. By finding the patterns behind recurring issues and the friction on the floor, you will turn manual work into automation and help move the operational metrics: faster order flow, higher throughput, lower cost per unit, and fewer escalations, with no compromise on patient safety.


Key job responsibilities
• Triage and resolve fulfillment issues from SIM and Trouble Ticket queues within defined SLAs, as part of a 24x7 multi-shift rotation.
• Diagnose problems across Pharmacy fulfillment systems using logs, metrics, dashboards, and data queries, and restore service quickly.
• Work with third-party vendors on robotics and automation hardware incidents: open and track escalations, share diagnostic data, and confirm fixes on site.
• Resolve network issues that affect fulfillment, mainly orders routed to the wrong fulfillment center and inventory out-of-stock scenarios.
• Route genuine defects to the right engineering team with clear reproduction steps, impact, and root-cause data, and follow them through to resolution.
• Analyze ticket trends to find recurring issues, then write scripts, automated remediation, and self-healing workflows that eliminate them.
• Help automate site launch readiness and configuration checks for new pharmacy sites and formats.
• Build and tune monitoring, dashboards, and alarms that catch issues before sites or patients feel them.
• Write and maintain runbooks, and contribute to Correction of Error (COE) reviews for high-severity incidents.

About the team
Join as one of the first engineers on Amazon Pharmacy’s new Support Engineering team in Bengaluru. You will help shape how the team works from day one: the runbooks we write, the tools we build, and the issues we automate away first. Early members of a new team have an outsized say in its direction, and the work you do here will show up directly in how Pharmacy fulfillment runs worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of software development, or 4+ years of technical support experience
- Experience scripting in modern program languages
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- Experience in agile/scrum or related collaborative workflow
- Experience troubleshooting and documenting findings

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating system
- Experience analyzing and troubleshooting RESTful web API calls
- Knowledge of distributed applications/enterprise applications

title: EDA Silicon Infrastructure Manager, Annapurna ML
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs is looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to think big in defining the strategic direction, roadmap, and execution for EDA infrastructure supporting SoC, IP, physical design, and verification teams. This is first and foremost a leadership and people management role: you will build, inspire, mentor, and grow a team of 6–10 engineers, set a high performance bar, develop the next generation of engineering leaders, and create a team culture rooted in operational excellence and customer obsession. You will own the team’s vision and success metrics, drive organizational alignment across globally distributed silicon development environments, and be accountable for the compute infrastructure, design-data-management methodologies, and automation your team delivers. While this role carries full management responsibility, it equally demands a hands-on technical leader. You will roll up your sleeves alongside your team, participating in architecture reviews, deep dives, on-call rotations, and incident response to maintain technical credibility and unblock engineers. You will guide the team in architecting scalable infrastructure including Linux-based compute clusters, storage, networking, HPC, and cloud-enabled hybrid platforms while optimizing silicon development flows spanning synthesis, place-and-route, STA, DFT, verification, emulation, and signoff. You will champion standardization, automation, and engineering productivity through self-service platforms, CI/CD workflows, and tooling that eliminates operational overhead, partnering with CAD methodology teams, silicon engineering teams, and AWS services teams to deliver infrastructure that is scalable, reliable, and globally supportable.

Key job responsibilities
• Build, inspire, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed team of 6–10 software development engineers and systems engineers; set clear expectations, conduct regular performance reviews, and foster a culture of ownership, operational excellence, and customer obsession.
• Recruit, hire, and retain top engineering talent; own the hiring bar for your team and actively build a diverse pipeline of candidates who strengthen the organization.
• Coach and develop engineers at all levels; create individualized growth plans, identify future leaders, and invest in the career development of every team member to build the next generation of engineering leaders.
• Define the team’s vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for EDA infrastructure; align priorities with organizational goals and communicate the strategy clearly to stakeholders at all levels.
• Define and track success metrics for the team and the services it provides, using data-driven dashboards and AI-assisted analytics to inform priorities, measure impact, and hold the team accountable to results.
• Drive strategic infrastructure decisions that support customer needs across systems, pre-silicon, and post-silicon teams, balancing immediate delivery with long-term scalability and technical excellence.
• Partner directly with silicon design, verification, emulation, software, and AWS service teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and iteration cycles; align infrastructure roadmaps with program milestones, establish continuous feedback mechanisms, and drive unified outcomes across organizational boundaries.
• Present technical documents, weekly reports, and program status updates to senior leadership, clearly communicating progress, risks, trade-offs, and resource needs.
• Maintain hands-on technical credibility by participating in deep dives, architecture reviews, on-call rotations, and incident response; lead by example to unblock the team and make sound technical decisions.
• Guide the team in architecting and evolving the compute, storage, networking, and scheduling infrastructure (LSF, Slurm, Kubernetes) that underpins all phases of silicon development, from RTL through GDSII signoff, ensuring it scales across global sites.
• Own end-to-end platform delivery for cloud infrastructure (AWS) and high-performance computing clusters that support EDA workloads including simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and verification.
• Own platform reliability, performance, and cost efficiency end-to-end; define and enforce SLOs, lead capacity planning, and drive cost optimization that maximizes engineering throughput.
• Establish incident management frameworks, lead postmortems, and codify operational excellence standards; create runbooks and preventive automation that improve system resilience and reduce mean time to recovery.
• Drive standardization and automation through self-service platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code to eliminate manual toil in project onboarding, workspace provisioning, and infrastructure deployment.


A day in the life
As an EDA Silicon Infrastructure Manager at Annapurna Labs, your day is defined by leadership. You start the morning reviewing overnight job/ticket metrics and platform health dashboards, then lead a team standup to triage incidents, remove blockers, and align on sprint priorities. You hold a 1:1 with engineers to discuss their career growth trajectory and coach them on preparing for a promotion. Mid-morning, you lead a capacity planning review for an upcoming tape-out, guiding your engineers through compute and storage modeling while making resource allocation decisions. After lunch, you roll up your sleeves and join a hands-on deep dive into a production incident, working side-by-side with your team to diagnose root cause and define corrective actions. Later, you lead a design review for a new automation service, coaching team members through architecture trade-offs and ensuring alignment with the broader infrastructure strategy. You then meet with a partner team in silicon verification to understand their evolving workflow needs and translate those into infrastructure priorities for your team’s roadmap. You close the day by reviewing a weekly report for senior leadership, clearly communicating your team’s progress on key operational metrics, risks, and upcoming milestones. Throughout it all, you balance the demands of people leadership, including hiring, performance management, and team development, with the technical depth that keeps you credible and effective as a hands-on engineering leader. Your leadership directly impacts the productivity of hundreds of engineers building breakthrough AWS silicon.

About the team
At Annapurna Labs, you will be at the heart of the infrastructure that powers breakthrough innovations in custom silicon for AWS. The ML Infrastructure team builds and operates the compute, storage, networking, CI/CD, and developer platforms that hundreds of chip designers and verification engineers depend on daily. We offer the resources and scale of AWS with the innovation culture and technical depth of a focused silicon team.
If you are passionate about leading high-performing engineering teams, thrive on solving complex infrastructure challenges at scale, and want to combine hands-on technical leadership with people management to accelerate the next generation of AWS silicon, we want to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
- 3+ years of managing system or software development teams experience
- 5+ years of deploying and operating in a Linux/Unix environment experience
- Experience with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design and scripting languages and their associated development environments
- Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- • 10+ years of experience in software development, systems engineering, EDA infrastructure, or engineering compute environments
- • Strong background in high-performance computing (HPC) environments and networked file systems (NFS, Lustre, or similar).
- • Familiarity with semiconductor development workflows and EDA tools including simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, static timing analysis, and formal verification.
- • Experience with job scheduling systems such as LSF, Slurm, or Grid Engine.
- • Experience with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.

Preferred qualifications

- • Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure at scale, including deep knowledge of EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, and related services.
- • Experience with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms for infrastructure workloads.
- • Experience with EDA vendor toolchains and licensing models (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens EDA).
- • Experience developing CAD methodology and engineering automation for RTL-to-GDSII flows.
- • Track record of leveraging automation and AI/ML to improve engineering productivity and operational efficiency.
- • Experience designing and operating observability platforms including dashboards, alerting, and data pipelines for infrastructure metrics.
- • Experience with high-performance storage architectures and optimizing data movement for large-scale compute workloads.
- • Experience managing cloud and EDA license costs and delivering measurable savings.
- • Experience delivering technical training to engineering teams and developing comprehensive documentation.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer I, Leo Network Observability, Visibility & Analytics team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's Low Earth Orbit satellite network, with a mission to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will connect people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Leo Network Observability, Visibility & Analytics team builds the systems that provide deep, end-to-end insight into the health, performance, and reliability of this global telecom network. Our systems span the full Leo service, from satellites and customer terminals to ground gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial network infrastructure, and help engineers understand network behavior, detect failures quickly, and diagnose complex issues.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the network health metrics, dashboards, and APIs our engineers and leaders rely on are accurate, reliable, and ready for release. You will test systems that turn network telemetry and events into answers to critical questions: Is the network healthy? Where is a failure occurring? What is its customer impact?

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Create and execute test plans and test cases for new and existing features across our network health services, data pipelines, APIs, and dashboards, ensuring thorough functional, integration, and end-to-end coverage across straightforward and moderately complex scenarios.
- Develop, maintain, and extend automated tests for APIs, UI, and data pipelines using languages such as Python, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to reduce manual testing effort.
- Validate the accuracy of network health metrics (such as availability, latency, and packet loss) against source data and expected results.
- Troubleshoot and isolate defects from test and pipeline failures, file clear and actionable bug reports, and work with developers to drive root cause analysis and resolution.
- Review requirements, designs, and change requests with engineers and product managers to identify risks and test gaps early, and recommend changes that improve quality and the customer experience.
- Participate in defect triage, test planning, and prioritization discussions, helping the team balance time constraints with test coverage goals.
- Use AI tools to help generate test cases, expand coverage, and speed up defect investigation.
- Track quality metrics and share release readiness status with the team.

A day in the life
As a QAE on the Network Observability team, you'll work with software engineers, network engineers, and product managers to review new features, identify risks, and plan how to test them. You might validate that a new availability metric matches the underlying telemetry one day, and build API automation for a new service the next. You'll write and run automated tests, triage failures in CI/CD pipelines, and partner with developers to reproduce and fix defects. You'll take part in sprint ceremonies and design reviews, and help make sure the data engineers and leaders use to operate the Leo network is right.

About the team
The Leo Network Observability, Visibility & Analytics team is responsible for making a highly distributed global telecom network understandable and operable at scale. We build the visibility layer that connects network signals across satellites, customer terminals, gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial infrastructure, turning individual telemetry signals into an end-to-end view of network health so issues can be detected, diagnosed, and resolved faster.

The problems we solve are inherently distributed and combine software engineering with networking and data science. We are building new capabilities rather than applying existing observability patterns to a conventional cloud service. If you enjoy ambiguous problems, care about getting the details right, and want to help build foundational systems for Amazon Leo, this team is a great place to grow.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience in automation testing
- Experience in manual testing
- Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in API & Mobile testing
- Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

title: Industriemechaniker
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.

Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

title: Senior Site EHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Site Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with the site level operations team for your designated site in order to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and Kaizen events, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in Amazon’s processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our associates.

In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial. You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals at your designated site. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies.
- Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Ensure safety record keeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
- Deep Dive safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Deep Dive trends and propose action plans to Sr. Leadership on site.
- Audit record keeping practices and Global Safety Database entries to ensure compliance to global safety standards and local regulations.
- Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
- Manage and mentor the Safety Managers and Safety Associates in your assigned site.
- Engage the Injury Prevention Specialists (IPS) and Site Leadership to drive long-term strategic actions to achieve incident reduction.
- Perform targeted Kaizen events in partnership with the Operations teams based on the risks identified in each task (force, repetition, and awkward postures).
- Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.
- Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training.
- Review for effectiveness the deployed safety tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
- Partner with corporate and other regional field safety personnel to leverage global safety and environmental best practices into NA network standards.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 7+ years of increasing responsibilities in safety and/or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations, or relevant experience applicable to the role
- 7+ years of increasing responsibilities in people and performance management
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment
- Willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends, as required to support direct reports and site needs

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree preferred
- Certified Safety Professional preferred
- Experience in a fast-paced, dynamic organization
- Interest in long-term career development through assignments in multiple business units across the nation
- Prior experience in a management development training program
- Track record of effectively managing a safety operation comprising both salaried and hourly staff
- Demonstrate experience in developing others into higher levels of responsibility in an organization
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort interfacing with Directors and VPs
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

title: Sr. Applied Scientist, Applied AI & Data Architecture
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 15, 2026

Do you want to define how enterprises customize their own models ? Do you enjoy work that spans data curation, post-training, evaluation, and production deployment of customized models?

As a Senior Applied Scientist in Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will build that path from customization to trusted evaluation. You will prove it with customers on their own data. You will help customers decide when and how to customize foundation models, using techniques that range from parameter-efficient fine-tuning and distillation to preference optimization and reinforcement fine-tuning. You will turn that work into reusable recipes, evaluation methods, and open-source accelerators that let builders customize models reliably and cost-effectively.

The role splits roughly 50/50 between direct customer engagements and building leverage through reusable science assets, open source, and thought leadership.

- Customer work: You will partner with customer science and engineering teams on their hardest customization problems. You'll frame the problem, choose the right approach, design the evaluation, and work hands-on to get customized models into production.
- Building time : You will develop reference implementations and training recipes, contribute to open-source projects, and publish findings that raise the bar for the broader community. You will work closely with AWS service teams to close the loop between what customers need and what AWS builds.

You will be the team's scientific bar-raiser. You will set evaluation standards, review modeling choices, and publish what you learn, internally and externally. You will work closely with the service teams so that the patterns we prove in the field become native features.

This is a global role within the Solutions Architect organization. You will maintain deep relationships with AI service and science teams and collaborate with specialists and builder customers across regions to stay current on the state of the art and influence roadmaps.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the evaluation methodology. Design the evaluation methodology behind every model-selection and customization decision. Score quality, cost, latency, and safety in a way that is reproducible, statistically sound, and calibrated to each customer's quality bar.
- Lead customization engagements end to end. Drive work from data curation and synthetic data generation through fine-tuning, distillation, continued pre-training, and reinforcement learning. Re-score every change against the same harness so customers see exactly what they gained.
- Invent where no textbook solution exists. Develop new techniques such as reward design for agentic tasks, simulation-based evaluation, and efficient serving of small decision models, then package them as reusable code any Solutions Architect can run.
- Turn engagement learnings into reusable assets. Build reference architectures, open-source accelerators, workshops, enablement materials, blogs, and papers that form a repeatable path from evaluation through deployment.
- Advise field teams and customers. Act as the scientific advisor on trade-offs among prompting, retrieval, customization, and frontier models, including knowing when not to customize.
- Mentor and influence across teams. Mentor engineers and Solutions Architects in ML methodology. Turn customer evidence into feature requests and proposals for AWS service teams that make field-proven patterns native product capabilities.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing a customer's distillation results, where a smaller model is closing the gap with a much larger one. The gains cluster in one task slice, so you flag possible data leakage before the design review. Afterward, you add a held-out evaluation set and a capability-regression check to the training recipe. In the afternoon, you share engagement findings with a product team to shape how evaluation fits into the customization workflow. You wrap up by refining an open-source evaluation harness you'll release alongside a customer workshop.

About the team
Applied AI and Data Architects (AIDA) is a team of specialized AI prototypers with a product mindset. The team builds a portfolio of domain-specific Tech Field Products in areas such as semantics, data engineering, ML, AI security/governance/agent-ops, and DevOps. Model customization and evaluation is one of the team's focus areas. Its goal is to make foundation and open weight model customization repeatable, measurable, and accessible to builders. title: Data Scientist, EU Prime and Marketing Analytics & Science (PRIMAS)
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about giving customers the richest, most inspiring experience in their shopping journey? Do you like to dive deep to understand how customer-centric solutions drive measurable results? Do you enjoy working closely with the business and software engineers to design rigorous experiments, build the data infrastructure behind them, and translate results into decisions? You are in the right place! Come join our Prime & Marketing Analytics and Science (PRIMAS) team, where your work will directly impact millions of customers.

The EU Marketing & Prime organization is looking for a Data Scientist to join the PRIMAS team. This role sits at the intersection of applied statistics and large-scale analytics — you'll design experiments and causal models, and also own the data pipelines, metrics, and reporting infrastructure that make those results usable across the business.

The PRIMAS team provides a comprehensive understanding of customer segments, affinities, and lifetime value. We use data science tools and advanced statistical techniques to study customer purchase and engagement behaviors, and generate actionable insights on where, when, and how we deliver products and programs to customers. We help increase customer engagement, sales, and marketing efficiency, and our systems are built entirely in-house on automated large-scale analytics infrastructure. You will design, launch, and measure experiments across marketing channels (SEM/SEO, Affiliates, Display, Social, Mobile, Email, Onsite, etc.), engagement products, and customer segments. You will improve our understanding of customer behavior, run rigorous power and minimum detectable effect (MDE) analyses to size experiments correctly, and build the causal and conversion models that value and target our marketing — then build the pipelines and dashboards that keep those signals flowing reliably to stakeholders and downstream systems. You will work at the forefront of consumer analytics, tackling some of the hardest measurement problems in the industry alongside strong scientists, statisticians, and software engineers.

Key job responsibilities
1. Design and implement scalable, statistically rigorous experiments (A/B, geo, holdout, quasi-experiments) to measure marketing incrementality across channels.
2. Perform power analysis and minimum detectable effect (MDE) calculations to determine experiment sample sizes, durations, and design trade-offs before launch.
3. Build causal and treatment-effect models that produce conversion and valuation signals consumed by downstream bidding and budgeting systems.
4. Building the ETL, metric definitions, and datasets that make results scalable, extensible, and repeatable rather than one-off analyses.
5. Develop measurement frameworks that quantify the true, platform-independent contribution of marketing over time, and build the dashboards and reporting that keep those metrics visible to the business.
6. Apply statistical, mathematical, and machine learning techniques to solve ambiguous business problems where the right approach isn't obvious.
7. Analyze experiment results for validity — inspecting distributions, checking for sample ratio mismatch, exploring covariate balance, and tracking down the source of anomalies.
8. Communicate experiment design, results, and trade-offs clearly to business and leadership audiences, including inputs into business reviews, and influence decisions and technical direction across teams.
9. Establish scalable, repeatable processes and best practices for experiment design, data modeling, and analysis.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- 2+ years of data/research scientist, statistician or quantitative analyst in an internet-based company with complex and big data sources experience
- 1+ years of creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers, or educational content experience
- Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

Preferred qualifications

- Ph.D. in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Knowledge of statistical packages and business intelligence tools such as SPSS, SAS, S-PLUS, or R
- Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving
- Experience with clustered data processing (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Map-reduce, and Hive)
- Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
- Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
- Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

title: Robotics Maintenance Technician, Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR) team is building advanced robotic systems that will transform autonomous operations. Our mission is to push the boundaries of what's possible in robotics, developing next-generation AI models that operate on numerous hardware embodiments in complex, real-world environments.

FAR is seeking a Robotics Maintenance Technician with high ownership and an R&D mindset. You will tackle maintenance, repair, and operational readiness of our robotic hardware platforms, test systems, and lab infrastructure. This hands-on role focuses on keeping our robots running at peak performance through expert troubleshooting, custom fabrication, and preventive maintenance. You will help the team through process standardization and knowledge sharing. You'll work shoulder to shoulder with the engineers and researchers who design and build cutting-edge robotic systems.

Key job responsibilities
Maintenance, Fabrication & Repair
- Maintain, troubleshoot, and improve a diverse fleet of robotic and electromechanical systems, including manipulators, humanoid robots, and hardware subsystems
- Troubleshoot humanoid robot software issues via Linux CLI, Python and log analysis, including sensor/actuator faults, communication dropouts, outdated firmware, and runtime errors
- Design, build, and improve custom electrical harnesses, cable assemblies, and robotic modifications with emphasis on proper cable routing, strain relief, and system reliability
- Replace and repair electrical components (motor drivers, relays, sensors, power distribution) and mechanical components (bearings, gears, actuators, drivetrain assemblies, end-effectors)
- Troubleshoot and repair control systems including EtherCAT, CAN bus, motor controllers, embedded electronics, and sensor arrays; read and interpret electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic schematics
- Develop and execute preventive and corrective maintenance processes, SOPs, and maintenance plans for robotic systems
- Develop and implement failure-tracking systems to capture failures, identify trends, perform root-cause analysis, and proactively reduce recurring issues
- Coordinate with robotics vendors for technical support, repairs, and replacement strategies
- Track spare-parts needs and maintain inventory records

Lab, Fleet & Researcher Support
- Maintain laboratory and testing environments in a clean, organized, safe, and ready-to-use condition
- Support lab reconfiguration, hardware integration, and prototype bring-up activities
- Serve as a maintenance point of contact for researchers, interns, and project teams; establish strong communication to understand requirements and develop practical solutions
- Review incoming requests, define scope and execution plans, establish timelines, and provide hands-on technical support

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- Associate's degree in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical Technology, or related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and experience)
- 1+ years of maintenance experience in robotics, autonomous systems, advanced manufacturing/technology, or R&D lab environments, including hands-on mechanical and electrical repair of complex electromechanical systems
- Experience reading and troubleshooting electrical and mechanical schematics
- Experience with motors, actuators, sensors, control systems, hand/power tools, soldering, and diagnostic equipment

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a technical field
- 3+ years of maintenance experience, including direct experience maintaining robotic systems (industrial robots, humanoids, mobile platforms, manipulators, or autonomous vehicles)
- Hands-on experience designing and building custom mechanical mounts, electrical harnesses, cable assemblies, or robotic modifications
- Familiarity with ROS, Linux command line, or basic Python scripts; EtherCAT or CAN bus diagnostics experience

title: AI Content & Reg Analyst, T&S, Trust and Safety
descriptionHtml:
The Content and Regulatory Analyst (CRA) is a specialist role in AWS Trust and Safety covering content abuse and the regulatory obligations attached to it, across AWS infrastructure and AWS AI services. The role covers CSEA, image-based sexual abuse, terrorist and violent extremist content, AI-generated harmful content, and other content abuse types. You will make per-case content determinations — with defensible reasoning and chain of custody — for abuse on the AWS platform including AWS AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker AI, and the growing set of GenAI-backed services), and you will handle the escalations and mandatory reporting obligations that come with them. While the role centers on complex content abuse across the AWS platform, including AI services, you will also act as a subject matter expert (SME) on policy and regulatory guidance across complex content abuse types spanning multiple AWS services, providing SME advice and escalation support to T&S and cross-functional partners.

You will collaborate across T&S and with cross-functional stakeholders (T&S Policy, Legal, Product and Engineering Teams), to drive the programs and processes that handle content abuse on AWS. The role is both operational and strategic. Operationally, you will liaise with AWS Product and Engineering and external partners to action abuse reports, respond to regulatory inquiries, craft customer-facing messaging, and resolve escalations. Strategically, you will support anti-abuse preparedness and response planning, including readiness for new regulation: defining project goals, building project plans, managing timelines across multiple stakeholders, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and meet their success metrics.

A defining feature of this role is its relationship to automation. You will not only review content — You will work with Policy, Product and Engineering to improve how content abuse is detected and prioritized, using case outcomes to improve accuracy over time. You will also create procedures and support initiatives — including content and training — that educate AWS customers on the responsible use of the AWS platform and services in a manner that prevents abuse or enables swift response. As one of the more technically proficient members of the team, you will also act in a mentor capacity whenever possible, helping ensure the continued growth and success of the AWS Trust & Safety team.

Key job responsibilities
- Review complex and AI abuse cases and make per-case determinations with defensible reasoning and chain of custody, handle customer escalations, coordinate across T&S and cross-functional teams (Legal, Product and Engineering), and produce written summaries or verbal briefings for senior leadership.
- Manage mandatory reporting of child sexual abuse material and other statutory reporting obligations, meeting required timeframes.
- Run operational responses to content regulation across multiple jurisdictions, including takedown requests, regulatory inquiries, and transparency reporting, working with Legal and T&S Policy.
- Identify bottlenecks and improve and evolve abuse-handling processes for T&S Operations — including creating and updating procedures and customer communications
- Partner with engineering teams to improve how content abuse is detected and prioritized, and recommend where automation can be extended, supported by documented case outcomes.
- Work with T&S, AWS Product and Engineering, and cross-functional partners to assess the risk that new services, products, or features may be abused — outlining risks and identifying short- and long-term mitigations.
- Track emerging content and AI regulation, AI safety trends and industry practice; identify emerging risks, assess their operational impact on AWS, and work across T&S and AWS to develop mitigation plans.
- Analyze case trends and emerging abuse patterns against upcoming and proposed legislation; translate findings into written memos and recommendations for Policy and Legal stakeholders to inform forward-looking policy and regulatory readiness.
- Analyze case data to find trends that signal opportunities for process improvement, automation, or emerging risks T&S needs to plan for.
- Define project goals and objectives with cross-functional teams; create detailed project plans (timelines, milestones, resource allocation); and manage timelines to ensure on-time delivery.
- Mentor and support the development of T&S team members, sharing expertise and acting in a mentor capacity to strengthen the team's ability to mitigate large-scale and complex abuse events.

About the team
You'll be joining the AWS Trust & Safety (T&S) Team, a global unit dedicated to protecting AWS services from abuse while maintaining customer trust. The team acts as the first line of defense for AWS, analyzing trends and reporting findings to service teams. Your role will involve working closely with various stakeholders — including Policy, Legal, and AWS Account teams — to develop scalable and sustainable solutions that protect against and mitigate abuse. The T&S team is crucial to ensuring that Amazon Web Services remains the most customer-centric company on Earth.

title: Tecnico/a Sicurezza sul Lavoro
descriptionHtml:
Garantire la sicurezza e il benessere dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro è una priorità assoluta in Amazon. I nostri Safety Technician svolgono un ruolo fondamentale per renderlo possibile. Questo ruolo rappresenta un'opportunità per avviare la tua carriera nella sicurezza sul lavoro e crescere in un'azienda internazionale. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i nostri esperti per monitorare il tuo sito, potendo così constatare ogni giorno la differenza che fai per il benessere delle persone.

Il Contratto Collettivo Nazionale (CCNL) di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica, Trasporti e Merci. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 del CCNL di riferimento.

Key job responsibilities
- Eseguire valutazioni del rischio e audit.
- Monitorare il sito per assicurarsi che i processi siano conformi alle procedure di sicurezza di Amazon.
- Creare e aggiornare i report sulle metriche di sicurezza da sottoporre ai colleghi.
- Collaborare con i colleghi di Operations e di tutta l'azienda su compiti relativi alla sicurezza e offrire indicazioni sui processi.
- Supportare l'implementazione di nuove misure di sicurezza.

A day in the life
Lavorerai in uno dei nostri siti. Questo significa che potrai seguire da vicino ciò che accade e i colleghi potranno rivolgersi a te con domande durante i loro turni. Questo ruolo consiste nell'individuare potenziali problemi prima che si verifichino. Dedicherai molto tempo a controllare il sito e a osservare come le persone utilizzano le attrezzature. Comprendendo il funzionamento di ogni attività e di ogni macchinario, sarai in grado di individuare il modo migliore per mantenere i processi sicuri. Sarai anche una delle persone che mettono in atto i cambiamenti in materia di sicurezza, il che significa che lavorerai a stretto contatto con molte persone. Oltre alle tue mansioni quotidiane e settimanali, offrirai supporto al team Operations su attività ad hoc legate alla sicurezza. La sicurezza è fondamentale per Amazon, e ci aiuterai a raccogliere i dati essenziali che ci permettono di tenere sotto controllo i nostri processi e di prevenire qualsiasi problema. Condividerai questi dati con i colleghi di tutta l'azienda e collaborerai con altri team per assicurare che la sicurezza sia sempre al primo posto.

About the team
Il team Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il benessere mentale e fisico dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro. Il nostro team collabora con responsabili, associati e autorità locali in tutti i nostri siti, assicurando il rispetto delle politiche di Amazon e delle normative vigenti, e garantendo la sicurezza dei nostri ambienti di lavoro. Il team offre una varietà di opportunità, dai Safety Technician ai Programme Manager. Indipendentemente dal tuo ruolo, contribuirai allo sviluppo e all'implementazione della strategia di sicurezza sull'intera rete.

Basic qualifications

- Una laurea, oppure una qualifica equivalente conforme al Quadro Europeo delle Qualifiche (EQF), preferibilmente in Tecniche della Prevenzione nell'Ambiente e nei Luoghi di Lavoro o Ingegneria della Sicurezza; oppure altra laurea accompagnata da esperienza rilevante nel campo della sicurezza sul lavoro; oppure laurea in Ingegneria o altri campi specifici, o diploma di scuola superiore con esperienza in ambito produzione/magazzino.
- Certificazione ASPP o RSPP.
- Conoscenza della legislazione italiana in materia di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro.
- Padronanza dell'italiano e conoscenza base dell'inglese (A2), scritto e parlato.

Preferred qualifications

- Le qualifiche preferenziali non sono necessarie per candidarsi a una posizione in Amazon. Se possiedi tutte le qualifiche di base sopra indicate, saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura.
- Esperienza con metodologie Lean, 5S o Kaizen.
- Esperienza nella pianificazione o gestione di iniziative attente all'ambiente.
- Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e in team.

title: Sr. SDM, Systems Integration, Amazon Leo, D2D Software
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices: a fully regenerative fifth-generation (5G) mobile base station on each satellite, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them. Our target is under a day from a defect being found to the fix deployed across the entire constellation, achieved by automating everything that a person would otherwise do by hand.

title: Sr Solutions Architect, EdTech, Worldwide Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help education technology companies build what's next with generative AI? Do you enjoy owning the technical relationship with a customer, from the first architecture whiteboard to a production launch at scale? Would you like a seat on a sales team where your technical judgment shapes the plan and the strategy?

Amazon Web Services is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join the EdTech team in the Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS) organization. You'll be the trusted technical advisor to a set of strategic EdTech customers, from fast-growing startups to established learning platforms that serve millions of students and teachers. You'll help them design, build, and scale on AWS, with a focus on bringing generative and agentic AI into their products in ways that are secure, cost-effective, and ready for production.

From idea to IPO and beyond, AWS sets the standard for education technology. The AWS Cloud lets EdTechs build and launch solutions that help students learn every day. You'll work on problems like scaling for back-to-school peaks, building AI tutors and assistants that teachers and districts can trust, protecting student data, and turning years of learning data into products that improve outcomes.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the technical engagement for a portfolio of strategic EdTech customers, and be accountable for their architecture decisions and their success on AWS.
- Lead generative AI engagements from use case to production, using services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and Amazon Q, including RAG, agents, evaluation, and guardrails.
- Design secure, scalable architectures that meet the privacy and compliance expectations of schools and districts.
- Partner with account managers on account plans, and bring a technical point of view to strategy, opportunity reviews, and executive conversations.
- Turn what you see across customers into reusable patterns, and bring customer feedback to AWS service teams to influence the roadmap.
- Raise the bar for the SA community by mentoring other Solutions Architects, sharing best practices, and speaking at customer and industry events.
- Travel up to 25 to 30% to meet with customers and partners.




Key job responsibilities
- Execution of a strategic technical account plan for platform adoption (e.g., establish relationships to influence technical stakeholders);
- Direct customer interaction to technically qualify and validate sales opportunities (e.g., conduct architecture meetings to validate solution);
- Thought leadership engagements to evangelize and advocate for the AWS platform (e.g., public speaking at customer/partner events) ;
- Curation and documentation of best practices to accelerate deployments of AWS solutions (e.g., public whitepapers, blogs, code);
- Conducting technical enablement for customers/partners (e.g., Immersion Days); and
- Capturing customer feedback and demand for evolving the AWS platform.




A day in the life
You might start with an architecture review for a customer launching an AI teaching assistant. Then you build a proof of concept on Amazon Bedrock, and end the day walking a CTO through a plan to cut inference cost before back-to-school. You'll go deep with engineers and stay strategic with executives, often on the same day.


About the team
EdTech West is a subregion of the North America-based WWPS EdTech organization. The team covers eight territories, each containing multiple customer accounts. Every territory operates with a paired Solutions Architect (SA) and Account Manager (AM).

EdTech and its sister GovTech teams (collectively "xTech") belong to the State and Local Government and Education (SLG/EDU) domain.

Our Customers
EdTech customers are Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) that build and deliver SaaS products for education institutions. Most are private-equity backed commercial companies. They prioritize speed to market, cost control, and product innovation. A large portion of our engagements center on guiding these customers through on-premises-to-cloud migrations and Generative AI adoption.

Industry Rhythm
The education technology industry operates on a seasonal cycle aligned with the academic calendar. Customers deploy their largest application and workload changes during summer months when end-user disruption is lowest. New projects, regional expansions, and application launches occur throughout the year.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Technical Infrastructure Program Mgr, Global Network Delivery
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all of AWS’ global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support AWS data centers globally including all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

The Global Network Delivery organization in AWS Infrastructure seeks a TiPM to support a global data center quality team. In this role you will drive best-in-class cabling quality in AWS’ AMER, APAC, and EMEA data centers to help us achieve the best operating, lowest cost, infrastructure in the world. You will ensure the highest quality standard is enforced and upheld and your efforts ensure we launch our data center network right-first time, on time, to enable the cloud for customers. You will establish mechanisms to inspect, track, and measure cabling projects for installation quality at multiple stages during the deployment process with both internal teams and contracted vendors. You will partner with install teams on remediation efforts and establish preventative mechanisms. You will establish metrics and drive the right quality outcomes by tracking cabling and hardware issues and breaking down problems into different categories and risk levels.

You will partner with a team of quality engineers whose responsibility is to see that all build, scaling, bricks, project cables, racks, and hardware installations are completed adhering to the correct guidelines. title: Senior Product Manager, Production Planning Team, Global Finance Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Your primary mission is automating Amazon's labor planning and to systematically eliminate manual efforts, while driving education and adoption of new automated tools developed by Tech teams. You will partner closely with engineering teams to define product requirements, prioritize the roadmap, and ensure tools deliver measurable business value.

You will also lead expansion programs to extend production planning services across other miles and organizations. This includes identifying opportunities, engaging stakeholders, and leading the end-to-end expansion cycle. Each new expansion is a chance to compound the team's impact and bring world-class planning capabilities to parts of the network that are still operating manually.

To accomplish this, you are expected to possess demonstrated experience in program and stakeholder management, and implementation of GenAI and automation projects. To excel at this role, you must be highly analytical, have knowledge in forecasting models and AI, and the capacity to collaborate and influence other teams is a must.

You must also recognize the ever-present challenges with accuracy of the assumptions that go into labor planning and strive for a deeper understanding of inputs and variation in planning assumptions which dictate the overall short- and long-term staffing outputs.

The decisions you make can have a significant impact on the team's strategy, automation, expansion, and overall costs associated with how well the labor plan balances between the site and network-level constraints.

You will also be responsible for the development of a team of 3–5 planning analysts, business analysts, and/or interns, and act as a Subject Matter Expert who can teach and influence all aspects of production planning — tactically and strategically. You are expected to be highly analytical, understand complex systems, and influence the various stakeholders impacting labor planning, including FC Operations, Ops Finance, HR, S&OP, and Workforce Staffing teams.

Your ability to communicate the short- and long-term staffing strategy of the network is essential. You will influence Directors and Ops Senior Leadership, Finance, HR, and other stakeholders to align and commit to new technologies, processes, and strategies. This guidance will cover a wide array of topics such as volume variability, site execution, assumptions accuracy, market constraints, and labor utilization. Given the scale and complexity of the LATAM network, you will build and lead a team capable of earning the trust of leadership teams across all sites — and of anticipating forward-looking risks to implement timely, high-impact solutions.

Key job responsibilities
Core Responsibilities

- Drive creation of GenAI automation, expansion, process improvement, and Lean initiatives to improve the labor planning process in the LATAM region, ultimately enabling the network to meet and exceed business plans
- Lead labor planning programs across the LATAM fulfillment network
- Leverage the Production Planning and S&OP teams by sourcing and nurturing ideas, and rolling them into the creation of improved and automated planning processes
- Take proactive steps to ensure that best practices in labor planning are shared across the network
- Outline, recommend, and implement new programs that guide the organization in maintaining and improving its competitive position and profitability
- Work with data source providers and technology teams to ensure that key decision data is accurate, automated, and timely
- Develop strategic relationships with your business partners — influence decisions, root cause issues quickly, uncover core problems using data, and create new mechanisms as needed
- Manage a team with competing priorities and provide level-headed guidance during unexpected events
- Expert at managing, evaluating, and analyzing data quickly while creating meaningful business reporting
- Support recruiting efforts to continually hire and develop the best talent

Key Skills & Abilities
- Translate complex, multi-variable data sets into clear, actionable recommendations for senior audiences
- Leverage modern analytics tools including SQL, Python, BI platforms (Tableau, QuickSight, or equivalent), and Excel to build scalable planning models
- Navigate ambiguity and operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment with limited structure
- Communicate staffing strategy concisely to both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels
- Build and sustain cross-functional trust with teams across FC Operations, Finance, HR, S&OP, and Workforce Staffing

A day in the life
As Senior Product Manager for LATAM Production Planning, you sit at the intersection of technology, operations, and strategy. Your decisions directly shape the short- and long-term staffing outputs for one of the world's most complex logistics networks. You'll pioneer GenAI-powered automation, expand planning capabilities to new business units, and develop a team of high-caliber analysts — all while influencing Directors and Senior Leadership across Finance, HR, and Operations. This is a career-defining opportunity for a data-driven leader who thrives on ambiguity and wants to leave a measurable footprint on how Amazon scales across Latin America.

In your first 12 months, you will be expected to:
- Launch or accelerate at least three GenAI-powered automation initiative that measurably reduces manual planning effort
- Co-lead the LATAM production planning roadmap, with a clear 6- and 12-month milestone plan
- Establish or strengthen stakeholder relationships
- Develop and coach your team of analysts, with at least one promotion-ready Intern identified
- Drive expansion of production planning services to at least one new mile or business unit
- Improve forecast accuracy KPIs by defining and tracking new planning accuracy metrics

About the team
The Production Planning Team (PPT) sits within Global Finance Solutions FP&A and is the analytical backbone of Amazon's LATAM fulfillment network. Our team drives the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of labor planning across the region — directly influencing how hundreds of thousands of associates are deployed each day. We partner with FC Operations, S&OP, HR, Workforce Staffing, and Finance to translate complex, dynamic data into actionable staffing strategies. We are a high-visibility, high-impact team at the forefront of GenAI and automation adoption, building the next generation of labor planning tools that will set the standard for the rest of Amazon's global network.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance) experience
- 6+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 6+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- 5+ years of program or project management experience, or a CPA and 4+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
- Experience in Excel (macros, index, conditional list, arrays, pivots, lookups), or experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Demonstrated GenAI experience (e.g., prompt engineering, working with LLM-based tools, or deploying AI automation in an operational or planning context)
- Ability to travel; travel expected primarily to local operations, with additional regional support

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- Experience working in fast paced environments, and managing workload even during times of stress, or escalated activity
- Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
- Experience in a leadership role
- Portuguese fluency
- Experience working in or with Mexico and Brazil operations, logistics, or fulfillment environments
- Previous experience within Manufacturing, Distribution Center, or Logistics processes and systems is a plus
- Advanced problem-solving and root cause analysis skills, combined with a proven ability to communicate those analyses clearly to diverse stakeholders

title: Area Manager, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. title: Senior Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take a first step. A day to look forwards to new challenges. And today is that day for you. It's your day to be part of something great. A day to make your ideas come to life. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people.
Our overall mission is simple: We want Amazon to be the place where our customers can find, discover and buy anything online. Whatever our customers want, we will find the means to deliver it. With your help, Amazon will continue to enable people to discover new worlds and implement innovation. This is your chance to make history.

Amazon is looking to hire an experienced Automation Engineer to join the team at our Fulfillment Center (FC) in Dobrovíz close to Prag.

The Automation Engineer will ensure that Safety comes first in all Facilities efforts. This position will be responsible for troubleshooting, design/implement/document control solutions for material handling systems, act as a liaison for internal and external resources, and be on call as needed. This position will also provide proper training to the Facility Technicians on device troubleshooting and Preventive Maintenance.
This position requires strong project management skills, effective communication skills, being self-directed, and the ability to multi-task and deliver results in a dynamic environment.

The following roles and responsibilities are required for a successful Automation Engineer:
• Prepare specifications and technical detail to fully define performance on equipment, material and services
• Perform PLC control level issue diagnosis
• Follow change management process and develop ad-hoc PLC ladder code change
• Familiarization with Siemens and/or Allen Bradley PLC processers and input/output modules.
• Provide detailed analysis and testing of existing and new engineering solutions and components
• Work with IT, FC Software and Operations Engineering to develop and update controls knowledge and training document for the Facilities Engineering team.
• Be responsible for incident follow-up, root cause analysis and documentation.
• Undertake industrial engineering design on existing material handling modules within European network
• Provide technical documentation such as flow diagrams, conveyor and equipment layouts, installation details, schedules and budgets.
• Support commissioning of new automation elements
• Actively participate in local or EU network level control projects and Initiatives
• Provide value engineering/ value analysis
• Ensures adherence to all Health & Safety procedures. Be proactive in the raising of potential H&S issues and the development of personal safety awareness
• Use AutoCAD to review, develop and maintain electrical schematic and conveyor layout drawings
• Fully understand and ensure procedural adherence to industry operating standards such as QS 9000, ISO 9001
• Actively participate in the Control System SharePoint site development
• Document control system and equipment configuration changes and keep the documentation updated on the SharePoint site.





Key job responsibilities
RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Be the site level Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all controls systems and sensors within the building. Work in a hands-on manner to actively monitor, fault find and repair systems in order to provide a high level of equipment availability to internal customers.
• Train technicians in the basics of control systems fault finding in order to raise the level of knowledge within the site.
• Work within the EU Controls network to enhance the capability to monitor Material Handling Equipment (MHE) metrics and provide visualization and data to internal customers by means of troubleshooting and prioritizing.
• Actively participate in or own continuous improvement projects coordinated by the EU Controls network.
• Work with IT, EU Controls Engineering and Operations Engineering to ensure all systems are correctly documented and that accurate backup libraries are maintained.
• Work alongside global teams to support the installation and commission of new equipment.
• Support other sites in the EU network as required.
• Interpreting both mechanical and electrical drawings plus understanding and developing improvement strategies for code conforming to IEC 61131-3.

Basic qualifications

- - Relevant experience with PLC controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment.
- - Experience supporting a wide range of different conveyors and sortation systems.
- - Experience in dealing with material handling, flow and capacity visualization and monitoring.
- - Experience with Microsoft Office, SolidWorks, Ignition, Visio and AutoCAD.
- - Ability to communicate (written & verbal) in English and the local language at CEFR Level B2 or higher.
- - Electrical or mechanical training degree in computer science, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or related fields.

Preferred qualifications

- - Understanding of ISO 13849 & 62061
- - Familiarity with CE Machinery Directive.
- - Experience in a multi-site environment.
- - Project management experience.
- - Knowledge of data analysis and process improvement techniques.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It’s driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality and productivity across our sites. At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop a team of Area Managers
- Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security
- Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance

A day in the life
You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.

Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. descriptionHtml:

At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun.
